	evam vadan trivikramaḥ <mauna-bhaṅgam>T6 kṛtavān āsīt| ataḥ <<śava-anta:>T6-gataḥ>T2 vetālaḥ tataḥ <na-dṛśyaḥ>Tn bhūtvā vṛkṣasya śākhām avalambitavān|

<svāsthya-rahasyam>T6 (06/03)
<dṛḍha-vrata>K1^ī trivikramaḥ punaḥ api vṛkṣasya śākhāyām lambamānam śavam skandhe āropya   <yathā-pūrvam>A1 maunena śmaśānam prati prasthitavān| tadā  <<śava-anta:>T6-gataḥ>T2 vetālaḥ avadat - ‘‘aye rājan! bhavataḥ pariśramam dṛṣṭavati mayi mahatī dayā utpadyate| <<sva-lābha>T6-artham>T4 pariśramam kṛtavantaḥ bahavaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ mayā| kecana anyasya kasyacit nimittam kāryam ārabdhavantaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ, kintu te <phala-prāpti>T6^taḥ pūrvam eva kāryāt nivṛttāḥ jātāḥ| bhavān tu anyasmai vacanam dattvā tasya pālanāya etādṛśam ghoram kaṣṭam vahati iti bhāti mama| <na-pātre>Tn dhanasya dānam iva <na-pātre>Tn vacanasya dānam api <hāni-karam>U| pūrvam puṣkaraḥ <na-pātre>Tn dānāt hānim anubhūtavān āsīt| bhavataḥ <mārga-āyāsasya>T7 parihārāya <puṣkara-vilāsayoḥ>Di  kathām śrāvayāmi| śraddhayā śṛṇotu tāvat’’ iti|
	anantaram vetālena kathā ārabdhā –
	pūrvam puṣkaraḥ nāma kaścana taruṇaḥ āsīt| saḥ mahāntam pariśramam tu karoti sma, kintu udarambharaṇāya api kleśam anubhavati sma| svasya <hīna-jīvanam>K1 smaran sadā duḥkham anubhavati sma saḥ|
	kadācit <vivāha-maṇḍape>T6 tena kāryam prāptam| kūpāt jalasya uddharaṇam, <pātra{3}-prakṣālam>T6  <iti-ādi>Bs6^kam tena karaṇīyam āsīt| <ā-dinam>A1 tena śramaḥ karaṇīyaḥ āsīt| ye ye <vivāha-gṛham>T6 āgacchanti te <gṛha-janaiḥ>T6 <sa-ādaram>BvP svāgatīkriyante sma, bhojyante sma ca| <bhojana-padārthāḥ>T6 <svāda-yuktāḥ>T3 bhavanti sma| yaḥ tān khādati sma saḥ teṣām praśaṃsām karoti sma eva| puṣkareṇa api kvacit te <bhojana-padārthāḥ>T6 prāpyante sma| ataḥ svasya kāryam mahatā utsāhena kṛtavān saḥ|
	saḥ pācakān praśaṃsan uktavān - ‘‘bhavantaḥ svādūni khādyāni nirmānti| <prati-dinam>A1 kutracit vā bhavadbhiḥ <pāka-kāryam>T6 prāpyeta eva| mām api ātmanā saha nayantu bhavantaḥ| bhavantaḥ yat kāryam vadanti tad aham śraddhayā kariṣyāmi| <pūrṇa-udaram>Bs6 bhojanam mayā sadā prāpsyate| kim etat anumanyate bhavadbhiḥ?’’ iti|
	tadā <pācaka-pramukhaḥ>T6 hasan avadat - ‘‘bhavān <bhojana-priyaḥ>Bs6  iva bhāti| asmābhiḥ saha āgamanena bhavataḥ icchāyāḥ pūrtiḥ na bhavet| yataḥ <prati-dinam>A1 vayam <pāka-kāryam>T6  na prāpnumaḥ| anyat ca, yadā <pāka-kāryam>T6 prāpyate tadā <sāhāyya-artham>T4 sthānīyān eva <karma-karān>U svīkariṣyāmaḥ| ataḥ bhavataḥ āvaśyakatā na asti asmākam| <svādu-bhojanam>K1 prāptavyam cet <dhanika-gṛhe>T6 janma prāptavyam’’ iti|
	dhanikānām gṛhe <prati-dinam>A1 svādu bhojanam bhavati iti aidamprāthamyena śrutavān āsīt puṣkaraḥ| ataḥ saḥ etat śrutvā mahat āścaryam prāptavān| tasya <mukha-bhāvam>T6 dṛṣṭvā <pācaka-pramukhaḥ>T6 avadat - ‘‘kim bhavatā kadāpi <dhanika-gṛhe>T6 kāryam na kṛtam? te <bahu-mūlya>Bs6^kam eva vastram dharanti| <svādu-padārthān>K1 khādanti| mṛdule talpe svapanti| <sarva-vidhāni>Bs6 sukhāni anubhavanti ca’’ iti|
	etat sarvam śrutavataḥ puṣkarasya manasi bhāvanā āgatā yat etādṛśam ekam api svapne api na prāpnuvataḥ mama jīvanam vyartham eva iti| ‘kenacit vā mārgeṇa mayā tādṛśam sukham anubhoktavyam’ iti saṅkalpam kṛtavān saḥ| grāmāt bahiḥ kaścana sannyāsī nivasati sma| puṣkaraḥ tam dṛṣṭvā svasya vyathām niveditavān|
	sarvam śrutvā sannyāsī <<manda-hāsa>K1-pūrvakam>Bs7 uktavān - ‘‘vatsa! eka ekena eka ekam kartavyam nirvoḍhavyam bhavati loke| bhavān yat sukham bhāvayati tat vastutaḥ sukham na| yat kaṣṭam bhāvayati tadapi vastutaḥ kaṣṭam na| ekam tu satyam yat iha prapañce vinā pariśramam kim api na prāpya puram te| sarvam bhagavataḥ icchāyāḥ <anu-guṇam>A1 pravartate’’ iti|
	etasya vacanasya alpaḥ api pariṇāmaḥ puṣkare na jātaḥ| saḥ dainyena sannyāsinam prārthitavān yat <dhanika-gṛhe>T6 mama vāsaḥ janma vā yathā syāt tathā karotu iti|
	tadā saḥ sannyāsī ekam mūlam dattvā avadat - ‘‘<samīpa-sthe>U grāme vilāsaḥ nāma kaścana dhanikaḥ nivasati| <varṣa-dvayāt>T6 pūrvam tena <<patnī-<vi-yogaḥ>Tp>T6 prāptaḥ asti| tasya ubhau putrau staḥ| tau ca videśe vāṇijyam kurutaḥ| <pitṛvya-putrī>T6 kācit idānīm tasya gṛhe nivasantī tadīyam <yoga-kṣemam>Ds  nirvahati| bhavān tam vilāsam paśyatu| etat mūlam ubhābhyām api gṛhītvā manasi vaktavyam yat āvām <<paraspara<deha-vinimayam>T6>S kartum icchāvaḥ iti| tadā vilāsasya śarīram bhavatā prāpyate, bhavata: ca śarīram tena prāpya puram te| eṣā kriyā ucyate – <<para-kāya>T6-praveśaḥ>T7 iti’’ iti|
	‘‘śrīman! bhavatā ucyate – vilāsaḥ dhanāḍhyaḥ bhāgyavān ca iti| evam sthite api kim saḥ mama śarīrasya svīkāram  aṅgīkuryāt?’’ iti pṛṣṭavān puṣkaraḥ|
	‘‘niścayena| bhavādṛśasya kasyacit taruṇasya anveṣaṇam saḥ kurvan asti ā bahoḥ kālataḥ| ataḥ saḥ bhavataḥ śarīram aṅgīkuryāt| bhavān taruṇaḥ| saḥ <madhya-vayaskaḥ>Bs6 | <<para-kāya>T6-praveśaḥ>T7  nāma svasya vayasaḥ api samarpaṇam| ataḥ etasya <<aṅgī-kāra>U-viṣaye>T6 punaḥ cintayatu’’ iti bodhitavān sannyāsī|
	‘‘yauvanāt api sukham pradhānam iti cintayāmi aham| kākaḥ iva <<dīrgha-kāla>K1-jīvanāt>T6 api haṃsaḥ iva <<alpa-kāla>K1-jīvanam>T6 eva varam khalu?’’ iti avadat puṣkaraḥ|
	‘‘rūpam dṛṣṭvā bhavatā bhrāntiḥ na prāptavyā| kākena tādṛśam kim na prāptam, yacca haṃsena prāptam? ataḥ samyak vicintya nirṇayatu’’ iti avadat sannyāsī|
	tathā api tasya vacane <viśeṣa-ādaram>K1 aprakaṭayan puṣkaraḥ <anantara-dine>K1 eva vilāsasya gṛham gatavān| tam dṛṣṭvā svasya icchām prakaṭitavān ca|
	etat śrutvā santoṣam prakaṭayan vilāsaḥ avadat - ‘‘aham bhavādṛśam eva pratīkṣamāṇaḥ āsam| bhavataḥ śarīram aham svīkariṣyāmi, bhavān ca mama śarīram svīkarotu| yāvat etat <śarīra-parivartanam>T6  ubhayoḥ sammatam bhavati tāvat etat anuvartatām’’ iti|
	<etat-anantaram>T6 tau sannyāsinā dattasya mūlasya sāhāyyena <śarīra-vinimayam>T6 kṛtavantau| tasmāt puṣkaraḥ tasya gṛhasya svāmī jātaḥ, vilāsa: ca sevakaḥ jātaḥ|
	<śarīra-parivartana>T6^taḥ puṣkaraḥ nitarām santuṣṭaḥ| madhuram khādanīyam iti tasya manasi icchā utpannā| ataḥ saḥ vilāsasya bhaginīm avadat - ‘‘adya <madhura-khādyam>K1 kārayatu’’ iti|
	vilāsasya bhaginī <pācaka-dvārā>T3 viṃśatim la़ḍḍukāni kāritavatī| tāni <puṣkara-śarīre>T6 sthitasya vilāsasya purataḥ saṃsthāpya - ‘‘bhoḥ, yasmin dine bhavān kāryam ārabdhavān tasmin eva dine bhavatā saubhāgyam prāptam| yāvanti icchati tāvanti laḍḍukāni khādatu bhavān| etat <khādana-kāryam>T6 bhavatā svāminaḥ purataḥ eva karaṇīyam| bhavataḥ svāmī eṣu dineṣu <na-svasthaḥ>Tn asti| tasya kāpi cikitsā <phala-kāriṇī>U na jātā| yat saḥ svayam na khādati tat sevakaiḥ khādyamānam dṛṣṭvā saḥ nitarām santoṣam anubhavati’’ iti avadat|
	<puṣkara-śarīre>K1 sthitaḥ vilāsaḥ catvāri laḍḍukāni khāditvā santoṣam anubhavan avadat - ‘‘etādṛśāni mayā itaḥ pūrvam na khāditāni eva āsan’’ iti|

	vilāsasya bhaginī tasya khādanam nivārayantī avadat - ‘‘agraja ! hanta, kim etat kṛtam bhavatā? gatam tu gatam eva| idānīm <nadī-paryantam>T6 vegena gatvā pratyāgacchatu| vaidyaḥ vadati yat nirantaram vyāyāmaḥ kṛtaḥ cet <yathā-iccham>A1 khāditum śakyeta iti’’ iti|

	<<gṛha-kārya>T6-ādīnām>Bs6 karaṇe yadi api kaṣṭam bhavati sma, tathāpi puṣkarasya śarīram tyaktum vilāsasya icchā na āsīt| yataḥ puṣkarasya śarīre tāruṇyam āsīt|

	vetālaḥ evam kathām samāpya  avadat – ‘‘rājan! sannyāsinaḥ kathanam kim <yukti-saṅgatam>T3 asti? kim tatra <naitika-mūlyam>K1 asti? puṣkaraḥ <kṛta-ghnaḥ>U na iti tasya kathanam kim <yukti-saṅgatam>T3 asti? <vilāsa-puṣkarayoḥ>Di yā vāstavikī samasyā āsīt tasyāḥ parihāram vismṛtya sannyāsī kamapi mārgam upadiṣṭavān| evam nanu? mama eteṣām sandehānām samādhānam jānan api bhavān yadi na vadet tarhi bhavataḥ śiraḥ sahasradhā bhagnam bhavet’’ iti|
	tadā maunena sthātum <na-śaktaḥ>Tn trivikramaḥ avadat - ‘‘sannyāsī na kevalam mahatyā śakteḥ āśrayaḥ, api tu <mānava-svabhāvasya>T6 jñātā api asti saḥ| puṣkaraḥ <kṛta-ghnaḥ>U na iti tena yat cintitam tat yuktam eva| <madhya-vayaskasya>Bs6 vilāsasya śarīram praviṣṭavān puṣkaraḥ avagatavān yat vilāsasya śarīre ke ke rogāḥ santi, teṣām kāraṇam ca kim iti| vilāsaḥ <vilāsamaya-jīvanasya>K1 dāsaḥ jātaḥ āsīt| alpam api pariśramam na karoti sma saḥ| vyāyāmam kaṭākṣeṇa api na paśyati sma| tasya rogasya kāraṇam etat eva āsīta| puṣkaraḥ etat avagatavān| <yauvana-pūrṇam>T3 śarīram api <roga-grastam>T3 na syāt iti cintayan saḥ <vilāsa-dvārā>T6 bahūni kāryāṇi kāritavān| etasmāt saḥ svasya śarīrasya rakṣaṇam kartum śaktavān, vilāsena <śrama-jīvanasya>T6 abhyāsam kāritavān ca| evam puṣkareṇa vilāsasya hitam eva cintitam| ataḥ puṣkare <kṛtaghnatā-āropaḥ>T6 sarvathā anucitaḥ’’ iti|

<dṛḍha-vrataḥ>Bs6 trivikramaḥ svīkṛtam kāryam parityaktum <na-icchan>Tn punaḥ api vṛkṣasya samīpam gatavān| vṛkṣam ārūhya śākhāyām lambamānam śavam skandhe āropya  adhaḥ āgatavān| tataḥ <yathā-pūrvam>A1 maunam <śmaśāna-abhimukham>T6 prasthitavān ca| tadā <<śava-anta:>T6-gataḥ>T2 vetālaḥ avadat - ‘‘aye rājan! bhavataḥ eṣaḥ mahān pariśramaḥ <sva-nimitam>T6 uta <anya-nimittam>T6 ityeva na jñāyate mayā| bhavān kaścit <deśa-pālakaḥ>T6 ityataḥ anyaḥ <deśa-pālakaḥ>T6 bhavantam etādṛśe kārye pravartayitum na arhati| kadācit paṇḍitāḥ bhavantam etasmin kārye pravartitavantaḥ syuḥ| yataḥ pāṇḍityena <pada-jālena>T6 vā anyasya bandhane teṣām <viśeṣa-ruciḥ>K1  bhavati| bhavān api rāmaśāstrī iva anyena prayukte <pada-jāle>T6  patitaḥ syāt iti bhāti mama| rāmaśāstrī kaḥ, tasya kathā kā iti jñātum kutūhalam syāt khalu bhavataḥ? tasya kathām vistareṇa śrāvayāmi, śraddhayā śrṛṇotu tāvat’’ iti|
anantaram vevālena kathā ārabdhā -
	pūrvam rāmaśāstrī nāma kaścit āsīt| saḥ alpe eva vayasi <śāstra-ādīni>Bs6 adhītya ‘paṇḍitaḥ’ iti khyātim prāptavān āsīt| tasya apekṣā āsīt yat mayā tādṛśam pāṇḍityam prāptavyam, yena mattaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ paṇḍitaḥ kaḥ api na bhavet iti| saḥ kadācit gṛham āgatavantam pituḥ bālyasne hitam śambhuśarmāṇam svasya āśayam niveditavān| saḥ pituḥ <bālya-sneha>T7^itaḥ śāstram adhītavān āsīt| ataḥ kāṃścana <śāstra-sambaddhān>T3 praśnān pṛṣṭvā utaram ca jñātvā saḥ ‘‘pāṇḍityam asti iti tu satyam eva| tatra api alpe vayasi etādṛśasya pāṇḍityasya prāptiḥ nitarām <na-pūrvā>Bsmn| tathā api <<na-sadṛśa>Bsmn-pāṇḍityam>K1  prāptavyam cet <nūtana-padānām>K1 sṛṣṭiḥ bhavatā karaṇīyā, tāni padāni vyavahāre ānetavyāni ca’’ iti uktavān|
‘‘tathā <nūtana-śabdānām>K1 sṛṣṭau <ati-samarthaḥ>Tp etāvatā eva kaḥ api asti vā’’ iti pṛṣṭavān rāmaśāstrī| 
 	‘‘kuto na| asmākam grāme devaśāstrī nāma kaścit asti| saḥ <nūtana-śabdānām>K1 nirmāṇe <artha-avagamane>T6 ca nitarām samarthaḥ| kintu kadācit tena prayujyamānānām padānām artham avagantum paṇḍitāḥ api kleśān anubhavanti| rājñaḥ sammānanam api prāptam asti tena| bhavatu nāma| aham tasya paricayam kārayāmi| yadi <<gūḍha-artha>K1-garbhitasya>T3 vākyasya prayogam bhavān karoti, tarhi saḥ bhavantam śiṣyatvena aṅgīkuryāt’’ iti uktavān śambhuśarmā|
rāmaśāstrī tena saha prasthitaḥ| mārge tasya manasi ekā eva cintā - devaśāstriṇā kīdṛśyā śailyā sambhāṣaṇam karaṇīyam iti|
śambhuśarmaṇaḥ anupamā nāma putrī āsīt| sā rūpeṇa buddhimattayā ca anupamā eva| ‘yadi mama putryāḥ rāmaśāstriṇaḥ ca <paraspara{2}-paricayaḥ>S bhavet, tataḥ ca tayoḥ vivāhaḥ nirvartanīyaḥ’ iti cintanam āsīt śambhuśarmaṇaḥ| ata: rāmaśāstriṇaḥ <<anu-caraṇa>Tp-artham>T4 anupamām niyojitavān āsīt saḥ|
rāmaśāstrī tu <sva-pāṇḍityasya>T6 pradarśanam katham ityeva sadā cintayan bhavati sma| ataḥ saḥ anupamāyāḥ saundaryam pāṇḍityam vā draṣṭum na śaktavān eva| tām sāmānya sevikām bhāvayan saḥ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi tām ādiśati sma| <dvi-trāṇām dinānām anantaram rāmaśāstrī <ātaṅka-miśritena>T3 svareṇa <sva-gavam>T6 iva uktavān-‘‘śvaḥ mayā devaśāstrī draṣṭavyaḥ’’ iti| 
‘‘sa tu idānīm grāme na asti| <<dina-dvaya>T6-anantaram>T6 prati āgacchet saḥ’’ iti uktavatī anupamā| 
‘‘itaḥ api <dina-dvayasya>T6 pratīkṣā karaṇīyā vā mayā| aho, dināni yugāyante atra’’ iti khedena uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
‘‘<kim-artham>T4 tāvatī cintā bhavataḥ? <<dina-dvaya>T6-ātma>Bs6^ke avadhau nūtanāni padāni sṛṣṭvā vyavahāre prayujya anubhavam sampādayatu bhavān’’ iti uktavatī anupamā| 
‘‘sarvāṇi api <nūtana-padāni>K1 mayā jhaṭiti avagamyante eva| yataḥ tādṛśam <na-pūrvam>Bsmn pāṇḍityam asti mama| devaśāstrī api yeṣām padānām artham na jānīyāt tādṛśāni padāni prayoktum api sāmarthyam asti eva mama| ata: kim abhyāsena’’ iti <sa-garvam>Bvs uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
tadā anupamā <<manda-hāsa>K1-pūrvakam>Bs7 uktavatī - ‘‘bhavān tu <mahat-paṇḍitaḥ>K1| bhavatā saha sambhāṣaṇam kurvatī kālam yāpayāva’’ iti|
‘‘paṇḍitasya mama paṇḍitena saha eva sambhāṣaṇam śobhate| ki sāmānyai: saha vyavahāreṇa’’ iti punaḥ api garveṇa eva uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
‘‘bhavādṛśānām nimittam eva ‘vikṛtaghnaḥ’-nāmakam padam sṛṣṭam asti’’ iti <kopa-miśritena>T3 svareṇa uktvā khedena tata: nirgatavatī anupamā|
anupamayā prayuktam vikṛtaghna: ityetat padam rāmaśāstriṇaḥ pīḍāyai ajāyata| bahudhā cintanasya anantaram api tena na jñātam yat anupamayā <kim-artham>T4 mayi ‘vikṛtaghnaḥ’ iti etat padam prayuktam iti| mayā ‘‘kāmapi kṛtaghnatām <na-kṛtavati>Tn mayi vikṛtaghnaḥ iti śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ bhavatyā| mayā kā kṛtaghnatā ācāritā’’ iti|
‘‘yadā bhavān <asmat-gṛham>T6 āgatavān tadā ārabhya mayā bhavataḥ sevā kṛtā| bhavata: praśaṃsā api kṛtā| etasya <prati-phalam>Tp mayā kim prāptam? sevā <sa-santoṣam>Bvs svīkṛtā bhavatā| na mama <saundarya-atiśaya:>T6 lakṣita:| mama buddhimattām <na-parīkṣya>Tn eva bhavatā nirṇītam yat aham <<sevā-mātra>Tm-artham>T4 arhā iti| <<upakāra-smaraṇa>T6-pravṛti:>T6  eva na asti bhavata:| ata: bhavān vikṛtaghnaḥ eva’’ iti uktavatī anupamā| 
‘‘punarapi mayi <vikṛtaghna-padasya>K7 prayogaḥ| etādṛśam padam loke vyavahāre na asti| kṛtam upakāram yaḥ vismarati saḥ ucyate kṛtaghnaḥ iti| vikṛtaghnaḥ iti padam tu na <prayukta-pūrvam>S’’ iti uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
	‘‘bhavān <kṛtaghna-mātram>Tm  na| ataḥ eva mayā <vikṛtaghna-padam>T6 prayuktam| bhavādṛśānām nimittam eva devaśāstriṇā etat padam sṛṣṭam asti’’ iti uktavatī anupamā|
	<vikṛtaghna-śabdaḥ>K7 devaśāstriṇā sṛṣṭaḥ iti śrutvā rāmaśāstrī nirṇītavān yat etasya padasya <viśiṣṭa-arthaḥ>K1 kaḥ api asti eva iti| ataḥ saḥ tasya padasya arthasya <avagamana-artham>T4 bahudhā <pra-yatnam>Tp kṛtavān| tathāpi arthaḥ tu na avagataḥ| ataḥ saḥ punarapi anupamām prārthitavān - ‘‘kṛpayā etasya padasya artham vadatu’’ iti|
	tadā anupamā uktavatī - ‘‘<mahat-paṇḍitaḥ>K1 bhavān etasya padasya artham itaḥ api avagantum na śaktavān? na hi sarvaḥ sarvam jānāti iti śrūyate| ataḥ bhavataḥ <sāhāyya-artham>T4 vadāmi| virūpam uddiśya etat padam aidamprāthamyena prayuktam| ataḥ virūpam yadi bhavān drakṣyati tarhi tasya padasya arthasya avagamanam <su-karam>Tg syāt’’ iti|
	‘‘kaḥ ayam virūpaḥ nāma janaḥ?’’ iti pṛṣṭavān rāmaśāstrī|
	‘‘virūpaḥ nāma kaścana kṛṣikaḥ| saḥ kadācit niścitavān yat alpena mūlyena kṣetram kretavyam iti| tasya samīpe dhanam na āsīt| tadā prativeśī śivarāmaḥ <ṛṇa-rūpeṇa>T6 dhanam dattavān| tena kṣetram krītavān virūpaḥ| tasmin kṣetre tena nidhiḥ prāptaḥ| tataḥ śivarāmasya ṛṇam pratyarpitavān virūpaḥ| atrāntare śivarāmasya putryāḥ vivāhaḥ niścitaḥ| <putrī-vivāhasya>T6 <nirvartana-artham>T4 virūpam ṛṇam yācitavān śivarāmaḥ| tadā virūpaḥ darpeṇa uktavān - ‘‘<nir-dhanāya>Bvp mayā ṛṇam na dīyate| nirdhanena <<ṛṇa-svīkāra>T6-cintā>T6  na karaṇīyā api’’ iti|
	punaḥ kadācit kṣetre kāryam kurvāṇaḥ virūpaḥ sarpeṇa daṃṣṭaḥ abhavat| <na-<ati-dūre>Tp>Tn kṣetre kāryam kurvāṇaḥ śambhuśarmā dhāvan āgatya virūpam skandhe āropya    māntrikasya samīpam nītavān| ‘yadi alpaḥ vilambaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt tarhi etasya prāṇāḥ apagatāḥ abhaviṣyan’ iti vadan māntrikaḥ yogyayā cikitsayā virūpam ujjīvitavān|
	<anantara-dine>k1 śambhuśarmā api sarpeṇa daṃṣṭaḥ abhavat| <tat samaye>T7 virūpaḥ tena eva mārgeṇa gacchan āsīt| yadā <māntrika-samīpam>T6 śambhuśaraṇasya nayanasya prastāvaḥ āgataḥ  tadā – ‘śambhuśaraṇam skandhe āropya  netum mama sāmarthyam na asti’ iti uktavān virūpaḥ| tadā śambhuśaraṇasya patnyā sūcitam yat māntrikam viṣayam nivedya tam atra ānayatu iti| tadā virūpaḥ uktavān ‘aham <uttara-diśi>K1 prasthitavān asmi| māntrikasya gṛham tu <dakṣiṇa-diśi>K1  asti| ataḥ aham etat kāryam kartum na śaknomi’ iti| tadā śambhuśaraṇasya patnī uktavatī - ‘evam tarhi bhavān atra rakṣakatvena tiṣṭhatu| aham eva gatvā māntrikam āneṣyāmi’ iti| ‘na śakyate etat| mayā tvarayā anyatra gantavyam’ iti vadan tataḥ nirgatavān virūpaḥ| tataḥ <saubhāgya-vaśāt>T6 māntrikaḥ kasmāccit vārtām śrutvā dhāvan āgatya <śambhu-śaraṇasya>T6 prāṇān rakṣitavān| evam asti virūpasya <pṛṣṭha-bhūmikā>K1’’ iti uktavatī anupamā|
	‘‘etam manasi nidhāya eva <kṛtaghna-padam>K7 nirmitam iti bhāti’’ iti uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
	‘‘<kṛtaghna-padam>K7 na, api tu <vikṛtaghna-padam>K7’’ iti uktavatī anupamā|
	‘‘kṛtam upakāram ye na smaranti te kṛtaghnāḥ| vikṛtaghnaḥ iti asya padasya na kaḥ api arthaḥ’’ iti uktavān rāmaśāstrī|
	‘‘kim <adhika-carcayā>K1? sakṛt bhavān tam virūpam dṛṣṭvā āgacchati cet suṣṭhu bhavet’’ iti sūcitavatī anupamā|
	rāmaśāstrī virūpam draṣṭum tataḥ prasthitavān| ‘virūpasya gṛham kutra’ iti praṣṭavyam iti yāvat saḥ cintayan āsīt tāvatā <mārga-pārśve>T6 kalahāyamānau ubhau dṛṣṭau| tayoḥ ekaḥ <dṛḍha-kāyaḥ>K1 mallaḥ iva dṛśyate sma| aparaḥ <kṣīṇa-kāyaḥ>Bs6|<dṛḍha-kāyaḥ>Bs6 <kṣīṇa-kāyam>Bs6 kaṇṭhe gṛhītvā praharan āsīt| rāmaśāstrī tayoḥ kalaham nivārayitum icchan kalahasya kāraṇam pṛṣṭavān| tadā <dṛḍha-kāyaḥ>Bs6 uktavān - ‘‘śrīman! eṣaḥ nadyām patitaḥ san majjanam prāpnuvan āsīt| aham prāṇāpāyam <na-vigaṇayya>Tn nadyām taran etasya rakṣaṇam kṛtavān| etat sarvam <dina-dvayāt>T6 pūrvam pravṛttam| adya aham - ‘ārogyam katham asti?’ iti praṣṭum yadā etasya samīpam āgatavān tadā eṣaḥ mām <na-abhijānan>Tn - ‘kaḥ bhavān?’ iti pṛṣṭavān| aham <dina-dvayāt>T6 pūrvam pravṛttam smāritavān| ‘mayā sā ghaṭanā eva na smaryate’ iti uktavān eṣaḥ| ‘bhavān sarvathā <buddhi-hīnaḥ>T3’ iti vadan mām upahasitavān api| etādṛśasya api upakāram kṛtavān aham niścayena <buddhi-hīnaḥ>T3 eva| etasmin vivekam utpādayitum mama buddhimattā <na-paryāptā>Tn| ataḥ eva <<deha-daṇḍana>T6-pūrvakam>Bs7  etam vivekam bodhayan asmi’’ iti|
	rāmaśāstriṇā sarvam avagatam| ‘eṣaḥ <kṛśa-kāyaḥ>Bs6 eva virūpaḥ syāt’ iti cintitavān saḥ <dṛḍha-kāyam>K1 uddiśya - ‘‘mānyavara! kim etādṛśe <kṣīṇa-kāye>Bs6 jane <deha-balasya>T6 prayogeṇa? eṣaḥ kenacit <viśeṣa-kāraṇena>K1 evam vyavahṛtavān syāt| tat kāraṇam kim iti jñātvā āgatyaaham vadiṣyāmi| ataḥ idānīm etam parityajya gacchatu bhavān’’ iti ukvān|
	rāmaśāstriṇaḥ mukhasya tejasvitām dṛṣṭvā samāhitaḥ san saḥ <dṛḍha-kāyaḥ>Bs6 tataḥ nirgatavān| tadā rāmaśāstrī tam <kṣīṇa-kāyam>Bs6 pṛṣṭavān - ‘‘bhavān eva khalu virūpaḥ?’’ iti|
	‘‘bhavān mattaḥ kim icchati iti aham na jānāmi| aham kaḥ iti bhavān jānāti| kintu bhavān kaḥ iti aham na jānāmi| tathā jñātavyam iti icchā api na asti mama’’ iti vadan virūpaḥ tataḥ nirgatavān| dīrgham niḥśvasya pratigatavān rāmaśāstrī|
	‘‘virūpaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ khalu bhavatā?’’ iti pṛṣṭavatī anupamā|
	‘‘ām| vārtālāpaḥ api kṛtaḥ’’ iti uktavān rāmaśāstrī| tataḥ saḥ pravṛttam sarvam nivedya anupamām punaḥ uktavān - ‘‘virūpasya <nindana-artham>T4 <kṛtaghna-padam>K7 <na-paryāptam>Tn| ataḥ eva devaśāstriṇā <vikṛtaghna-padam>K7 sṛṣṭam asti| viśeṣeṇa yaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ bhavati saḥ eva vikṛtaghnaḥ| ‘vi’ iti etasya upasargasya yojanāt kṛtaghnatāyāḥ parā kāṣṭhā dyotitā bhavati| evam nanu?’’ iti|
	‘‘<śabdārtha-viṣaye>T6 samyak eva cintitam bhavatī| kintu <vikṛtaghna-padasya>K7 vāstavikaḥ arthaḥ tu ito'pi na avagataḥ’’ iti hasantī uktavatī anupamā|
	tāvatā tatra āgataḥ  śambhuśarmā rāmaśāstriṇam uktavān - ‘‘pāṇḍityena anupamām <<anu-artha>A1-nāmadheyām>Bs6 etām mama putrīm etāvatā bhavān avagatavān syāt iti aham cintayāmi| vastutaḥ devaśāstrī nāma ko'pi na asti| bhavatoḥ <melana-artham>T4 eva mayā devaśāstrī sṛṣṭaḥ āsīt’’ iti|

vidūṣakaḥ--(nirūpya) bho! devaulapīṭhiāe mama ṇodaamallaaṃ ṇikkhivia dakkhiṇāmāsaāṇi gaṇia bandhia pa़ḍiṇivutto dāṇi modaamallaaṃ ṇa pekkhāmi| 
(vicintya ā ekamodaaparitosido ṇa dāva olaggo me aṇusaradi| uccadāe pāārassa agaī kukkurāṇaṃ| avakhadabattadāe 
alohaṇīaṃ pahiāṇaṃ| ādu api ṇaṃ khāāmi| bhodu oggāraissaṃ dāva ahaṃ| hī hī buḍḍho via sūaravatthī suddhavādaṃ evva uggirāmi
| ahava lohidakaccāaṇīe keraaṃ mama keraaṃ tti karia siveṇa paḍihatthīkidaṃ bhave|
 (nirūpya) jadi vi eso bamhaārī bahukehi rūvehi aviṇaaṃ karedi| bhodupekkhissaṃ dāva ahaṃ| bho! edaṃ khu mama modaamallaaṃ siva
ssa pādamūle ciṭṭai| jāva ṇaṃ gaṇhāmi| dehi bhaṭṭā! dehi me modaamallaaṃ| bhaṭṭā! tuvaṃ vi mama coro si| 
avihā ālihidaṃ khu mama modaamallaaṃ | bhaṭṭā! tuvaṃ vi mama coro si| avihā ālihidaṃ khu mama modaamallaaṃ| bhaṭṭa!
 taduvaṃ vi mama coro si| avihā ālihidaṃ khu mama modaamallaaṃ saṃdāvatimireṇa suṭṭhu ṇa pekkhāmi| bhodu pamajijassaṃ dāva
 ahaṃ| hī hī sāhu le cittaara! bhāva! sāhu| juttalehadāe vaṇṇāṇaṃ jaha jaha pamajjāmi, taha taha ujjaladaraṃ hoi| bhodu,
 udaeṇa pamajjissaṃ| kahiṃ ṇu hu udaaṃ| idaṃ sohaṇaṃ suddhataḍāaṃ| ahaṃ via sivo vi dāva edassiṃ modaamallae ṇirāso hodu|bho

  bho! < deva-< kula-pīṭhikāyāṃ>_T6->_T6 mama <modaka-mallakaṃ>_K1 nikṣipya < dakṣiṇā-māṣakān>_K1  gaṇiyitvā baddhvā < prati-< ni-vṛttaḥ>_S->_Tp idānīṃ <modaka-mallakaṃ>_K1  na prekṣe| ā < < eka-modaka>_K1-< pari-toṣitaḥ>_Tp->_T3 na tāvat+<ava-lagnaḥ>_Tp mām+anusarati| uccatayā prākārasya+< a-gatiḥ>_Tn kukkurāṇām|
 < < a-kṣata>_Tn-bhaktatayā>_K1 +lobhanīyaṃ pathikānām| athavā api+enaṃ khādāmi| bhavatu udgariṣyāmi tāvat+aham| hī hī vṛddhaḥ+ iva < sūkara3-bastiḥ>_T6 
< śuddha-vātam>_K1 + iva udgirāmi| athavā < lohita-kātyāyanyāḥ>_K1 mām+iti kṛtvā śivena < prati-hastīkṛtaṃ>_A1 bhavet| yadi+api+eṣaḥ
 brahmacārī bahukaiḥ+ rūpaiḥ+< a-< vi-nayaṃ>_S->_Tn karoti| bhavatu prekṣiṣye tāvat+aham| bho! eṣaḥ khalu mama <modaka-mallakaḥ>_K1  śivasya < pada2-mūle>_T6 tiṣṭhati| yāvat+enaṃ gṛhṇāmi| dehi bhartaḥ! dehi me <modaka-mallakam>_K1| bhartaḥ! tvam+api mama coraḥ+asi| < < a-vidyā>_Tn < ā-likhitaṃ>_A1->_T6 khalu mama <modaka-mallakaṃ>_K1 < < saṃ-tāpa>_Tg -timireṇa>_K1 suṣṭhu na prekṣe| bhavatu pramārjiṣyāmi tāvat+aham| hī hī sādhu re citrakara !
 bhāva! sādhu| < yukta-lekhatayā>_K1 varṇānāṃ yathā pramārjmi, tathā tathā+< ujvalataraṃ bhavati| bhavatu, udakena pramārjiṣyāmi| kutra  nu khalu+udakam| idaṃ śobhanaṃ < śuddha-taṭākam>_K1 | aham+iva śivaḥ+api tāvat+etasmin <modaka-mallake>_K1 < niḥ-āśaḥ>_Bs6+ bhavatu|]

utmattakaḥ---kiṃ modaā| kahiṃ modaā| kaśśa modaā| kiṃ ime modaā ujjhanti, ādu piṇajjhanti,
 udāho khajjanti| [kiṃ modakāḥ| kutra modakāḥ| kasya modakāḥ| kim+ime modakāḥ ujjhyante, athavā pinahyante,  uta+aho khādyante|]
vidūṣakaḥ---ṇa khajjanti ṇa khajjanti ṇa ujjhanti a| [na khādyante na khādyante na+ujjhyante ca|]

[eṣā khalu mama rasanā < khāditu-kāmā>_Bs6 liṅgāni karoti|]

khādyante+ iti+<an-<apsaras3-saṃvāsaḥ>_T6>_Tn+ <uttarakuru-vāsaḥ>_T7+ mayā+anu-bhūyate| ekaḥ khalu mahān doṣaḥ| mama+āhāraḥ suṣṭhu na pari-ṇamati| supracchadanāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ nidrāṃ na labhe| yathā vātaśoṇitam+abhitaḥ+iva vartate+ iti prekṣe| bhoḥ! sukhaṃ na<āmaya-paribhūtam>_T3+<a-<kalya-vartaṃ>_T6>_Tn ca|]

atha caturthaḥ+aṅkaḥ
(tataḥ praviśati <sa-parivārā>_BvS padmāvatī, <<āvantikā-veṣa>_T6-dhāriṇī>_U vāsavadattā ca)

(ubhe upa-viśataḥ)

vṛddhagopālakaḥ---@bho meghadiṇṇa! kkhu, vaṣabhadiṇṇa! kkhu, kumbhadiṇṇa! kkhu, ghoṣadiṇṇa! vakhu, pakāletha pakāletha godhaṇaṃ| edaṣṣi vuṃdāvaṇe pakāmaṃ pāṇīa pādūṇaṃ hubhāravaṃ karanto āantu godhaṇaṃ| eṣo govajjahādo ṇikkamia parighaṭṭiavammīamūlo bhujaṅgehi kuvaṇṇohiṃ ṇīluppaladāmehi ṣiṃgalaggehi via vaṣabo ṣobadi| aṇṇovi eṣo vaṣabho uṭṭhidappaṣāriapucco ṇikuṃciajāṇū ṣaṣīva dhavalaṅgo aggaviṣāṇehi mahīṃ uvvahanto vivaṣobadi| jāva dāṇi dāmaaṃ ṣaddāvaāmi| ale dāmaa! baavadīṇaṃ ṣuthale odālia ṣahavacchāṇaṃ tuvaṃ pi āaccha|@ [bhoḥ meghadatta! khalu, vṛṣabhadatta! khalu, kumbhadatta! khalu ghoṣadatta! khalu, prakālayata prakālayata <go-dhanam>K6| etasmin vṛndāvane prakāmam pānīyam pītvā <humbhā-ravam>K1 kurvat āyātu <go-dhanam>K6| eṣaḥ <go-vrajān‌>T6 niṣkramya <parighaṭṭita-<valmīka-mūlaḥ>T6>K1 bhujaṅgaiḥ kuvarṇaiḥ <<nīla-utpala>K1-dāmabhiḥ>T6 <śṛṅga{2}-lagnaiḥ>T3 iva vṛṣabhaḥ śobhate| anyaḥ api eṣaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ <utthita-prasārita-pucchaḥ>Bb <nikuñcita{2}-jānuḥ>Bs6 śaśī iva <dhavala-aṅgaḥ>Bs6 <agra-viṣāṇābhyām>T1 mahīm udvahan iva śobhate| yāvat idānīm dāmakam śabdayāmi| are dāmaka! bhagavatīḥ susthale avatārya <saha-vatsāḥ>BvS tvam api āgaccha|]

(tataḥ praviśati dāmakaḥ|)
dāmakaḥ---@aho mahantaṃ tiṇajālaṃ ṣāmiṇo ṇandagovaṣṣa| ṣudajaṇaṇadiṇādo ālahia ahiadalaṃ āṇaṃdābbhūdaṃ vaḍḍhai| bhodu iha ciṭṭhadu godhaṇata, jāva mādulaṃ uvaṣappiṣṣaṃ (upasṛtya) mādula! vandāmi!@ [aho mahat <tṛṇa{3}-jālam>T6 svāminaḥ nandagopasya| <<suta-janana>T6-dināt>T6 ārabhya adhikataram <ānanda-adbhutam>K3 vardhate| bhavatu, iha tiṣṭhatu <go-dhanam>K6, yāvat mātulam upasarpsyāmi| mātula! vande|]
vṛddhagopālakaḥ---@ṣantī hodu pantī hodu amhāṇa godhaṇaṣṣa a|@ [śāntiḥ bhavatu śāntiḥ bhavatu āsmākam <go-dhanasya>K6 ca|]
dāmakaḥ---@mādula! jadappahudi nandagovaputte paṣūde, tadappahudi amhāṇaṃ godhaṇaṃ vajjiaroaṃ ṣaṃvuttaṃ| ṇaṃ ṣavvāṇaṃ govajaṇāṇaṃ pīdī vaḍḍhai| aṇṇaṃ ca, khāde khāde mūlāṇi, phalāṇi gumhe gumhe| madhu kettiaṃ duddhadhadi khīraṃ tattaaṃ evva ghidaṃ|@ [mātula! yadā prabhṛti <nandagopa-putraḥ>T6 prasūtaḥ tadā prabhṛti asmākam <go-dhanam>K6 <varjita-rogam>Bs6 saṃvṛttam| nanu sarveṣām <gopa-janānām>T6 prītirvardhate, anyat ca, khāte khāte mūlāni, phalāni gulme gulme| madhu kiyat duhyate kṣīram tāvat eva ghṛtam|]
vṛddhagopālakaḥ---@aṇṇaṃ ca idaṃ acchaliaṃ| daṣarattappaṣūde ṇaṃdagovavutte pūtaṇā ṇāma dāṇavī viṣaṣampūridatthaṇā ṇaṃdagovīe ruvaṃ gaṇhia āādā| tade tāe dālaaṃ gaṇhia taṣṣa muhe thaṇaṃ pakkhittaṃ| tado taṃ vijāṇia puvidā pāḍidā cammavaṣeṣā dāṇavī bhavia tatto evva mudā| tado māṣamatte ṇaṃdagovavutte ṣaaḍo ṇāma dāṇavo ṣaaḍaveṣaṃ gaṇhia āado| taṃ pi jāpia ekapādappahāreṇa cuṇṇīkido ṣo vi dāṇavo bhavia tatto evva mudo| tado māṣaparivutte naṃdagovavutte ekaṣṣiṃ gehe gacchia khīraṃ pibai, aṇṇaṣṣiṃ gehe gacchia dadhiṃ bhakkhai, ekaṣṣiṃ gehe gacchia ṇavaṇīdaṃ giladi, aṇṇaṣṣiṃ gehe gacchia pāasaṃ bhujjai, aparaṣṣi gehe gacchia takkaghaṭaṃ paloadi| tado luṭṭhāhi govajuvadīhi ṇandagovīe uttaṃ| dato luṭṭhāe ṇandagovīe dāmaṃ gaṇhia taṣṣa majjhe vandhia ṣeṣaṃ ulūhale bajjhaṃ| tado taṃ pi ulūhalaṃ āghaṭṭaantaṃ pekkhia jamalajjuṇe ṇāma dāṇave ṇikkhitta| tado duve ekkobhūde| teṣaṃ antaleṇa gacchanteṇa ṇandagovavutteṇa āghaṭṭaanteṇa ṣamūlaviḍavaṃ cuṇṇīkide te vi dāṇave bhavia tatto evvamude| tado govajaṇehi uttaṃ--mahābalapalakkamī ajjappahudi bhaṭṭidāmodalo ṇāma hodu tti| tado āhāvaṇappahāvaṇamatte ṇaṃdagovavutte palaṃbo ṇāma dāṇavo ṇaṃdagovavelasaṃ gaṇhia āado| tado ṣaṃkaliṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhe ṇikkhivia gacchantaṃ taṃ vijāṇia bhaṭṭiṇā ṣaṅkaliṣaṇeṇa taṣṣa dāṇavaṣṣa ṣīṣe muṭṭhippahāro kidā| teṇa ppahāreṇa ukkhittacakkhu ṣo vi dāṇavo bhavia tatto evva mudo| govalajaṇehi parivado tālahalāṇi gaṇhiduṃ tālavaṇaṃ gado| tahiṃ tālavaṇe dheṇuo ṇāma dāṇavo gaddabhavesaṃ gaṇihaa āado| tado taṃ pi jāṇia bhaṭṭidāmodaleṇa taṣṣa vāmapādaṃ gaṇihaa ukkhivia pādidāṇi tālaphalāṇi| ṣo vi dāṇavo bhavia tatto evva mudo| tado kesī ṇāma dāṇavo tulaṃgavesaṃ gaṇhia āado| tadā taṃ pi jāṇia bhaṭṭidāmodaleṇa taṣṣa muhe kopparo diṇṇo| tado teṣa duvī pāḍido tulaṃgo| ṣo vi dāṇavo bhavia tatto eva mudo| edāṇi aṇṇāṇi kammāṇi kidāṇi bhaṭṭidāmodaleṇa|@
jayasree




[anyat ca idam āścaryam| daśarātraprasūte? <nandagopa-putre>T6 pūtanā nāma dānavī <<viṣa-sampūrita>T3-stanā>Bs6 nandagopyāḥ rūpam gṛhītvā āgatā| tataḥ tayā dārakam gṛhītvā tasya mukhe stanaḥ <<eka-pāda>K1-prahāreṇa>T6 <cūrṇa-i^kṛtaḥ>Tp saḥ api dānavaḥ bhūtvā tataḥ eva mṛtaḥ| tataḥ <māsa-parivṛttaḥ>T3 <nandagopa-putraḥ>T6 ekasmin gehe gatvā kṣīram pibati anyasmin gehe gatvā dadhi tayoḥ antareṇa gacchatā <nandagopa-putreṇa>T6 aghaṭṭayatā <<sa-mūla>BvS-viṭapam>K1 <cūrṇa-i^kṛtau>Tp| tau api dānavau bhūtvā tataḥ eva mṛtau| tataḥ <gopa{3}-janaiḥ>T6 uktam- <mahat-<bala-parākramaḥ>Di>Bs6 adyaprabhṛtiḥ <bhartṛ-dāmodaraḥ>K1 nāma bhavatu iti| tataḥ <<ādhāvana-pradhāvana>Di-mātre>Tm <nandagopa-putre>T6 pralambaḥ nāma dānavaḥ <nandagopa-veṣam>T6 gṛhitvā eva mṛtaḥ| <gopa{3}-janaiḥ>T6 parivṛtaḥ <tāla-phalāni>K1 grahītum <tāla-vanam>K1 gataḥ| tatra <tāla-vane>K1 dhenukaḥ nāma dānavaḥ <gardabha-veṣam>T6 gṛhītvā āgataḥ| tataḥ tam api jñātvā <bhartṛ-dāmodareṇa>K1 tasya <vāma-pādam>K1 gṛhītvā utkṣipya pātitāni <tāla-phalāni>K1| saḥ api dānavaḥ bhūtvā tataḥ eva mṛtaḥ| tataḥ keśī nāma dānavaḥ <turaṅga-veṣam>T6 gṛhītvā āgataḥ| tataḥ tam api dāmakaḥ---@mādula! ṣavvaṃ dāva ciṭṭhadu| ajja bhaṭṭidāmodalo imaṣṣiṃ vuṃdāvane govakaṇṇa āhi ṣaha hallīṣaaṃ ṇāma pakīlidu āacchadi|@ [mātula! sarvam tāvat tiṣṭhatu| adya <bhartṛ-dāmodaraḥ>K1 asmin vṛndāvane <gopa-kanyakābhiḥ>K1 saha hallīsakam nāma prakrīḍitum āgacchati|]
vṛddhagopālakaḥ---@teṇa hi savvehi govajaṇehi ṣaha bhaṭṭidāmodalaṣṣa hallīṣaaṃ pekkhamha|@ [tena hi sarvaiḥ <gopa{3}-janaiḥ>T6 saha <bhartṛ-dāmodarasya>K1 hallīsakam prekṣāmahe]
dāmakaḥ---@jaṃ mādulo āṇavedi|@ [yat mātulaḥ ājñāpayati|]
(niṣkrāntau|)

(tataḥ praviśati vidūṣakaḥ)
vidūṣakaḥ---@bho! ṇa jāṇaṃti avatthavisesaṃ issaraputtā ṇāma| ado tattabhavaṃ avimārao isisāveṇa kulaparibbhaṃsaṃ aṃtaakulappavāsaṃ attaṇo viṇṇāṇaṃ gurujaṇaṃ ca acintaanto jadā hatthisaṃbhamadiase kuntibhoaduhiā kuraṅgīdiṭṭhā, tadappahudi aṇṇādiso via saṃvuto| hī hī kiṃ bahūṇā, mae vi saha goṭṭhiṃ ṇecchadi, savvaālaṃ cintaaṃto ahiramadi| sacco khu loappavādo`saṃghaāriṇo aṇattha' tti| ko ettha sambandho| sā rāadāriā, saaṃ aṃtaja tti| ahaṃ pi dāva bamhaṇaparivādaṃ parihāraṃto bamhaṇakulesu paribbhamia pacchaṇṇo tattahodo āvasaṃ evva gacchāmi|@ [bhoḥ! na jānanti <avasthā-viśeṣam>T6 <īśvara-putrāḥ>T6 nāma| ataḥ tatrabhavān avimārakaḥ <ṛṣi-śāpena>T6 <kula-paribhraṃśam>T5 <<<antya-ja>U-kula>T6-pravāsam>T7 ātmanaḥ

mayā api saha goṣṭhīm na icchati, <sarva-kālam>K1 cintayan abhiramate| satyaḥ khalu <loka-pravādaḥ>T6 `<saṅgha-cāriṇaḥ>U <na-arthāḥ>Bsmn' iti| kaḥ atra sambandhaḥ| sā <rājan-dārikā>T6, svayam <antya-jaḥ>U iti| aham api tāvat <brāhmaṇa-parivādam>T6 pariharan <brāhmaṇa-kuleṣu>T6 paribhramya pracchannaḥ tatrabhavataḥ āvāsam eva gacchāmi| ]

nalinikā---(<sa-śokam>BvS) @sacco khu loappavādo--bahuvigdhāṇi suhāṇi tti| eso khu saṃvaccharo adikkando bhaṭṭidāriāe avicchiṇṇasuhasamboeṇa radiṃ karia| amhāaṃ puṇa goṭṭhījaṇassa uttarakuruvāso saṃvutto ajja uṇa mahārāeṇa vivido eso khu vuttanto tti suṇia sīdadi via sarīraṃ| bhaṭṭidāriā ca lajjābhaamaaṇehi abhitāliamāṇā sandāveṇa muddhā avaadacedaṇā via saṃvuttā| eso khu pāsādo ṇivvāvidadīvo via me paḍibhādi| teṇa bhaṭṭhidāraeṇa virahidāe mama ekkaṃ pi hiaappīdikaraṃ ṇa jādaṃ| bhaṭṭidārao aviggheṇa ṇiggado tti suṇia ajja palhādadaṃ via me hiaaṃ| sampadi suruddhaṃ kaṇṇāuraṃ| (parikramya) ammo sahīo| halā māadhie! kiṃ edaṃ|@ [satyaḥ khalu <loka{3}-pravādaḥ>T6--- <bahu-vighnāni>Bs6 sukhāni iti| eṣaḥ khalu saṃvatsaraḥ atikrāntaḥ bhartṛdārikāyāḥ <<na-vicchinna>Tn-<sukha-sambhogena>T6>K1 ratim kṛtvā| asmākam punaḥ <goṣṭhī-janasya>T6 <<uttara-kuru>K1-vāsaḥ>T7 saṃvṛttaḥ| adya punaḥ <mahat-rājena>K1 viditaḥ eṣaḥ khalu vṛttāntaḥ iti śrutvā sīdati iva śarīram| bhartṛdārikā ca <lajjā-bhaya-madanaiḥ>Di abhitāḍyamānā santāpena mugdhā <apagata-cetanā>Bs5 iva saṃvṛttā| eṣaḥ khalu prāsādaḥ <nirvāpita-dīpaḥ>Bs7 iva me pratibhāti| tena bhartṛdārakeṇa virahitāyāḥ mama ekam api <hṛdaya-prītikaram>T6 na jātam| bhartṛdārakaḥ <na-vighnena>Tn nirgataḥ iti śrutvā adya prahlāditam iva me hṛdayam| samprati <su-ruddham>Tp kanyāpuram| ammo ammo sakhyau| halā māgadhike! kim etat|]
māgadhikā---@halā! kiṃ pucchasi| ṇaṃ maṇḍaṇavelā bhaṭṭidāriāe|@ [halā! kim pṛcchasi| nanu <maṇḍana-velā>T6 bhartṛdārikāyāḥ|]

ubhe---ham|
nalinikā---@ahamapi bhaṭṭidāriāe dukkhaṃ pekkhiduṃ asahantī iha āadamhi|@ [aham api bhartṛdārikāyāḥ duḥkham prekṣitum <na-sahamānā>Tn iha āgatā asmi|]
māgadhikā---@ṇa sakkaṃ khu bhaṭṭidāriāe avatthādaṃsaṇaṃ| taha vi bhaṭṭidāri aṃ assasaissāmo|@ [na śakyam khalu bhartṛdārikāyāḥ <avasthā-darśanam>T6| tathā api bhartṛdārikām āśvāsayiṣyāmaḥ|]

gaṇikā---@uvavisadu! ayyo|@ [upaviśatu āryaḥ|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---(<sva-gatam>T7) @puāviseseṇa jāṇāmi kyyaṃ ti|@ (upaviśati|) [<pūjā-viśeṣeṇa>T6 jānāmi kāryam iti|]
gaṇikā---@hañje! evaṃ via|@ [hañje! evam iva|]
ceṭī---@ajjue! taha| ayya! rāamagge vissatthasampādaṃ ayyaṃ kāduṃ icchadi ajjuā| kassa kiṃ kattabba|@ [ajjuke! tathā| ārya! <<rājan{3}-mārge>T6-viśvasta-sampātam>Bb āryam kartum icchati ajjukā| kasya kim kartavyam|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@suṇādu ayyā|@ [śṛṇotu āryā|]
gaṇikā---@avahidamhi|@ [avahitā asmi|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@pāḍaliputtaṃ me jammabhūmī| pakidīe vaṇijao ahaṃ| tado bhāadheaparivutadāe dasāe saṃvāhaavutiṃ uvajīvāmi|@ [pāṭaliputram me janmabhūmiḥ| prakṛtyā vaṇik aham| tataḥ <bhāgadheya-parivṛttatayā>T6 daśayā <saṃvāhaka-vuttim>T6 upajīvāmi|]
gaṇikā---@saṃvāhao ayyo| suumārā kalā sikkhidā ayyeṇa|@ [saṃvāhakaḥ āryaḥ| sukumārā kalā śikṣitā āryeṇa|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@kaletti sikkhidā| ājīviaṃ dāṇi saṃvuttam|@ [kalā iti śikṣitā| <ā-jīvitam>A1 idānīm saṃvṛttam|]
gaṇikā---@ṇivvedasūaaṃ via vaaṇaṃ ayyassa| tado tado|@ [<nirveda-sūcakam>T6 iva vacanam āryasya| <tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@ajjue! so dāṇi ahaṃ āanatuāṇaṃ suṇia purusavisesakodūhaleṇa āado mhi imaṃ ujjaaṇiṃ|@ [ajjuke! saḥ idānīm aham āgantukānām śrutvā <<puruṣa-viśeṣa>K1-kautūhalena>T7 āgataḥ asmi imām ujjayanīm|]
gaṇikā---@tado dato|@ [<tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@tado iha āadamatta evva kocci satthavāhaputto samāsādido|@ [tataḥ iha āgatamātraḥ eva kaścit <sārthavāha-putraḥ>T6 samāsāditaḥ|]
gaṇikā---@keriso|@ [<kī-dṛśaḥ>U|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@āidimanto avibbhamanto aṇucchitto lalido lalidadāe avimhao cauro mahuro dakkho sadakkhiñño abimado āido tuṭṭho hodi| dayya ṇa vikatthedi| appaṃ vi sumaradi, bahuaṃ pi avaidaṃ visumaradi| añjue! kiṃ vahuṇā, tassa kulavuttassa guṇāṇaṃ caubbhāaṃ pi sudiggheṇa vi gimhadiaheṇa vaṇṇiduṃ ṇa sakkaṃ| kiṃ bahuṇā, dakkhiññadāe parakeraaṃ via attaṇo sarīraṃ dhāredi|@ [ākṛtimān <na-vibhraman>Tn <na-utsiktaḥ>Tn lalitaḥ lalitatayā vismayaḥ caturaḥ madhuraḥ dakṣaḥ <sa-dākṣiṇyaḥ>BvS abhimataḥ ācitaḥ tuṣṭaḥ bhavati| dattvā na vikatthayati| alpam api smarati, bahukam api apakṛtam vismarati| ajjuke! kim bahunā, tasya <kula-putrasya>Km guṇānām <catur-bhāgam>K1 api <su-dīrgheṇa>K1 api <grīṣma-divasena>T6 varṇayitum na śakyam| kim bahunā, dākṣiṇyatayā parakīyam iva ātmanaḥ śarīram dhārayati|]
gaṇikā---(apavārya) @hañje! ko ṇu khu so ayyacārudattassa guṇāṇaṃ aṇukaredi|@ [hañje! kaḥ nu khalu saḥ <ārya-cārudattasya>K1 guṇān anukaroti|]
ceṭī---@mama vi kodūhalaṃ soduṃ| ko ṇuhu ujjaaṇiṃ attaṇo guṇehi maṇḍedi|@ [mama 
api kautūhalam śrotum| kaḥ nu khalu ujjayanīm ātmanaḥ guṇaiḥ maṇḍayati|]
gaṇikā---@tado tado|@ [<tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@tado tassa guṇavikkiṇidasarīro vissaridakalatto uvajīvio saṃvutto|@ [tataḥtasya <<guṇa-vikrīta>T3-śarīraḥ>Bs6 <vismṛta-kalatraḥ>Bs3 upajīvikaḥ saṃvṛtta|]
gaṇikā---@kiṃ so dariddo|@ [kim saḥ daridraḥ|]
saṃvāhaka---@kahaṃ aṇācikkhide ayyā jāṇādi|@ [katham <na-ākhyātaḥ>Tn āryā jānāti|]
gaṇikā---@eassiṃ dullaho guṇavibhavo tti| tado tado|@ [ekasmin durlabhaḥ <guṇa-vibhavaḥ>T6 iti| <tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
ceṭī---@ko ṇāma so ayyo|@ [kaḥ nāma saḥ āryaḥ|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@ayyacārudatto ṇāma|@ [<ārya-cārudattaḥ>K1 nāma|]
gaṇikā---@jujjai| tado tado|@ [yujyate| <tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@tado so vibhavamandadāe assāhiṇaparijaṇo visajjiakuḍumbabharaṇo cārittamattāvaseso satthavāhakule paḍivasadi| ahaṃ pi teṇa ayyeṇa abbhaṇuññādo---aṇṇaṃ uvaciṭṭhadu tti| kahaṃ aṇṇaṃ erisaṃ maṇussaraaṇaṃ labheaṃ ti kahaṃ ca tassa komalalalidamahurasarīpparisakidatthaṃ me hatthaṃ sāhāraṇasarīrasammaddeṇa soaṇīaṃ karissaṃ ti jādaṇivvedo daddhasarīrarakkhaṇatthaṃ jūdovajīvī saṃvutto|@ [tataḥ saḥ <vibhava-mandatayā>T6 <svādhīna-parijanaḥ>Bs6 <visarjita-<kuṭumba-bharaṇaḥ>T6>Bs3 <cāritra^mātra-avaśeṣaḥ>Bs6 <sārthavāha-kule>T6 prativasati| aham api tena āryeṇa abhyanujñātaḥ anyam upatiṣṭhatām iti| katham anyam <ī-dṛśam>U <manuṣya-ratnam>T7 labheya iti, katham ca tasya <<<komala-<lalita-<madhura-śarīra>K1>K1>K1-sparśa>T6-<kṛta-artham>Bs3>T3 me hastam <<sādhāraṇa-śarīra>K1-sammardena>T6 śocanīyam kariṣyāmi iti <jāta-nirvedaḥ>Bs6 <<dagdha-śarīra>K1-<rakṣaṇa-artham>T4>T6 <dyūta-upajīvī>U saṃvṛttaḥ|]
(gaṇikā <sa-<harṣa-bāṣpam>Di>BvS ceṭīm avalokayati|)
ceṭī---@tado tado|@ [<tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@tado bahūṇi diṇāṇi mae parāideṇa puruseṇa kadāī ahaṃ pi dahasu suvaṇṇesu parāido mhi|@ [tataḥ bahūni dināni mayā parājitena puruṣeṇa kadācit aham api daśasu suvarṇeṣu parājitaḥ asmi|]
gaṇikā---@tado tado|@ [<tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@tado ajja veśamagge jaicchovaṇado samāsadido mhi| tassa bhaeṇa iha paviṭṭho| evaṃ ayyā jāṇādu|@ [tataḥ adya <veśa-mārge>T6 yadṛcchopanataḥ samāsāditaḥ asmi| tasmāt bhayena iha praviṣṭaḥ| evam āryā jānātu|]
gaṇikā---(<ātman-gatam>T7) @aho accāhidaṃ| evaṃ khu maṇṇe vāsapapādapaviṇāseṇa pakkhiṇo āhiṇḍanti tti (prakāśam) evaṃ gade attakerao ayyo| halā! ehaṃ taṃ jaṇaṃ visajjehi|@ [aho <ati-āhitam>Tp| evam khalu manye <<vāsa-pādapa>T6-vināśena>T6 pakṣiṇaḥ āhiṇḍante iti| evam gataḥ ātmīyaḥ āryaḥ| halā! ehi tam janam visarjaya|]
ceṭī---@taha|@ (niṣkrāntā|) [tathā|]
gaṇikā---@ṇa śu ayyeṇa atthaṇimittā cintā kādavvā| ayyacārudatto eva dedi ttiayyo jāṇādu|@ [na khalu āryeṇa <artha-nimittā>T6 cintā kartavyā| <ārya-cārudattaḥ>K1 eva dadāti iti āryaḥ jānātu|]
ceṭī---(praviśya) @ajjue! visajjido so jaṇo, parituṭṭho gado a|@ [ajjuke! visarjitaḥ saḥ janaḥ, parituṣṭaḥ gataḥ ca|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@aṇuggahido mhi|@ [anugṛhītaḥ asmi|]
gaṇikā---@gacchadu ayyo suhijjaṇadaṃsaṇeṇa pīdi ṇivvattedajuṃ|@ [gacchatu āryaḥ <<suhṛt-jana>K1-darśanena>T6 prītim nirvartayitum|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@ajja eva kadāi ṇivvedeṇa pavvajeaṃ| jai iaṃ pariaṇe saṅkantā kalā bhave, tado ayyāe aṇuggahido bhaveaṃ|@ [adya eva kadācit nirvedena pravrajeyam| yadi iyam parijane saṃkrāntā kalā bhavet, tataḥ āryayā anugṛhītaḥ bhaveyam|]
gaṇikā---@jassa kide iaṃ kalā sikkhidā, so evva ayyeṇa uvaciṭṭhidavvo bavissadi|@ [yasya kṛte iyam kalā śikṣitā, saḥ eva āryeṇa upasthātavyaḥ bhaviṣyati|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---(<sva-gatam>T7) @ṇiuṇaṃ khu paccācakkhido mhi| ko hi ṇām appaṇā kidaṃ paccuaāreṇa viṇāsedi| (prakāśam) ayye! gacchāmi dāva ahaṃ|@ [nipuṇam khalu pratyākhyātaḥ asmi| kaḥ hi nāma ātmanā kṛtam pratyupakāreṇa vināśayati| ārye! gacchāmi tāvat aham|]
gaṇikā---@gacchadu ayyo puṇo daṃsaṇāa|@ [gacchatu āryaḥ punaḥ darśanāya|]
saṃvāhakaḥ---@ayyo! taha|@ (niṣkrāntaḥ) [ārye! tathā|]
gaṇikā---@haṃ, saddo via|@ [ham śabdaḥ iva|]
(praviśya)
ceṭaḥ---@vicchittie! vicchittie! kahi kahiṃ ajjuā|@ [vicchittike! vicchittike! <kutra-kutra>d ajjukā|]
gaṇikā---@haṃje! kiṃ edaṃ|@ [hañje! kim etat|]
ceṭaḥ---@h, vippaladdho mhi, vādāaṇaṇaikkhāmidapuvvakāāe oṇamiapaoharāe kaṇṇaūrassa paripphando ajjuāe jeṇa ṇa diṭṭho|@ [ham, vipralabdhaḥ asmi, <<vātāyana-niṣkrāmita>T3-<pūrva-kāyayā>T1>Bs3 <avanamita{2}-payodharayā>Bs6 karṇapūrasya parispandaḥ ajjukayā yena na dṛṣṭaḥ|]
gaṇikā---@lahujaṇassa sulaho vimhao| kiṃ de usseassa kāraṇam|@ [<laghu-janasya>K1 sulabhaḥ vismayaḥ| kim te utsekasya kāraṇam|]
ceṭaḥ---@suṇādu ajjuā| eso uggavegeṇa ogāhaṇaṇivvattideṇa passudamadagandhaṃ rāamaggaṃ karanteṇa maṅgalahatthiṇa bhaddakavodaeṇa aṇeapurusasaṅkalesu rāamaggesu uttariapaḍavirāadāe ahialakkhaṇīo kocci pavvaido samāsādido|@ [śṛṇotu ajjukā eṣaḥ <ugra-vegena>K1 <avagāhana-nivartitena>T5 <prasruta-<mada-gandham>T6>Bs7 <rājan-mārgam>T6 kurvatā <maṅgala-hastinā>K1 bhadrakapotakena <<aneka-puruṣa>K1{3}-saṅkuleṣu>T6 <rājan-mārgeṣu>K1 <<uttarīya-paṭa>T6-virāgatayā>T6 <adhika-lakṣaṇīyaḥ>K1 kaścit pravrajitaḥ samāsāditaḥ|]
gaṇikā---@haṃ, tado tado|@ [ham, <tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
ceṭaḥ---@tado mae hatthihatthāmaddatāḍiamāṇo dantantaraparivattamāṇo hatthihatthapaḍidacaraṇo tadajo hā hā vipāḍido hā hā hadotti jaṇavāde saṃvutte tado diṇṇakarappahāreṇa parivattidaṃ hatthiṃ karia moido so parivvāo|@ [tataḥ mayā <<<hasti-hasta>T6-amarda>T3-tāḍyamānaḥ>T3 <<danta{2}-antara>T6-parivartamānaḥ>T7 <<hasti-hasta>T6-patita-caraṇaḥ>Bb tataḥ hā hā vipāṭitaḥ hā hā hataḥ iti janavāde saṃvṛtte tataḥ <datta-<kara-prahāreṇa>T3>K1 parivartitam hastinam kṛtvā mocitaḥ saḥ parivrāṭ|]
gaṇikā---@piaṃ me| tado tado|@ [priyam me| <tataḥ-tataḥ>d|]
ceṭaḥ---@tado savvo jaṇao bhaṇādi--aho ceḍassa kamma tti| ṇa uṇa kocci kiṃ pi icchai dāuṃ| tado ajjue! keṇa vi kulavutteṇa uidāṇi ābharaṇaṭṭhāṇāṇi viloia aṅguṭṭheṇāṇia vi uṇa aladvaṃ pekkhia devvaṃ uvālabhia digghaṃ ṇissasia ettao me vibhavo tti karia parijaṇahatthe aaṃ pāvarao pesido|@ [tataḥ sarvaḥ janaḥ bhaṇati---aho ceṭasya karma iti| na punaḥ kaścit kim api icchati dātum| tataḥ ajjuke! kena api <kula-putreṇa>Km ucitāni <ābharaṇa{3}-sthānāni>T6 vilokya aṅguṣṭhena ānīya api punaḥ <na-labdham prekṣya daivam upālabhya dīrgham niḥśvasya etāvān me vibhavaḥ iti kṛtvā <parijana-haste>T6 ayam prāvārakaḥ preṣitaḥ|]
gaṇikā---(ceṭīm avalokya) @ko ṇu khu ayyacārudattassa guṇāṇi aṇukaredi|@ [kaḥ nu khalu <ārya-cārudattasya>K1 guṇān anukaroti|]
ceṭī---@ajjue! mama vi kodūhalaṃ atthi| ko ṇu khu eso|@ [ajjuke! mama api kautūhalam asti| kaḥ nu khalu eṣaḥ|]
gaṇikā---@keṇa vi sāhuṇā puruseṇa hodavvaṃ|@ [kena api sādhunā puruṣeṇa bhavitavyam|]
ceṭī---@sāhu pucchīadu dāva|@ [sādhuḥ pṛcchyatām tāvat|]
gaṇikā---@hañje ekapurusapakkhavādidā savvaguṇāṇi hanti|@ [hañje! <<eka-puruṣa>K1-pakṣapātitā>T7 <sarva{3}-guṇān>K1 hanti|]
ceṭī---@bhadda! se ṇāma tuvaṃ jāṇāsi|@ [bhadra! asya nāma tvam jānāsi|]
ceṭaḥ---@ṇa hu jāṇāmi|@ [na khalu jānāmi|]
gaṇikā---@adilahu tue kidaṃ|@ [<ati-laghu>K1 tvayā kṛtam|]
ceṭī---@jai evaṃ, iha tue ko tti mantidaṃ|@ [yadi evam, iha tvayā kaḥ iti mantritam|]
ceṭaḥ---@ahaṃ ettaaṃ tu jāṇāmi---bhaddao avimhao tti|@ [aham etāvat tu jānāmi bhadrakaḥ <a-vismayaḥ>Bsmn iti|]

gaṇikā---(prāsādāt vilokya)@haṃje! eso hi so ayyacārudatto evva jaṇṇovavīdamattapāvārao gacchai| tā jāva dūraṃ gao ṇa bhavissadi eso, pekkhamha dāva ṇaṃ|@ [hañje! eṣaḥ hi saḥ <ārya-cārudattaḥ>K1 eva <yajñopavīta^mātra-prāvārakaḥ>Bs6 gacchati| tat yāvat dūram gataḥ na bhaviṣyati eṣaḥ, prekṣāmahe tāvat enam]
(niṣkrāntāḥ sarve|)

|| atha tṛtīyaḥ aṅkaḥ ||
(tataḥ praviśati nāyakaḥ vidūṣakaḥ ca|)
nāyakaḥ---vayasya! vīṇā nāma <<na-samudra>Tn-utthitam>T5 ratnam| kutaḥ,
utkaṇṭhitasya <hṛdaya-anugatā>T2 sakhi iva 
<<saṅkīrṇa-doṣa>K1-rahitā>T3 viṣayeṣu goṣṭhī|
<krīḍā-raseṣu>K1 <madana-vyasaneṣu>K1 kāntā 
strīṇām tu <<kānta-rati>T3-vighnakarī>T6 <sa-patnī>Bs6 || 1 ||
vidūṣakaḥ---@bho vayassa! ko kālo kidaparighosaṇadāe ṇissampādā rāamaggā| kukkurā vi osuttā| vaaṃ ṇiddaṃ ṇa labhāmo| aṇṇaṃ ca dāṇi accharīaṃ| imaṃ hadavīṇaṃ ṇa ramāmi| ahiadiḍhatthāṇae vicchiṇṇatantiā hodu|@ [bhoḥ vayasya! kaḥ kālaḥ <kṛta-parighoṣaṇa>Bs7^tayā <nir-sampātāḥ>Bsp <rājan-mārgāḥ>T6 kukkurāḥ api avasuptāḥ| vayam nidrām na labhāmahe| anyat ca idānīm āścaryam| imām <hata-vīṇām>K1 na rame| <<adhika-dṛḍha>K1-sthāne>T6 <vicchinna-tantrīkā>Bs6 bhavatu|]
nāyakaḥ---vayasya! <bhāva{3}-śābalena>T6 bahuśaḥ khalu adya madhuram gītam| na ca bhavān ramate|
vidūṣakaḥ---@ado evva edaṃ ahaṃ ṇa ramāmi| mahuraṃ pi bahu khādiaṃ ajiṇṇaṃ hoi|@ [ataḥ eva etām aham na rame| madhuram api bahu khāditam ajīrṇam bhavati]
nāyakaḥ---sarvathā <su-vyaktam>Tp gītam| kutaḥ,
raktam ca <tāra-madhuram>Ds ca samam sphuṭam ca 
<bhāva-arpitam>T3 ca na ca <sa-<abhinaya-prayogam>T6>BvS|
kim vā praśasya vividhaiḥ bahu <tat-tat>d uktvā
<bhitti-antaram>T6 yadi bhavet yuvatī iti vidyām || 2 ||
vidūṣakaḥ---@kāmaṃ pasaṃsedu bhavaṃ| mama khu dāva gāanto maṇusso itthiā vi paṭhantī ubhaaṃ ādaraṃ ṇa dedi| gāanto dāva maṇusso rattasumaṇāveṭṭhido via purohido diḍhaṃ ṇa sohai| itthiyā vi paṭhantī chiṇṇaṇāsiā via dheṇuā adivirūvā hoi|@ [kāmam praśaṃsatu bhavān| mama khalu tāvat gāyan manuṣyaḥ strī api paṭhantī ubhayam ādaram na dadāti| gāyan tāvat manuṣyaḥ <<rakta{3}-sumanas>K1-veṣṭitaḥ>T3 iva purohitaḥ dṛḍham na śobhate| strī api paṭhantī <chinna-nāsikā>Bs6 iva dhenuḥ <ati-virūpā>Tp bhavati|]
nāyakaḥ---sakhe! upārūḍhaḥ <ardha-rātraḥ>T1| <sthira-timirāḥ>Bs7 <rājan-mārgāḥ>T6| <<nir-sampāta>Bsp-puruṣa>K1^tvāt prasuptā iva ujjayanī pratibhāti| kutaḥ,
asau hi dattvā <timira-avakāśam>T6
astam gataḥ hi <<aṣṭama-pakṣa>K1-candraḥ>T6|
<toya-avagāḍhasya>T7 <vana-dvipasya>T6 
<viṣāṇa-koṭī>T6 iva nimajjamānā || 3 ||
vidūṣakaḥ---@suṭṭhu bhavaṃ bhaṇādi| antaddhiamāṇacandaladdhāvaāso odaradī via pāsādādo andhaāro|@ [suṣṭhu bhavān bhaṇati| <<<antardadhāna-candra>K1-labdha>T5-avakāśaḥ>Bs3 avatarati iva prāsādāt andhakāraḥ|]
nāyakaḥ---(parikramya) idam asmadīyam gṛham| vardhamānavaka! vardhamānavaka!
vidūṣakaḥ---@vaddhamāṇavaa! vaddhamāṇavaa! duvāraṃ avāvuda|@ [vardhamānavaka! vardhamānavaka dvāram apāvṛṇu|]
(praviśya)

ceṭī---(apavārya) @kiṃṇu khu tassa jaṇassa dādavvaṃ bhavissadi tti edaṇṇimittaṃ bhaṭṭidārao santappadi ti bhaṭṭidāriā tava hatthe daia ayyauttaṃ aṇiriṇaṃ karissāmi tti evaṃ karedi| tā gaṇha edaṃ|@ [kinnu khalu tasmai janāya dātavyam bhaviṣyati iti etat nimittam <bhartṛ-dārakaḥ>T6 santapyate iti <bhartṛ-dārikā>T6 tava haste dattvā āryaputram <a-ṛṇam>Bsmn kariṣyāmi iti evam karoti| tat gṛhāṇa etat|]

vidūṣakaḥ---(gṛhītvā) @savavaṃ dāva ciṭṭhadu| rodidīvia hodīe diṭṭhī|@ [sarvam tāvat tiṣṭhatu| roditi iva bhavatyāḥ dṛṣṭiḥ|]

brāhmaṇī---@haddhi|@ (niṣkrāntā|) [hā dhik|]

nāyakaḥ---kim etat|

vidūṣakaḥ--@tattahodī hiaeṇa tumaṃ yācedi| ahaṃ sīseṇa yācemi| gaṇha edaṃ|@ [tatrabhavatī hṛdayena tvām yācate| aham śīrṣeṇa yāce| gṛhaṇa etat|]
nāyakaḥ---tathā| (gṛhītvā) vayasya! imām muktāvalīm gṛhītvā vasantasenāyāḥ sakāśam gaccha|

gaṇikā---@kaṃ ayyacārudatto maṇḍaissidi|@ [kim <ārya-cārudattaḥ>K1 maṇḍayiṣyati|]

gaṇikā---@uṭṭhehi uṭṭhehi| kusandesaṃ asūāmi, ṇa tuvaṃ|@ [<uttiṣṭha-utiṣṭha>d| <ku-sandeśāya>Tk asūyāmi, na tubhyam|]

sajjalakaḥ---

nidrām ca hitvā timiram bhayam ca|

diṣṭyā <karman-ante>T6 prabhātam| yāvat idānīm vasantasenāyāḥ paricārikāyāḥ madanikāyāḥ <niṣkraya-artham>T4 mayā idam kṛtam| (parikramya) idam vasantasenāyāḥ gṛham| yāvat praviśāmi| (praviśya) kim nu khalu <abhyantara-sthā>U madanikā| athavā, <pūrva-ahṇe>T1 gaṇikānām abhyantare sānnidhyam| ataḥ tatra eva tathā bhavitavyam| yāvat śabdāpayāmi| madanike! madanike!|

vidūṣakaḥ---(sarvataḥ vilokya) @aho gaṇiāvāḍacassa sassirīadā| ṇāṇāpaṭṭaṇasaṃmāgadehi āamiehi putthaā vāīanti| saṃojaanti a āhārappaāraṇi| vīṇa vādīanti| saṃojaantia āharappaārāṇi| vīṇā vādīanti| suvaṇṇaārā alahkārappaārāṇi ādareṇa jojaanti|@ [aho <gaṇikā-vāṭasya>T6 <sa-śrīkatā>BvS| <<nānā-paṭṭaṇa>K1-samāgataiḥ>T5 āgamikaiḥ pustakāni vācyante| saṃyojyante ca <āhāra-prakārāḥ>T6| vīṇāḥ vādyante| <suvarṇa-kārāḥ>U <alaṅkāra{3}-prakārān>T6 ādareṇa yojayanti|]
ceṭī---@esā ajjuā| uvasappadu ayyo|@ [eṣā ajjukā| upasarpatu āryaḥ]
vidūṣakaḥ---(upagamya) @sotthi hodīe|@ [svasti bhavatyai|]
gaṇikā---@āadaṃ  ayyassa| hañje! āsaṇaṃ ayyassa, pādodaaṃ ca|@ [svāgatam āryasya| hañje! āsanam āryasya, <pāda-udakam>T4 ca|]
vidūṣakaḥ---(<ātman-gatam>T7) @savvaṃ āṇedu vajjia bhoaṇaṃ|@ [sarvam ānayatu varjayitvā bhojanam|]
ceṭī---@jaṃ ajjuā āṇavedi| (āsanam dadāti <pāda-udakam>T4 ca|) uvavisadu ayyo|@ [yat ajjukā ājñāpayati| upaviśatu āryaḥ|]
vidūṣakaḥ---(upaviśya) @paḍicchadu āsaṇaṃ bhodī| ahaṃ kiñci bhaṇiduṃ āado|@ [pratīcchatu āsanam bhavatī| aham kiñcit bhaṇitum āgataḥ|]
gaṇikā---(upaviśya) @avahidamhi|@ [avahitā asmi|]
vidūṣakaḥ---@kettiamattaṃ khu tassa alaṅkārassa mullappamāṇaṃ|@ [kiyanmātram khalu tasya alaṅkārasya <mūlya-pramāṇam>T6|]
gaṇikā---@kiṇimittaṃ khu ayyo pucchadi|@ [kim nimittam khalu āryaḥ pṛcchati|]
vidūṣakaḥ---@suṇādu bhodī| tattahodo cārudattassa guṇappaccāaṇaṇimittaṃ khu tue alaṅkāro tahi ṇikkhitto| so teṇa jūde hārido|@ [śṛṇotu bhavatī| tatrabhavataḥ cārudattasya <<guṇa{3}-pratyāyana>T6-nimittam>T7 khalu tvayā alaṅkāraḥ tasmin nikṣiptaḥ| saḥ tena dyūte hāritaḥ|]
gaṇikā---@jūde| jujjai| tado tado|@ [dyūte| yujyate| tataḥ tataḥ|]

gaṇikā---(<ātman-gatam>T7) @dhi kkhu gaṇiābhāvaṃ| luddhatti maṃ tulaadi| jai ṇa paḍicche, so evva doso bhavissadi| (prakāśam) āṇedu ayyo|@ [dhik khalu <gaṇikā-bhāvam>T6| lubdhaḥ iti mām tulayati| yadi na pratīcchāmi, saḥ eva doṣaḥ bhaviṣyati| ānayatu āryaḥ|]
vidūṣakaḥ---@idaṃ gaṇhadu bhodī|@ [idam gṛhṇātu bhavatī|]
gaṇikā---(gṛhītvā) @paḍicchidaṃ tae tti ayyo ṇivededu|@ [pratīṣṭam tayā iti āryaḥ nivedayatu|]
vidūṣakaḥ---(<ātman-gatam>T7) @kovi uvaāro vi ṇa edāe bhaṇido| (prakāśam) evaṃ hodu|@ (dattvā niṣkrāntaḥ|) [kaḥ api upacāraḥ api na etayā bhaṇitaḥ| evam bhavatu|]
gaṇikā---@sāhu cārudatta! sāhu| bhāadheaparivuttadāe dasāe māṇāvamāṇaṃ rakkhidaṃ|@ [sādhu cārudatta! sādhu| <bhāgadheya-parivṛttatāyām>T6 daśāyām <māna-avamānam>Ds rakṣitam|]
(praviśya)
madanikā---@ajjue! satthavāhaputtassa saāsādo kocci maṇusso āado icchai ajjuaṃ pekkhiuṃ|@ [ajjuke! <sārthavāha-putrasya>T6 sakāśāt kaścit manuṣyaḥ āgataḥ icchati ajjukām draṣṭum|]
gaṇikā---@kiṃ diṭṭhapuruvo ṇavadaṃsaṇo vā|@ [kim <dṛṣṭa-pūrvaḥ>S <nava-darśanaḥ>Bs6 vā|]
madanikā---@ajjue! ṇahi, tassakerao tti me paḍībhādi|@ [ajjuke! nahi, tadīyaḥ iti me pratibhāti|]

gaṇikā---@aho ramaṇijjadā ajja divasassa|@ [aho ramaṇīyatā adya divasasya|]
(tataḥ praviśati madanikā sajjalakena saha|)
sajjalakaḥ---kaṣṭā khalu <ātma-śaṅkā>T6 nāma,
yaḥ kaścit <cakita-gatiḥ>Bs6 nirīkṣate mām 
sambhrāntaḥ drutam upasarpati sthitaḥ vā|
sarvān tān tulayati doṣataḥ manaḥ me 
svaiḥ doṣaiḥ bhavati hi śaṅkitaḥ manuṣyaḥ || 6 ||
madanikā---@esā ajjuā| uvasappadu ayyo|@ [eṣā ajjukā| upasarpatu āryaḥ|]
sajjalakaḥ---(upasṛtya) sukham bhavatyai|
gaṇikā--@sāadaṃ ayyassa| hañje! āsaṇaṃ dedu ayyassa|@ [svāgatam āryasya| hañje! āsanam dīyatām āryāya|]
sajjalakaḥ---bhavatu bhavatu| gṛhītam āsanam| tvaritataram anuṣṭheyam kiñcit kāryam asti| 
gaṇikā---@evaṃ bhaṇādu ayyo|@ [evam, bhaṇatu āryaḥ|]
sajjalakaḥ---āryacārudattena asmi preṣitaḥ-- yaḥ tāvat alaṅkāraḥ mama haste nikṣiptaḥ, saḥ tu <<na-saṃbhoga>Tn-malina>T3^tayā gṛhasya <na-sānnidhyāt>Tn kauṭumbikānām durārakṣaḥ| tat gṛhyatām- iti|
gaṇikā---@imaṃ tassa cārudattasya dedu ayyo|@ [imam tasmai cārudattāya dadātu āryaḥ|]
sajjalakaḥ---bhavati! na khalu aham gacchāmi|
gaṇikā---@ahaṃ jāṇāmi tasya gehe sāhasaṃ karia āṇīdo aaṃ alaṅkāro| tassaguṇāṇi aṇaukampedu ayyo|@ [aham jānāmi tasya gehe sāhasam kṛtvā ānītaḥ ayam alaṅkāraḥ| tasya guṇān anukampatām āryaḥ|]
sajjalakaḥ---(<ātman-gatam>T7) katham viditaḥ asmi anayā|
gaṇikā---@ko etthaṃ, pavahaṇaṃ dāva ayyassa|@ [kaḥ atra, pravahaṇam tāvat āryāya|]
madanikā---@ṇemisaddo via suṇīadi| āadeṇa pavahaṇeṇa hodavvaṃ|@ [<nemi-śabdaḥ>T6 iva śrūyate| āgatena pravahaṇena bhavitavyam]
gaṇikā---(svaiḥ ābharaṇaiḥ madanikām alaṅkṛtya) @āruhadu ayyo ayyāe saha pavahaṇaṃ|@ [ārohatu āryaḥ āryayā saha pravahaṇam|]
madanikā---@ajjue! kiṃ edaṃ|@ [ajjuke! kim etat|]
gaṇikā---@mā khu mā khu evaṃ mantia| ayyā khu si dāṇiṃ saṃvuttā| gaṇhadu ayyo|@ (madanikām gṛhītvā sajjalakāya prayacchati|) [mā khalu mā khalu evam mantrayitvā| āryā khalu asi idānīm saṃvṛttā| gṛhṇātu āryaḥ|]
sajjalakaḥ---(<ātman-gatam>T6) bhoḥ! kadā khalu asyāḥ pratikartavyam bhaviṣyati| athavā, śāntam śāntam pāpam|
naraḥ <pratyupakāra-arthī>U vipattau labhate phalam|
dviṣatām eva kālaḥ astu yaḥ asyā bhavatu tasya vā || 7 ||
(tayā saha niṣkrāntaḥ sajjalakaḥ|)
gaṇikā--@caurie!|@ [caturike!]
(praviśya)
ceṭī---@ajjue! iamhi|@ [ajjuke! iyam asmi|]

ceṭī---@piaṃ me, amudaṃkaṇāḍaaṃ saṃvuttaṃ|@ [priyam me, <amṛta-aṅka>Bsu-nāṭakam>K1 saṃvṛttam|]
gaṇikā--@ehi imaṃ alaṅkaraṃ gaṇhia ayyacārudttaṃ abhisarissāmo|@ [ehi imam alaṅkāram gṛhītvā <ārya-cārudattam>K1 abhisariṣyāvaḥ|]
ceṭī---@ajjue! taha edaṃ puṇa abhisāriāsahāabhūdaṃ duddiṇaṃ uṇṇamidaṃ|@ [ajjuke! tathā| etat punaḥ <abhisārikā-<sahāya-bhūtam>T2>T6 durdinam unnamitam|]
gaṇikā---@hadāse! mā hu baḍḍhāvehi|@ [hatāśe! mā khalu vardhaya|]

(niṣkrānte|)
|| iti caturthaḥ aṅkaḥ ||

sañjayaḥ uvāca  
tam tathā kṛpayā āviṣṭam <<aśru-pūrṇa>T3-ākula-īkṣaṇam>Bb|
viṣīdantam idam vākyam uvāca madhusūdanaḥ||2.1||
śrībhagavān uvāca
kutaḥ tvā kaśmalam idam viṣame samupasthitam|
<<na-ārya>Tn-juṣṭam>T3 <na-svargyam>Tn <<na-kīrti>Tn-karam>U arjuna||2.2||
klaibyam mā sma gamaḥ pārtha na etat tvayi upapadyate|
kṣudram <hṛdaya-daurbalyam>T6 tyaktvā uttiṣṭha <param-tapa>U||2.3||
arjunaḥ uvāca 
katham bhīṣmam aham saṃkhye droṇam ca madhusūdana|
iṣubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi <pūjā-arhau>U <ari-sūdana>U||2.4||
gurūn <na-hatvā>Tn hi <mahat-anubhāvān>Bs6 śreyaḥ bhoktum bhaikṣyam api iha loke| 
hatvā <artha-kāmān>Di tu gurūn iha eva bhuñjīya bhogān <rudhira-pradigdhān>T3||2.5||
na ca etat vidmaḥ katarat naḥ garīyaḥ yat vā jayema yadi vā naḥ jayeyuḥ| 
yān eva hatvā na jijīviṣāmaḥ te avasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ||2.6||
<<kārpaṇya-doṣa>K1-upahata-svabhāvaḥ>Bb pṛcchāmi tvām <<dharma-saṃmūḍha>T7cetāḥ>Bs6| 
yat śreyaḥ syāt niścitam brūhi tat me śiṣyaḥ te aham śādhi mām tvām prapannam||2.7||
na hi prapaśyāmi mama apanudyāt yat śokam ucchoṣaṇam indriyāṇām| 
avāpya bhūmau <a-sapatnam>Bsmn ṛddham rājyam surāṇām api ca adhipatyam||2.8||
sañjayaḥ uvāca
evam uktvā hṛṣīkeśam guḍākeśaḥ parantapa|
na yotsye iti govindam uktvā tūṣṇīm babhūva ha||2.9||
tam uvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ prahasan iva bhārata|
senayoḥ ubhayoḥ madhye viṣīdantam idam vacaḥ||2.10|| 
||2.10|| - atra 'dṛṣṭvā tu <pāṇḍava-anīkam>T6' (gītā 1.2) iti ārabhya yāvat 'na yotsye iti govindam uktvā tūṣṇīm babhūva ha' (gītā 2.9) iti etadantaḥ prāṇinām <<<<<<<śoka-moha>Di-ādi>Bs6-<<<saṃsāra-bīja>T6>-bhūta>T2-doṣa>K1>K1-udbhava>T6-kāraṇa>T7-pradarśana>T6-artha^tvena>T4 vyākhyeyaḥ granthaḥ| tathāhi - arjunena <rājya-guru-putra-mitra-suhṛt-svajana-saṃbandhin-bāndhaveṣu>Di 'aham eṣām ' 'mama ete' iti evam <<<bhrānti-<pratyaya-nimitta>T6-sneha-viccheda>Diādi>Bs6-nimittau>K1 ātmanaḥ <śoka-mohau>Di pradarśitau 'katham bhīṣmam aham saṃkhye' (gītā 2.4) iti ādinā| <śoka-mohābhyām>Di hi <abhibhūta-viveka-vijñānaḥ>Bb svataḥ eva <kṣatra-dharme>T6 yuddhe pravṛttaḥ api tasmāt yuddhāt upararāma; <para-dharmam>T6 ca <<bhikṣā-jīvana>T3-ādi^kam>Bs6 kartum pravavṛte| tathā ca <sarva-prāṇinām>K1 <<<<śoka-moha>Di-ādi>Bs6-doṣa>K1-āviṣṭa-cetasām>Bb svabhāvataḥ eva <<sva-dharma>T6parityāgaḥ>T6 <pratiṣiddha-sevā>K1 ca syāt| <sva-dharme>T6 pravṛttānām api teṣām <<vāṅ-manas-kāya>Di-ādīnām>Bs6 pravṛttiḥ <phala-abhisandhi>T3-pūrvikā>BS6 eva <sa-ahaṃkārā>BvS ca bhavati| tatra evam sati <<dharma-<na-dharma>Tn-upacayāt>T6 <<<<iṣṭa-<na-niṣṭa>Tnjanma-sukha-duḥkha>Diādi>Bs6-prāpti>T6-lakṣaṇaḥ>Bs6 saṃsāraḥ <na-uparataḥ>Tn bhavati iti ataḥ <<saṃsāra-bīja>T6-bhūtau>T2 <śoka-mohau>Di| tayoḥ ca <<<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsa>T6-pūrvakāt>T6 <ātman-jñānāt>T6 na anyataḥ nivṛttiḥ iti tat upadidikṣuḥ <<<sarva-loka>K1-anugraha>T6-artham>T4 arjunam <nimitta^i-kṛtya>Tg āha bhagavān vāsudevaḥ - '<na-śocyān>Tn' (gītā 2.11) iti ādi||
atra kecit āhuḥ - <<<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsa>T6-pūrvakāt>T6 <<ātman-jñāna>T6-niṣṭhā>T7-mātrāt>A2 eva kevalāt kaivalyam na prāpyate eva| kim tarhi? <<<agnihotra-ādi>Bs6-<<śrautasmārta>Di-karma>Km>K1-sahitāt>T3 jñānāt <kaivalya-prāptiḥ>T6 iti sarvāsu gītāsu niścitaḥ artha iti| jñāpakam ca āhuḥ asya arthasya - 'atha cet tvam imam dharmyam saṃgrāmam na kariṣyasi' (gītā 2.33) 'karmaṇi eva adhikāraḥ te ' (gītā 2.47) 'kuru karma eva tasmāt tvam' (gītā 4.15) iti ādi| <<hiṃsa-ādi>BS6-yukta^tvāt>T3 vaidikam karma <na-dharmāya>Tn iti iyam api āśaṅkā na kāryā| katham? kṣātram karma <yuddha-lakṣaṇam>Bs6 <<<<guru-bhrātṛ-putra>Di-ādi>Bs6-hiṃsā>T6-lakṣaṇam>Bs6 atyantam krūram api <sva-dharmaḥ>T6 iti kṛtvā na <na-dharmāya>Tn; tat akaraṇe ca 'tataḥ <sva-dharmam>T6 kīrtim ca hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi' (gītā 2.33) iti bruvatā <<yāvajjīvādi-śruti>K1-coditānām>T3 <<<paśu-ādi>Bs6hiṃsā>T6-lakṣaṇānām>Bs6 ca karmaṇām prāk eva na <na-dharma^tvam>Tn iti <su-niścitam>Tg uktam bhavati - iti|| 
tat asat; <<jñāna-karma>Di-niṣṭhayoḥ>T7 <vibhāga-vacanāt>T6 <<buddhi-dvaya>T6-āśrayayoḥ>T6 '<na-śocyān>Tn' (gītā 2.11) iti ādinā bhagavatā yāvat '<sva-dharmam>T6 api ca āvekṣya' (gītā 2.31) iti <etad-antena>Bs6 granthena yat <<<parama-artha>K1-<ātman-tattva>T6>Di-nirūpaṇam>T6 kṛtam tat sāṃkhyam| <tad-viṣayā>T6 buddhiḥ ātmanaḥ <<<janma-ādi>Bs6-<ṣaḍ-vikriyā>Km>K1-abhāvāt>T6 <na-kartā>T6 ātmā iti <<prakaraṇa-artha>T6-nirūpaṇāt>T6 yā jāyate, sā <sāṃkhya-buddhiḥ>T6| sā yeṣām jñāninām ucitā bhavati, te sāṃkhyāḥ| etasyāḥ buddheḥ janmanaḥ prāk ātmanaḥ <<<<deha-ādi>Bs6-vyatirikta^tva>T5-kartṛ^tva-bhoktṛ^tva>Di-ādi-apekṣaḥ>Bb <<<dharma-<na-dharma>Tn>Di-viveka>T6-pūrva^kaḥ>Bs6 <<<mokṣa-sādhana>T6-anuṣṭhāna>T6-lakṣaṇaḥ>Bs6 yogaḥ| <tad-viṣayā>T6 buddhiḥ <yoga-buddhiḥ>T6| sā yeṣām karmiṇām ucitā bhavati te yoginaḥ| tathā ca bhagavatā vibhakte dve buddhī nirdiṣṭe 'eṣā te abhihitā sāṃkhye buddhiḥ yoge tu imām śṛṇu' (gītā 2.39) iti| tayoḥ ca <<sāṃkhya-buddhi>T6-āśrayām>Bs6 <jñāna-yogena>K6 niṣṭhām sāṃkhyānām vibhaktām vakṣyati 'purā <veda-ātmanā>Bs6 mayā proktā' (gītā 3.3) iti| tathā ca <<yoga-buddhi>T6-āśrayām>Bs6 <karman-yogena>K6 niṣṭhām vibhaktām vakṣyati - '<karman-yogena>K6 yoginām' (gītā 3.3) iti| evam <sāṃkhya-buddhim>T6 <yoga-buddhim>T6 ca āśritya dve niṣṭhe vibhakte bhagavatā eva ukte <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di <<<kartṛtva-<na-kartṛtva>Tn-ekatva-anekatva>Di-buddhi>K1-āśrayayoḥ>T6 yugapat <<<eka-puruṣa>Km-āśrayatva>K1-<na-saṃbhavam>Tn>T6 paśyatā| yathā etat <vibhāga-vacanam>T6, tathā eva darśitam śātapathīye brāhmaṇe - 'etam eva pravrājinaḥ lokam icchantaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ pravrajanti' (bṛ0 4.4.22) iti <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsam>T6 vidhāya <tat-śeṣeṇa>T6 'kim prajayā kariṣyāmaḥ yeṣām naḥ ayam ātmā ayam lokaḥ' (bṛ0 4.4.22) iti| tatra evam ca prāk <dāra-parigrahāt>T6 puruṣaḥ ātmā prākṛtaḥ <<dharma-jijñāsā>T6-<uttara-kālam>K1>T6 <<loka-traya>T6-sādhanam>T6 - putram, <dvi-prakāram>Bs6 ca vittam mānuṣam daivam ca; tatra mānuṣam <karman-rūpam>Bs6 <<<pitṛ-loka>T6-prāpti>T6-sādhanam>T6 vidyām ca daivam vittam <<<deva-loka>T6-prāpti>T6-sādhanam>T6 saḥ akāmayata' (bṛ0 1.4.17) iti <avidyā-kāma^vataḥ>T3 eva sarvāṇi karmāṇi śrautādīni darśitāni| tebhyaḥ vyutthāya pravrajanti' (bṛ0 4.4.22) iti vyutthānam ātmānam eva lokam icchataḥ <a-kāmasya>Bsmn vihitam| tat etat <vibhāga-vacanam>T6 <na-upapannam>Tn syāt yadi <<śrauta-karma>K1-jñānayoḥ>T7 samuccayaḥ abhipretaḥ syāt bhagavataḥ|| 
na ca arjunasya praśnaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati 'jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te' (gītā 3.1) iti ādiḥ| <<<eka-puruṣa>Km-anuṣṭheya^tva>T6-<na-saṃbhavam>Tn>T6 <buddhi-karmaṇoḥ>Di bhagavatā pūrvam <na-uktam>Tn katham arjunaḥ <na-śrutam>Tn buddheḥ ca karmaṇaḥ jyāyastvam bhagavati adhyāropayet mṛṣā eva 'jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te matā buddhiḥ' (gītā 3.1) iti|| 
kiñca - yadi <buddhi-karmaṇoḥ>Di sarveṣām samuccayaḥ uktaḥ syāt arjunasya api saḥ uktaḥ eva iti, 'yat śreyaḥ etayoḥ ekam tat me brūhi <su-niścitam>Tg' (gītā 5.1) iti katham ubhayoḥ upadeśe sati <anyatara-viṣaye>T6 eva praśnaḥ syāt? na hi <<pitta-praśamana>T6-arthinaḥ>U vaidyena madhuram śītalam ca bhoktavyam iti upadiṣṭe tayoḥ anyatarat <<pitta-praśamana>T6-kāraṇam>T6 brūhi iti praśnaḥ saṃbhavati|| 
atha arjunasya <<<<<<bhagavat-ukta>T3-vacana>K1artha>T6-viveka>T6-<na-avadhāraṇa>Tn>T6-nimittaḥ>T6 praśnaḥ kalpyeta, tathā api bhagavatā <praśna-anurūpam>T6 prativacanam deyam - mayā <buddhi-karmaṇoḥ>Di samuccayaḥ uktaḥ, <kim-artham>T4 ittham tvam bhrāntaḥ asi - iti| na tu punaḥ prativacanam <na-anurūpam>Tn pṛṣṭāt anyat eva 'dve niṣṭhe mayā purā prokte' iti vaktum yuktam||

yat ca 'pūrvaiḥ pūrvataram kṛtam' (gītā 4.15) 'karmaṇā eva hi <sam-siddhim>Tg āsthitāḥ janakādayaḥ' (gītā 3.20) iti, tat tu pravibhajya vijñeyam| tat katham? yadi tāvat pūrve <janaka-ādayaḥ>Bs6 <tattva-vidaḥ>U api <pravṛtta-karmāṇaḥ>Bs3 syuḥ, te <<loka-saṃgraha>T6-artham>T4 'guṇāḥ guṇeṣu vartante' (gītā 3.28) iti jñānena eva <sam-siddhim>Tg āsthitāḥ, <karma-saṃnyāse>T6 prāpte api karmaṇā saha eva <sam-siddhim>Tg āsthitāḥ, na <karma-saṃnyāsam>T6 kṛtavantaḥ iti arthaḥ| atha na te <tattva-vidaḥ>U; <īśvara-samarpitena>T3 karmaṇā <sādhana-bhūtena>T2 <sam-siddhim>Tg <sattva-śuddhim>T6, <<jñāna-utpatti>T6-lakṣaṇām>Bs6 vā <sam-siddhim>Tg, āsthitāḥ <janaka-ādayaḥ>Bs6 iti vyākhyeyam| tam eva artham vakṣyati bhagavān '<sattva-śuddhaye>T6 karma kurvanti' iti| (gītā 5.11) '<sva-karmaṇā>T6 tam abhyarcya siddhim vindati mānavaḥ' (gītā (18.46) iti uktvā siddhim prāptasya punaḥ <jñāna-niṣṭhām>T7 vakṣyati - 'siddhim prāptaḥ yathā brahma' (gītā 18.50) iti ādinā||

||2.13|| - dehaḥ asya asti iti dehī, tasya dehinaḥ dehavataḥ ātmanaḥ asmin vartamāne dehe yathā yena prakāreṇa kaumāram                          <kumāra-bhāvaḥ>T6 <bālyā-avasthā>K1, yauvanam yūnaḥ bhāvaḥ <madhyamā-avasthā>K1, jarā <vayas-hāniḥ>T6 <jīrṇā-avasthā>K1, iti etāḥ tisraḥ avasthāḥ <anyonya-vilakṣaṇāḥ>Bs6| tāsām <prathamā-avasthā>K1-nāśe>T6 na nāśaḥ, <<dvitīyā-avasthā>K1-upajane>T6 na upajananam ātmanaḥ| kim tarhi? avikriyasya eva <<<dvitīyā-tṛtīyā>Di-avasthā>K1-prāptiḥ>T6 ātmanaḥ dṛṣṭā| tathā tadvat eva dehāt anyaḥ dehaḥ <deha-antaram>Tm, tasya prāptiḥ <<deha-antara>Tm-prāptiḥ>T6 avikriyasya eva ātmanaḥ iti arthaḥ| dhīraḥ dhīmān, tatra evam sati na muhyati na moham āpadyate||

antavantaḥ ime dehāḥ nityasya uktāḥ śarīriṇaḥ|

||2.18|| - antaḥ vināśaḥ vidyate yeṣām te antavantaḥ| yathā <mṛga-tṛṣṇika>T6-ādau>Bs6 <sat-buddhiḥ>K1 anuvṛttā <<pramāṇa-nirūpaṇa>T6-ante>T6 vicchidyate, saḥ tasya antaḥ; tathā ime dehāḥ <svapna-<<māyā-deha>T6-ādi>Bs6^vat ca antavantaḥ nityasya śarīriṇaḥ śarīravataḥ <na-nāśinaḥ>Tn <na-prameyasya>Tn ātmanaḥ antavantaḥ iti uktāḥ vivekibhiḥ iti arthaḥ| 'nityasya' '<na-nāśinaḥ>Tn' iti na punaḥ uktam; nityatvasya <dvi-vidha^tvāt>Km loke, nāśasya ca| yathā dehaḥ <bhasma^i-bhūtaḥ>Tg <na-darśanam>Tn gataḥ naṣṭaḥ ucyate| vidyamānaḥ api yathā anyathā pariṇataḥ <<vyādhi-ādi>Bs6-yuktaḥ>T3 jātaḥ naṣṭaḥ ucyate| tatra 'nityasya' '<na-nāśinaḥ>Tn' iti <dvi-vidhena>Km api nāśena <na-saṃbandhaḥ>Tn asya iti arthaḥ| anyathā <pṛthivī-ādi>Bs6^vat api nityatvam syāt ātmanaḥ; tat mā bhūt iti 'nityasya' '<na-nāśinaḥ>Tn' iti āha| <na-prameyasya>Tn na prameyasya <<pratyakṣa-ādi>Bs6-pramāṇaiḥ>K1 <na-paricchedyasya>Tn iti arthaḥ|| 
nanu āgamena ātmā paricchidyate, <pratyakṣa-ādinā>Bs6 ca pūrvam| na ātmanaḥ svataḥsiddhatvāt| siddhe hi ātmani pramātari pramitsoḥ <pramāṇa-anveṣaṇā>T6 bhavati| na hi pūrvam 'ittham aham' iti ātmānam <na-pramāya>T6 paścāt <prameya-paricchedāya>T6 pravartate| na hi ātmā nāma kasyacit <na-prasiddhaḥ>Tn bhavati| śāstram tu antyam pramāṇam ataddharmādhyāropaṇamātranivartakatvena pramāṇatvam ātmanaḥ pratipadyate, na tu <<na-<jñāta-artha>K1>Tn-jñāpakatvena>T6| tathā ca śrutiḥ - 'yatsākṣādaparokṣādbrahma ya ātmā sarvāntaraḥ' iti|| 
yasmāt evam nityaḥ <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn ca ātmā tasmāt yudhyasva, yuddhāt uparamam mā kārṣīḥ iti arthaḥ|| 
na hi atra <yuddha-kartavyatā>T6 vidhīyate, yuddhe pravṛtte eva hi asau <<śoka-moha>Di-pratibaddhaḥ>T3 tūṣṇīm āste| ataḥ tasya <<<kartavya-pratibandha>T6-apanayana>T6-mātram>S bhagavatā kriyate| tasmāt 'yudhyasva' iti <anuvāda-mātram>S, na vidhiḥ|| 
<<<śoka-moha>Di-ādi>Bs6-<saṃsāra-kāraṇa>T6>K1-nivṛttyartham>T6 <gītā-śāstram>K7, na pravartakam iti etasya arthasya <sākṣin-bhūte>T2 ṛcau ānināya bhagavān| yat tu manyase 'yuddhe <bhīṣma-ādayaḥ>Bs6 mayā hanyante' 'aham eva teṣām hantā' iti, eṣā buddhiḥ mṛṣā eva te| katham? 
yaḥ enam vetti hantāram yaḥ ca enam manyate hatam|
ubhau tau na vijānītaḥ na ayam hanti na hanyate||2.19||
||2.19|| - yaḥ enam prakṛtam dehinam vetti vijānāti hantāram <hanana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 kartāram yaḥ ca enam anyaḥ manyate hatam <deha-hananena>T6 'hataḥ aham' iti <hanana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 <karma-bhūtam>T2, tau ubhau na vijānītaḥ na jñātavantau <na-vivekena>Tn ātmānam| 'hantā aham' 'hataḥ asmi aham' iti <deha-hananena>T6 ātmānam <<aham-pratyaya>K7-viṣayam>T6 yau vijānītaḥ tau <<ātman-svarūpa>T6-<na-abhijñau>Tn>T6 iti arthaḥ| yasmāt na ayam ātmā hanti na <hanana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 kartā bhavati, na ca hanyate na ca karma bhavati iti arthaḥ, <na-vikriyatvāt>Tn|| 
katham <na-vikrayaḥ>Tn ātmā iti dvitīyaḥ mantraḥ -
na jāyate mriyate vā kadācit na ayam bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ| 
ajaḥ nityaḥ śāśvataḥ ayam purāṇaḥ na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre||2.20||
||2.20|| - na jāyate na utpadyate, <jani-lakṣaṇā>Bs6 <vastu-vikriyā>T6 na ātmanaḥ vidyate iti arthaḥ| tathā na mriyate vā| <vā-śabdaḥ>K7 <ca-arthe>T6| na mriyate ca iti antyā <vināśa-lakṣaṇā>Bs6 vikriyā pratiṣidhyate| <kadācit-śabdaḥ>K7 <<sarva-vikriyā>K1-pratiṣedhaiḥ>T6 saṃbadhyate - na kadācit jāyate, na kadācit mriyate, iti evam| yasmāt ayam ātmā bhūtvā <bhavana-kriyām>T6 anubhūya paścāt <na-bhavitā>Tn abhāvam gantā na bhūyaḥ punaḥ, tasmāt na mriyate| yaḥ hi bhūtvā na bhavitā saḥ mriyate iti ucyate loke| <vā-śabdāt>K7 <na-śabdāt>K7 ca ayam ātmā <na-bhūtvā>Tn vā bhavitā dehavat na bhūyaḥ| tasmāt na jāyate| yaḥ hi <na-bhūtvā>Tn bhavitā saḥ jāyate iti ucyate| na evam ātmā| ataḥ na jāyate| yasmāt evam tasmāt ajaḥ, yasmāt na mriyate tasmāt nityaḥ ca| yadi api <ādi-antayoḥ>Di vikriyayoḥ pratiṣedhe sarvāḥ vikriyāḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ bhavanti, tathā api <madhya-bhāvinīnām>T6 vikriyāṇām <sva-śabdaiḥ>T6 eva pratiṣedhaḥ kartavyaḥ <na-uktānām>Tn api <<yauvana-ādi>Bs6-<samasta-vikriyāṇām>K1>K1 pratiṣedhaḥ yathā syāt iti āha - śāśvataḥ iti ādinā| śāśvataḥ iti <apakṣaya-lakṣaṇā>Bs6 vikriyā pratiṣidhyate| <śaśvat-bhavaḥ>U śāśvataḥ| na apakṣīyate <sva-rūpeṇa>T6, <nir-avayavatvāt>Bsp| na api <guṇa-kṣayeṇa>T6 apakṣayaḥ, <nir-guṇa^tvāt>Bvp| <apakṣaya-viparītā>T3 api <vṛddhi-lakṣaṇā>Bs6 vikriyā pratiṣidhyate - purāṇaḥ iti| yaḥ hi <avayava-āgamena>T6 upacīyate saḥ vardhate abhinavaḥ iti ca ucyate| ayam tu ātmā <nir-avayava^tvāt>Bvp purā api navaḥ eva iti purāṇaḥ; na vardhate iti arthaḥ| tathā na hanyate| hantiḥ atra <vipariṇāma-arthe>T6 draṣṭavyaḥ <na-punaḥ>T6 uktatāyai| na vipariṇamyate iti arthaḥ| hanyamāne vipariṇamyamāne api śarīre| asmin mantre ṣaṭ                         <bhāva-vikārāḥ>T6 <<laukika-vastu>K1-vikriyāḥ>T6 ātmani pratiṣidhyante| <<<sarva-prakāra>K1-vikriyā>K1-rahitaḥ>T3 ātmā iti <vākya-arthaḥ>T6| yasmāt evam tasmāt 'ubhau tau na vijānītaḥ' iti pūrveṇa mantreṇa asya saṃbandhaḥ||
yaḥ enam vetti hantāram' iti anena mantreṇa <hanana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 kartā karma ca na bhavati iti pratijñāya, 'na jāyate' iti anena <na-vikriya^tvam>Tn hetum uktvā <pratijñāta-artham>K1 upasaṃharati -
veda <na-vināśinam>Tn nityam yaḥ enam ajam <na-vyayam>Tn| 
katham saḥ puruṣaḥ pārtha kam ghātayati hanti kam||2.21||
||2.21|| - veda vijānāti <na-vināśinam>Tn <<antya-<bhāva-vikāra>T6>K1-rahitam>T3 nityam <vipariṇāma-rahitam>T3 yaḥ veda iti saṃbandhaḥ| enam pūrveṇa mantreṇa uktalakṣaṇam ajam <janman-rahitam>T3 <na-vyayam>Tn <apakṣaya-rahitam>T3 katham kena prakāreṇa saḥ vidvān puruṣaḥ adhikṛtaḥ hanti <hanana-kriyām>T6 karoti, katham vā ghātayati hantāram prayojayati| na kathañcit kañcit hanti, na kathañcit kañcit ghātayati iti ubhayatra ākṣepaḥ eva arthaḥ, <<praśna-artha>T4-asaṃbhavāt>T6| <hetu-arthasya>T4 ca <na-vikriya^tvasya>Tn tulyatvāt viduṣaḥ <<sarva-karma>K1-pratiṣedhaḥ>T6 eva <prakaraṇa-arthaḥ>T6 abhipretaḥ bhagavatā| hanteḥ tu ākṣepaḥ <udāharaṇa-artha^tvena>T4 kathitaḥ|| 
viduṣaḥ kam <<<karma-asaṃbhava>T6-hetu>T6-viśeṣam>T6 paśyan karmāṇi ākṣipati bhagavān 'katham saḥ puruṣaḥ' iti| nanu uktaḥ eva ātmanaḥ <na-vikriyatvam>Tn <<<<sarva-karma>K1-asaṃbhava>T6-kāraṇa>T6-viśeṣaḥ>K1| satyam uktaḥ| na tu saḥ <kāraṇa-viśeṣaḥ>K1, anyatvāt viduṣaḥ <na-vikriyāt>T6 ātmanaḥ| na hi <na-vikriyam>T6 sthāṇum viditavataḥ karma na saṃbhavati iti cet, na; viduṣaḥ ātmatvāt| na <<deha-ādi>Bs6-saṃghātasya>T6 vidvattā| ataḥ pāriśeṣyāt <na-saṃhataḥ>Tn ātmā vidvān <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn iti tasya viduṣaḥ <karma-asaṃbhavāt>T6 ākṣepaḥ yuktaḥ 'katham saḥ puruṣaḥ' iti| yathā <<buddhi-ādi>Bs6-āhṛtasya>T3 <<śabda-ādi>Bs6-arthasya>K1 <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn eva san <<<buddhi-vṛtti>T6-aviveka>T6-vijñānena>T6 <na-vidyayā>Tn upalabdhā ātmā kalpyate, evam eva <<<ātman-<na-ātma>Tn>Di-viveka>T6-jñānena>T6 <buddhi-vṛttyā>T6 vidyayā <<na-satya>Tn-rūpayā>K1 eva <parama-arthataḥ>K1 <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn eva ātmā vidvān ucyate| viduṣaḥ <<karman-<na-saṃbhava>Tn>T6-vacanāt yāni karmāṇi śāstreṇa vidhīyante tāni na viduṣaḥ vihitāni iti bhagavataḥ niścayaḥ avagamyate|| 
nanu vidyā api <na-viduṣaḥ>Tn eva vidhīyate, <vidita-vidyasya>Bs3 <piṣṭa-peṣaṇa>T6^vat <<vidyā-vidhāna>T6-ānarthakyāt>T6| tatra na-viduṣaḥ karmāṇi vidhīyante na viduṣaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ na upapadyate iti cet, na; anuṣṭheyasya <<<bhāva-abhāva>Di-viśeṣa>T6-upapatteḥ>T6| <<<<<agnihotra-ādi>Bs6-vidhi>K1-artha>T6-jñāna>T6-<uttara-kālam>K1>T6 <<agnihotra-ādi>Bs6-karma>K1 <<<aneka-sādhana>K1-upasaṃhāra>T6-pūrvakam>T6 anuṣṭheyam 'kartā aham, mama kartavyam' ityevam <prakāra-vijñāna^vataḥ>T6 <na-viduṣaḥ>Tn yathā anuṣṭheyam bhavati, na tu tathā 'na jāyate' ityādi ātman-svarūpa-vidhi-artha-jñāna-uttara-kāla-bhāvi kiñcit anuṣṭheyam bhavati; kintu 'na aham kartā, na aham bhoktā' ityādi <ātman-<<<<ekatva-<na-kartṛtva>Tn>Di-ādi>Bs6-viṣaya>K1-jñānāt>T6>T6 na anyat utpadyate iti eṣaḥ viśeṣaḥ upapadyate| yaḥ punaḥ 'kartā aham' iti vetti ātmānam, tasya 'mama idam kartavyam' iti <avaśyam-bhāvinī>S buddhiḥ syāt; <tat-apekṣayā>T6 saḥ adhikriyate iti tam prati karmāṇi saṃbhavanti| saḥ ca <na-vidvān>Tn' ubhau tau na vijānītaḥ' iti vacanāt viśeṣitasya ca viduṣaḥ <<karman-ākṣepa>T6-vacanāt>T6 ca 'katham saḥ puruṣaḥ' iti| tasmāt viśeṣitasya <<na-vikriyā>Tn-<ātman-darśinaḥ>U>T3 viduṣaḥ mumukṣoḥ ca <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāse>T6 eva adhikāraḥ| ataḥ eva bhagavān nārāyaṇaḥ sāṃkhyān viduṣaḥ aviduṣaḥ ca karmiṇaḥ pravibhajya dve niṣṭhe grāhayati - '<jñāna-yogena>K6 sāṃkhyānām <karman-yogena>K6 yoginām' iti| tathā ca putrāya āha bhagavān vyāsaḥ - 'dvau imau atha panthānau' ityādi| tathā ca <kriyā-pathaḥ>T6 ca eva purastāt paścāt saṃnyāsaḥ ca iti| tam eva vibhāgam punaḥ punardarśayiṣyati bhagavān - <na-<tattva-vit>U>Tn '<ahaṃkāra-vimūḍha>T3-ātmā>Bs6 kartā aham iti manyate', <tattva-vit>T6 tu na aham karomi iti| tathā ca '<sarva-karmāṇi>K1 manasā saṃnyasya āste' ityādi|| 
tatra kecit <paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ vadanti - '<<<janman-ādi>Bs6-<ṣaṭ-<bhāva-vikriyā>T6>Km>K1-rahitaḥ>T3 avikriyaḥ akartā ekaḥ aham ātmā' iti na kasyacit jñānam utpadyate, yasmin sati <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsaḥ>T6 upadiśyate iti| tat na; 'na jāyate' <<<ityādi-śāstra>K1-upadeśa>T6-<ānarthakya-prasaṅgāt>T6>T6| yathā ca <<śāstra-upadeśa>T6-sāmarthyāt>T6 <<<dharma-<na-dharma>Tn>Diastitva>T6-vijñānam>T6 kartuḥ ca <<<deha-antara>Tm-saṃbandha>T6-vijñānam>T6 utpadyate, tathā śāstrāt tasya eva ātmanaḥ <<<<na-vikriyatva>Tn-<na-kartṛtva>Tn-ekatva>Di-ādi>Bs6-vijñānam>T6 kasmāt na utpadyate iti praṣṭavyāḥ te| <karaṇa-<na-gocaratvāt>Tn>T6 iti cet, na; 'manasā eva anudraṣṭavyam' iti śruteḥ| <<<śāstra-ācārya>T6upadeśa>T6-<<<śama-dama>Di-ādi>Bs6-saṃskṛtam>T3>T3 manaḥ <ātman-darśane>T6 karaṇam| tathā ca <tat-adhigamāya>T6 anumāne āgame ca sati jñānam na utpadyate iti                                                                                                   <sāhasa-mātram>S etat| jñānam ca utpadyamānam <tat-viparītam>T6 <na-jñānam>Tn avaśyam bādhate iti abhyupagantavyam| tat ca <na-jñānam>Tn darśitam 'hantā aham, hataḥ asmi' iti 'ubhau tau na vijānītaḥ' iti| atra ca ātmanaḥ <hanana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 kartṛtvam karmatvam <hetu-kartṛ^tvam>Km ca <<na-jñāna>Tn-kṛtam>T3 darśitam| tat ca <sarva-kriyāsu>K1 api samānam <kartṛ^tva-ādeḥ>Bs6 <avidyā-kṛta^tvam>T6, <na-vikriya^tvāt>Tn ātmanaḥ| vikriyāvān hi kartā ātmanaḥ <karman-bhūtam>T2 anyam prayojayati 'kuru' iti| tadetat <na-viśeṣeṇa>Tn viduṣaḥ <sarva-kriyāsu>K1 kartṛtvam <hetu-kartṛ^tvam>Km ca pratiṣedhati bhagavān vāsudevaḥ viduṣaḥ <<<<karman-adhikāra>T6-abhāva>T6-pradarśana>T6-artham>T4 'vedāvināśinam ... katham saḥ puruṣaḥ ityādinā| kva punaḥ viduṣaḥ adhikāraḥ iti etat uktam pūrvam eva '<jñāna-yogena>K7 sāṃkhyānām' iti| tathā ca <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsam>T6 vakṣyati '<sarva-karmāṇi>K1 manasā' ityādinā|| 
nanu manasā iti vacanāt na vācikānām kāyikānām ca saṃnyāsaḥ iti cet, na; <sarva-karmāṇi>K1 iti viśeṣitatvāt| mānasānām eva <sarva-karmaṇām>K1 iti cet, na; <<manas-vyāpāra>T6-pūrvakatvāt>T6 <<vāk-kāya>Di-vyāpārāṇām>T6 <<manas-vyāpāra>T6-abhāve>T6 <tat-<na-upapatteḥ>Tn>T6| śāstrīyāṇām <vāk-kāya-karmaṇām>Di kāraṇāni mānasāni karmāṇi varjayitvā anyāni <sarva-karmāṇi>K1 manasā saṃnyaset iti cet, na; 'na eva kurvan na kārayan' iti viśeṣaṇāt| <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsaḥ>T6 ayam bhagavatā uktaḥ mariṣyataḥ na jīvataḥ iti cet, na; 'navadvāre pure dehī āste' iti <viśeṣaṇa-<na-upapatteḥ>Tn>T6| na hi <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsena>T6 mṛtasya <tat-dehe>K1 āsanam saṃbhavati| <na-kurvataḥ>Tn <na-kārayataḥ>Tn ca dehe saṃnyasya iti saṃbandhaḥ na dehe āste iti cet, na; sarvatra ātmanaḥ <<na-vikriyatva>Tn-avadhāraṇāt>T6, <āsana-kriyāyāḥ>T6 ca <adhikaraṇa-apekṣatvāt>T6, <tat-<na-apekṣa^tvāt>Tn>T6 ca saṃnyāsasya| saṃpūrvaḥ tu <nyāsa-śabdaḥ>K7 atra <tyāga-arthaḥ>Bs6, na <nikṣepa-arthaḥ>Bs6| tasmāt <gītā-śāstre>K7 <ātman-jñāna>T6^vataḥ saṃnyāse eva adhikāraḥ, na karmaṇi iti tatra tatra upariṣṭāt <<ātman-jñāna>T6-prakaraṇe>T6 darśayiṣyāmaḥ|| 
prakṛtam tu vakṣyāmaḥ| tatra ātmanaḥ <na-vināśitvam>Tn pratijñātam| tat kim iva iti, ucyate -
vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛhṇāti naraḥ aparāṇi| 
tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇāni anyāni saṃyāti navāni dehī||2.22||
||2.22|| - vāsāṃsi vastrāṇi jīrṇāni durbalatām gatāni yathā loke vihāya parityajya navāni abhinavāni gṛhṇāti upādatte naraḥ puruṣaḥ aparāṇi anyāni, tathā tadvat eva śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇāni anyāni saṃyāti saṃgacchati navāni dehī ātmā puruṣavat <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn eva iti arthaḥ||
kasmāt <na-vikriyaḥ>Tn eva iti, āha -
na enam chindanti śastrāṇi na enam dahati pāvakaḥ| 
na ca enam kledayanti āpaḥ na śoṣayati mārutaḥ||2.23||
||2.23|| - enam prakṛtam dehinam na chindanti śastrāṇi, <nir-avayavatvāt>Bvp na <avayava-vibhāgam>T6 kurvanti| śastrāṇi <asi-ādīni>Bs6| tathā na enam dahati pāvakaḥ, agniḥ api na bhasmīkaroti| tathā na ca enam kledayanti āpaḥ| apām hi <sa-avayavasya>BvS vastunaḥ <ārdrībhāva-karaṇena>T6 <<avayava-viśleṣa>T6-āpādane>T6 sāmarthyam| tat na <nir-avayave>Bvp ātmani saṃbhavati| tathā snehavat dravyam <sneha-śoṣaṇena>T6 nāśayati vāyuḥ| enam tu ātmānam na śoṣayati mārutaḥ api|| 
yataḥ evam tasmāt -
<na-chedyaḥ>Tn ayam <na-dāhyaḥ>Tn ayam <na-kledyaḥ>Tn <na-śoṣyaḥ>Tn eva ca| 
nityaḥ <sarva-gataḥ>T2 sthāṇuḥ <na-calaḥ>Tn ayam sanātanaḥ||2.24||
||2.24|| - yasmāt <<<anyonya-nāśa>T6-hetu>T6-bhūtāni>T2 enam ātmānam nāśayitum na utsahante <asi-ādīni>Bs6 tasmāt nityaḥ| nityatvāt <sarva-gataḥ>T2| <sarva-gata>T2^tvāt sthāṇuḥ iva, sthiraḥ iti etat| sthiratvāt <na-calaḥ>Tn ayam ātmā| ataḥ sanātanaḥ ciraṃtanaḥ, na kāraṇāt kutaścit niṣpannaḥ, abhinavaḥ ityarthaḥ||

||2.60|| - yatataḥ prayatnam kurvataḥ api hi yasmāt kaunteya puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ medhāvinaḥ api iti vyavahitena saṃbandhaḥ| indriyāṇi pramāthīni <pramathana-śīlāni>Bs6 <viṣaya-abhimukham>T6 hi puruṣam vikṣobhayanti ākulīkurvanti, <ākula^i-kṛtya>Tg ca haranti prasabham prasahya prakāśam eva paśyataḥ <<viveka-vijñāna>Di-yuktam>T3 manaḥ||
yataḥ tasmāt -
tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yuktaḥ āsīta <asmad-paraḥ>Bs6| 
vaśe hi yasya indriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā||2.61||
||2.61|| - tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya saṃyamanam vaśīkaraṇam kṛtvā yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ san āsīta <asmad-paraḥ>Bs6 aham vāsudevaḥ <sarva-pratyak>T6 ātmā paraḥ yasya saḥ <asmad-paraḥ>Bs6, 'na anyaḥ aham tasmāt' iti āsīta ityarthaḥ| evam āsīnasya yateḥ vaśe hi yasya indriyāṇi vartante <abhyāsa-balāt>T6 tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā||
atha idānīm parābhaviṣyataḥ <<sarva-<na-artha>Tn>K1-mūlam>T6 idam ucyate -
