saṅgāt saṃjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodhaḥ abhijāyate||2.62||
||2.62|| - dhyāyataḥ cintayataḥ viṣayān śabdādīn <viṣaya-viśeṣān>K1 ālocayataḥ puṃsaḥ puruṣasya saṅgaḥ āsaktiḥ prītiḥ teṣu viṣayeṣu upajāyate utpadyate| saṅgāt prīteḥ saṃjāyate samutpadyate kāmaḥ tṛṣṇā| kāmāt kutaścit pratihatāt krodhaḥ abhijāyate||
krodhāt bhavati saṃmohaḥ saṃmohāt <smṛti-vibhramaḥ>T6|
<smṛti-bhraṃśāt>T6 <buddhi-nāśaḥ>T6 <buddhi-nāśāt>T6 praṇaśyati||2.63||
||2.63|| - krodhāt bhavati saṃmohaḥ <na-vivekaḥ>Tn <<kārya-<na-kārya>Tn>Di-viṣayaḥ>Bs6| kruddhaḥ hi saṃmūḍhaḥ san gurum api ākrośati| saṃmohāt <smṛti-vibhramaḥ>T6 <<<<<śāstra-ācārya>T6-upadeśa>T6-āhita>T3-saṃskāra>K1-janitāyāḥ>T3 smṛteḥ syāt vibhramaḥ bhraṃśaḥ <<<smṛti-utpatti>T6-nimitta>T6-prāptau>T6 <na-utpattiḥ>Tn| tataḥ <smṛti-bhraṃśāt>T6 <buddhi-nāśaḥ>T6 buddheḥ nāśaḥ| <<<<kārya-<na-kārya>Tn>Di-viṣaya>T6-viveka>T6-<na-yogyatā>Tn>T6 antaḥkaraṇasya buddheḥ nāśaḥ ucyate| <buddhi-nāśāt>T6 praṇaśyati| tāvat eva hi puruṣaḥ yāvat antaḥkaraṇam tadīyam <<<<kārya-<na-kārya>Tn>Di-viṣaya>T6-viveka>T6-yogyam>T6| <tat-<na-yogya>Tn>T6^tve naṣṭaḥ eva puruṣaḥ bhavati| ataḥ tasya antaḥkaraṇasya buddheḥ nāśāt praṇaśyati <<puruṣa-artha>T6-<na-yogyaḥ>Tn>T6 bhavati ityarthaḥ||
<sarva-<na-arthasya>Tn>K1 mūlam uktam <viṣaya-abhidhyānam>T6| atha idānīm <mokṣa-kāraṇam>T6 idam ucyate -
<<rāga-dveṣa>Di-viyuktaiḥ>T3 tu viṣayān indriyaiḥ caran| 
<ātman-vaśyaiḥ>T6 <vidheya-ātmā>Bs6 prasādam adhigacchati||2.64||
||2.64|| - <<rāga-dveṣa>Di-viyuktaiḥ>T3 rāgaḥ ca dveṣaḥ ca <rāga-dveṣau>Di, <tat-puraḥsarā>T6 hi indriyāṇām pravṛttiḥ svābhāvikī, tatra yaḥ mumukṣuḥ bhavati saḥ tābhyām viyuktaiḥ <śrotṛ-ādibhiḥ>Bs6 indriyaiḥ viṣayān <na-varjanīyān>Tn caran upalabhamānaḥ <ātman-vaśyaiḥ>T6 ātmanaḥ vaśyāni <vaśa^i-bhūtāni>Tg indriyāṇi taiḥ <ātman-vaśyaiḥ>T6 <vidheya-ātmā>Bs6 icchātaḥ vidheyaḥ ātmā antaḥkaraṇam yasya saḥ ayam prasādam adhigacchati| prasādaḥ prasannatā svāsthyam|| 
prasāde sati kim syāt iti ucyate -
prasāde <sarva-duḥkhānām>K1 hāniḥ asya upajāyate|
<prasanna-cetasaḥ>Bs6 hi āśu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣṭhate||2.65||
||2.65|| - prasāde <sarva-duḥkhānām>K1 <ādhyātmika-ādīnām>Bs6 hāniḥ vināśaḥ asya yateḥ upajāyate| kiñca - <prasanna-cetasaḥ>Bs6 <svastha-antaḥkaraṇasya>Bs6 hi yasmāt āśu śīghram buddhiḥ paryavatiṣṭhate ākāśam iva pari samantāt avatiṣṭhate, <ātman-svarūpeṇa>T6 eva niścalībhavati ityarthaḥ||
evam <prasanna-cetasaḥ>Bs6 <avasthita-buddheḥ>Bs6 <kṛta-kṛtya^tā>Bs3 yataḥ, tasmāt <<rāga-dveṣa>Di-viyuktaiḥ>T3 indriyaiḥ <śāstra-<na-viruddheṣu>Tn>T6 <na-varjanīyeṣu>Tn yuktaḥ samācaret iti <vākya-arthaḥ>T6||
sā iyam prasannatā stūyate -
na asti buddhiḥ <na-yuktasya>Tn na ca <na-yuktasya>Tn bhāvanā| 
na ca <na-bhāvayataḥ>Tn śāntiḥ <na-śāntasya>Tn kutaḥ sukham||2.66||
||2.66|| - na asti na vidyate na bhavati ityarthaḥ, buddhiḥ <<ātman-svarūpa>T6-viṣayā>Bs6 <na-yuktasya>Tn <<na-samāhita>Tn-antaḥkaraṇasya>Bs6| na ca asti <na-yuktasya>Tn bhāvanā <<ātman-jñāna>Tn-abhiniveśaḥ>T6| tathā - na ca asti <na-bhāvayataḥ>Tn <<ātman-jñāna>Tn-abhiniveśam>T6 <na-kurvataḥ>Tn śāntiḥ upaśamaḥ| <na-śāntasya>Tn kutaḥ sukham? indriyāṇām hi <<viṣaya-sevā>T6-tṛṣṇātaḥ>T6 nivṛttiḥ yā tat sukham , na <viṣaya-viṣayā>Bs6 tṛṣṇā| duḥkham eva hi sā| na tṛṣṇāyām satyām sukhasya <gandha-mātram>S api upapadyate ityarthaḥ|| 
<na-yuktasya>Tn kasmāt buddhiḥ na asti iti ucyate -
indriyāṇām hi caratām yat manaḥ anuvidhīyate|
tadasya harati prajñām vāyuḥ nāvam iva ambhasi||2.67||
||2.67|| - indriyāṇām hi yasmāt caratām <<sva-sva>d-viṣayeṣu>T6 pravartamānānām yat manaḥ anuvidhīyate anupravartate tat <<indriya-viṣaya>T6-vikalpanena>T6 pravṛttam manaḥ asya yateḥ harati prajñām <<<ātman-<na-ātma>Tn>Di-viveka>T6-jām>U nāśayati| katham? vāyuḥ nāvam iva ambhasi udake jigamiṣatām mārgāt uddhṛtya unmārge yathā vāyuḥ nāvam pravartayati, evam <ātman-viṣayām>T6 prajñām hṛtvā manaḥ <viṣaya-viṣayām>Bs6 karoti|| 
'yatataḥ hi' iti upanyastasya arthasya anekadhā upapattim uktvā tam ca artham upapādya upasaṃharati - 
tasmāt yasya <mahat-bāho>Bs6 nigṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ| 
indriyāṇi <indriya-arthebhyaḥ>T6 tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā||2.68||
||2.68|| - indriyāṇām pravṛttau doṣaḥ upapāditaḥ yasmāt, tasmāt yasya yateḥ he <mahat-bāho>Bs6, nigṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ <sarva-prakāraiḥ>K1 <<mānasa-ādi>Bs6-bhedaiḥ>K1 indriyāṇi <indriya-arthebhyaḥ>T6 <śabda-ādibhyaḥ>Bs6 tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā||
yaḥ ayam laukikaḥ vaidikaḥ ca vyavahāraḥ saḥ <utpanna-<viveka-jñānasya>T6>Bs6 <sthita-prajñasya>Bs6 <avidyā-kārya^tvāt>T6 <avidyā-nivṛttau>T6 nivartate, avidyāyāḥ ca <vidyā-virodhāt>T6 nivṛttiḥ, iti etam artham sphuṭīkurvan āha -
yā niśā <sarva-bhūtānām>K1 tasyām jāgarti saṃyamī|
yasyām jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyataḥ muneḥ||2.69||
||2.69|| - yā niśā rātriḥ <<sarva-pada>K1-arthānām>T6 <aviveka-karī>U <tamas-svabhāva^tvāt>Bs6 <sarva-bhūtānām>K1 sarveṣām bhūtānām| kim tat <<parama-artha>K1-tattvam>T6 <sthita-prajñasya>Bs6 viṣayaḥ| yathā <naktam-carāṇām>U ahaḥ eva sat anyeṣām niśā bhavati, tadvat <<naktam-cara>U-sthānīyānām>T6 <na-jñānām>Tn <sarva-bhūtānām>K1 niśā iva niśā <<parama-artha>K1-tattvam>T6, <na-gocara^tvāt>Tn <na-<tat-buddhīnām>T6>Bsmn| tasyām <<<parama-artha>K1-tattva>T6-lakṣaṇāyām>Bs6 <ajñāna-nidrāyāḥ>K7 prabuddhaḥ jāgarti saṃyamī saṃyamavān, <jita-indriyaḥ>Bs3 yogī ityarthaḥ| yasyām <<<grāhya-grāhaka>Di-bheda>T6-lakṣaṇāyām>Bs6 <avidyā-niśāyām>K7 prasuptāni eva bhūtāni jāgrati iti ucyante, yasyām niśāyām prasuptāḥ iva <svapna-dṛśaḥ>U, sā niśā <avidyā-rūpatvāt>T6 <<parama-artha>K1-tattvam>T6 paśyataḥ muneḥ|| 
ataḥ karmāṇi <avidyā-avasthāyām>T6 eva codyante, na <vidyā-avasthāyām>T6| vidyāyām hi satyām udite savitari śārvaram iva tamaḥ praṇāśam upagacchati avidyā| prāk vidyotpatteḥ avidyā <pramāṇa-buddhyā>T6 gṛhyamāṇā <<<<kriyā-kāraka>Di-phala>T6-bheda>T7-rūpā>Bs6 satī <<sarva-karma>K1-hetu^tvam>T6 pratipadyate| na <<na-pramāṇa>Tn-buddhyā>T6 gṛhyamāṇāyāḥ <<karman-hetu^tva>T6-upapattiḥ>T6, '<pramāṇa-bhūtena>T2 vedena mama coditam kartavyam karma' iti hi karmaṇi kartā pravartate, na '<avidyā-mātram>S idam sarvam niśā iva' iti| yasya punaḥ 'niśā iva <avidyā-mātram>S idam sarvam <bheda-jātam>T3' iti jñānam tasya <ātman-jñasya>U <<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāse>T6 eva adhikāraḥ na pravṛttau| tathā ca darśayiṣyati - <tat-buddhayaḥ>Bs6 <tat-ātmānaḥ>Bs6' ityādinā <jñāna-niṣṭhāyām>T7 eva tasya adhikāram|| 
tatra api <<pravartaka-pramāṇa>T6-<na-bhāve>Tn>T6 <pravṛtti-<na-upapattiḥ>Tn>T6 iti cet, na; <<sva-ātma>T6-viṣaya^tvāt>T6 <ātman-vijñānasya>T6| na hi ātmanaḥ <sva-ātmani>T6 <<pravartaka-pramāṇa>T6-apekṣatā>T6, ātmatvāt eva| <tat-anta^tvāt>Bs6 ca <sarva-pramāṇānām>K1 pramāṇatvasya| na hi <<ātman-svarūpa>T6-adhigame>T6 sati punaḥ <<pramāṇa-prameya>Di-vyavahāraḥ>T6 saṃbhavati| pramātṛtvam hi ātmanaḥ nivartayati antyam pramāṇam; nivartayat eva ca <na-pramāṇībhavati>Tn, <<svapna-kāla>T6-pramāṇam>T7 iva prabodhe| loke ca <vastu-adhigame>T6 <<pravṛtti-hetu^tva>T6-<na-darśanāt>Tn>T6 pramāṇasya| tasmāt na <ātman-vidaḥ>U karmaṇi adhikāraḥ iti siddham||
viduṣaḥ <tyakta-eṣaṇasya>Bs3 <sthita-prajñasya>Bs6 yateḥ eva <mokṣa-prāptiḥ>T6, na tu <na-saṃnyāsinaḥ>Tn <kāma-kāminaḥ>U iti etam artham dṛṣṭāntena pratipādayiṣyan āha -
āpūryamāṇam <<na-cala>Tn-pratiṣṭham>Bs6 samudram āpaḥ praviśanti yadvat| 
tadvat kāmā yam praviśanti sarve sa śāntim āpnoti na <kāma-kāmī>U||2.70||
||2.70|| - āpūryamāṇam adbhiḥ <<na-cala>Tn-pratiṣṭham>Bs6 <na-calatayā>Tn pratiṣṭhā avasthitiḥ yasya tam <acala-pratiṣṭham>Bs6 samudram āpaḥ sarvataḥ gatāḥ praviśanti <<sva-ātma>T6-stham>U <na-vikriyam>Tn eva santam yadvat, tadvat kāmāḥ <viṣaya-saṃnidhau>T6 api sarvataḥ <icchā-viśeṣāḥ>T6 yam puruṣam ? samudram iva āpaḥ - <na-vikurvantaḥ>Tn praviśanti sarve ātmani eva pralīyante na <<sva-ātma>T6-vaśam>T6 kurvanti, saḥ śāntim mokṣam āpnoti, na itaraḥ <kāma-kāmī>U, kāmyante iti kāmāḥ viṣayāḥ tān kāmayitum śīlam yasya saḥ <kāma-kāmī>U, na eva prāpnoti ityarthaḥ||
yasmāt evam tasmāt -
vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumān carati <nir-spṛhaḥ>Bs6|
<nir-mamaḥ>Bsmn <nir-ahaṃkāraḥ>Bsmn saḥ śāntim adhigacchati||2.71||
||2.71|| - vihāya parityajya kāmān yaḥ saṃnyāsī pumān sarvān <na-śeṣataḥ>Tn kārtsnyena carati, <<<jīvana-mātra>S-ceṣṭā>T6-śeṣaḥ>Bs6 paryaṭati ityarthaḥ| <nir-spṛhaḥ>Bs6 <<śarīra-<jīvana-mātre>S>T6 api nirgatā spṛhā yasya saḥ <nir-spṛhaḥ>Bs6 san, <nir-mamaḥ>Bsmn <<<śarīra-jīvana>T6-mātra>S-ākṣipta-parigrahe>Bb api mama idam iti <abhiniveśa-varjitaḥ>Bs3, <nir-ahaṃkāraḥ>Bsmn <<<<vidyāvattva-ādi>Bs6-nimitta>K1-<ātman-saṃbhāvanā>T6>T3-rahitaḥ>T3 ityetat| saḥ <evam-bhūtaḥ>S <sthita-prajñaḥ>Bs6 <brahma-vit>U śāntim <<<<sarva-saṃsāra>K1-duḥkha>T6-uparama>T6-lakṣaṇām>Bs6 <nirvāṇa-ākhyām>Bs6 adhigacchati prāpnoti <brahma-bhūtaḥ>U bhavati ityarthaḥ|| 
sā eṣā <jñāna-niṣṭhā>T6 stūyate -
eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha na enām prāpya vimuhyati| 
sthitvā asyām <anta-kāle>K1 api <brahma-nirvāṇam>T7 ṛcchati||2.72||
||2.72|| - eṣā <yathā-ukta>A1^a brāhmī brahmaṇi bhavā iyam sthitiḥ sarvam karma saṃnyasya <brahma-rūpeṇa>T6 eva avasthānam ityetat| he pārtha, na enām sthitim prāpya labdhvā na vimuhyati na moham prāpnoti| sthitvā asyām sthitau brāhmyām <yathā-ukta>A1^āyām <anta-kāle>K1 api antye vayasi api <brahma-nirvāṇam>T7 <brahma-nirvṛtim>T7 mokṣam ṛcchati gacchati| kimu vaktavyam brahmacaryāt eva saṃnyasya <yāvat-jīvam>A1 yaḥ brahmaṇi eva avatiṣṭhate saḥ brahmanirvāṇam ṛcchati iti||
OṂ tatsat iti <śrīmat-<bhagavat-gītāsu>T6>K1 upaniṣatsu <brahma-vidyāyām>T6 <yoga-śāstre>K7 <<śrīkṛṣṇa-arjuna>Di-saṃvāde>T6 <sāṃkhya-yogaḥ>K6 nāma dvitīyaḥ adhyāyaḥ||
iti 
śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau śrīmadbhagavadgītābhāṣye dvitīyaḥ adhyāyaḥ||

śāstrasya <<<pravṛtti-nivṛtti>Di-viṣaya>K6-bhūte>T2 dve buddhī bhagavatā nirdiṣṭe, sāṅkhye buddhiḥ, yoge buddhiḥ, iti ca| tatra 'prajahāti yadā kāmān' ityārabhya ā <adhyāya-parisamāpteḥ>T6, <<sāṅkhya-buddhi>T7-āśritānām>T2 saṃnyāsam kartavyam uktvā, teṣām <tat-niṣṭhatayā>T7 eva ca kṛtārthatā uktā - 'eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ' iti| arjunāya ca, 'karmaṇi eva adhikāraḥ te ... mā te saṅgaḥ astu <na-karmaṇi>Tn' iti karma eva kartavyam uktavān <yoga-buddhim>T7 āśritya, na tataḥ eva <śreyas-prāptim>T6 uktavān| tadetat ālakṣya, <paryākula^i-kṛta>Tg-buddhiḥ>Bs6 arjunaḥ uvāca| katham bhaktāya <śreyas-arthine>U, yat sākṣāt <<śreyas-prāpti>T6-sādhanam>T6 <<sāṅkhya-buddhi>T7-niṣṭhām>T7 śrāvayitvā, mām karmaṇi <<dṛṣṭa-<aneka-<na-artha>Tn>K1>K1-yukte>T3 pāramparyeṇa api <<<<na-ekāntika>Tn-śreyaḥ>K1-prāpti>T6-kāle>T6 niyuñjyāt, iti yuktaḥ paryākulībhāvaḥ arjunasya, <tat-anurūpaḥ>T6 ca praśnaḥ 'jyāyasī cet' ityādiḥ, <<praśna-apākaraṇa>T6-vākyam>T6 ca bhagavataḥ yuktam , yathā uktam <vibhāga-viṣaye>T6 śāstre||
kecit tu - arjunasya <praśna-artham>T6 anyathā kalpayitvā, <tat-pratikūlam>T6 bhagavataḥ prativacanam varṇayanti, yathā ca ātmanā <saṃbandha-granthe>T6 <gītā-arthe>T6 nirūpitaḥ, <tat-pratikūlam>T6 ca iha punaḥ <praśna-prativacanayoḥ>Di artham nirūpayanti| katham? tatra <saṃbandha-granthe>T6 tāvat - sarveṣām āśramiṇām <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di samuccayaḥ <gītā-śāstre>K7 nirūpitaḥ arthaḥ iti uktam; punaḥ viśeṣitam ca, <<<yāvat-jīva>A1śruti>S-coditāni>T3 karmāṇi parityajya, kevalāt eva jñānāt mokṣaḥ prāpyate, ityetat ekāntena eva pratiṣiddham iti| iha tu āśramavikalpam darśayitvā, yāvajjīvaśruticoditānām eva karmaṇām parityāgaḥ uktaḥ| tat katham īdṛśam viruddham artham arjunāya brūyāt bhagavān, śrotā vā katham viruddham artham avadhārayet|| 
tatra etat syāt - gṛhasthānām eva <<śrauta-karma>K1-parityāgena>T6 kevalāt eva jñānāt mokṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na tu <āśrama-antarāṇām>Tm iti| etat api <<pūrva-uttara>Ds-viruddham>T6 eva| katham? <sarva-āśrama>K1^iṇām <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di samuccayaḥ <gītā-śāstre>K7 niścitaḥ arthaḥ iti pratijñāya, iha katham <tat-viruddham>T6 kevalāt eva jñānāt mokṣam brūyāt <āśrama-antarāṇām>Tm||
atha matam <<śrauta-karma>K1-apekṣayā>T6 <etad-vacanam>K1, 'kevalāt eva jñānāt <<śrauta-karma>K1-rahitāt>T3 gṛhasthānām mokṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate' iti tatra gṛhasthānām vidyamānam api smārtam karma <na-vidyamāna^vat>Tn upekṣya, 'jñānāt eva kevalāt' iti ucyate iti| etat api viruddham| katham? gṛhasthasya eva <smārta-karmaṇā>K1 samuccitāt jñānāt mokṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na tu <āśrama-antarāṇām>Tm iti, katham vivekibhiḥ śakyam avadhārayitum| kiñca - yadi <mokṣa-sādhana^tvena>T6 smārtāni karmāṇi <ūrdhva-retasām>Bs6 samuccīyate, tathā gṛhasthasya api iṣyatām smārtaiḥ eva samuccayaḥ na śrautaiḥ||
atha śrautaiḥ smārtaiḥ ca gṛhasthasya eva samuccayaḥ mokṣāya, <ūrdhva-retasām>Bs6 tu <<<smārta-karma>K1-mātra>S-samuccitāt>T3 jñānāt mokṣaḥ iti| tatra evam sati, gṛhasthasya <āyāsa-bāhulyāt>T6, śrautam smārtam ca <<bahu-duḥkha>K1-rūpam>Bs6 karma śirasi āropitam syāt||

siddhaḥ tarhi <sarva-āśrama>K1^iṇām <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di samuccayaḥ - na, mumukṣoḥ <<<sarva-karma>K1-saṃnyāsa>T6-vidhānāt>T6| '<putra-eṣaṇāyāḥ>T6 <vitta-eṣaṇāyāḥ>T6 ca <loka-eṣaṇāyāḥ>T6 ca vyutthāya atha <bhikṣā-caryam>T6 caranti', 'tasmāt nyāsameṣām tamasāmatiriktamāhuḥ', 'nyāsa evātyareca yat' iti, 'na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ' iti ca| 'brahmacaryāt eva pravrajet' ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ| 'tyaja dharmam <na-dharmam>Tn ca ubhe <satya-anṛte>Di tyaja| ubhe <satya-anṛte>Di tyaktvā yena tyajasi tat tyaja| saṃsāram eva <nir-sāram>Bsmn dṛṣṭvā <sāra-didṛkṣayā>T6| pravrajanti <<na-kṛta>Tn-udvāhāḥ>Bs3 param vairāgyam āśritāḥ' iti brahaspatiḥ| 'karmaṇā badhyate jantuḥ vidyayā ca vimucyate| tasmāt karma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ' iti <śuka-anuśāsanam>T6| iha api ca '<sarva-karmāṇi>K1 manasā saṃnyasya' ityādi||
mokṣasya ca <na-kāryatvāt>Tn, mumukṣoḥ <karman-ānarthakyam>T6| nityāni <<pratyavāya-parihāra>T6-arthāni>T4 iti cet, na; <<na-saṃnyāsi>Tn-viṣayatvāt>T6 <pratyavāya-prāpteḥ>T6| na hi, <<agnikārya-ādi>Bs6-<na-karaṇāt>Tn>T6 saṃnyāsinaḥ pratyavāyaḥ kalpayitum śakyaḥ, yathā <brahma-cāriṇām>U <na-saṃnyāsinām>Tn api karmiṇām| na tāvat nityānām karmaṇām abhāvāt eva, <bhāva-rūpasya>T6 pratyavāyasya utpattiḥ kalpayitum śakyā, 'katham asataḥ sat jāyeta' iti, asataḥ <<<sat-janma>T6-<na-saṃbhava>Tn>T6-śruteḥ>T6| yadi <vihita-<na-karaṇāt>Tn>T6 <na-saṃbhāvyam>Tn api pratyavāyam brūyāt vedaḥ, tadā <<na-artha>Tn-karaḥ>U vedaḥ <na-pramāṇam>Tn iti uktam syāt; vihitasya <karaṇa-<na-karaṇayoḥ>Tn>Di <<duḥkha-mātra>S-phala^tvāt>T6| tathā ca kārakam śāstram, na jñāpakam, iti <<na-upapanna>Tn-artham>K1 kalpitam syāt| na ca etat iṣṭam| tasmāt na saṃnyāsinām karmāṇi| ataḥ <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di <samaccaya-<na-upapattiḥ>Tn>T6; 'jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te matā buddhiḥ' iti, arjunasya <praśna-<na-upapatteḥ>Tn>T6 ca||
yadi hi bhagavatā dvitīye adhyāye jñānam karma ca samuccitya tvayā anuṣṭheyam ityuktam syāt, tataḥ arjunasya praśnaḥ <na-upapannaḥ>Tn 'jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te matā buddhiḥ' iti| arjunāya cet <buddhi-karmaṇī>Di tvayā anuṣṭheye ityukte, yā karmaṇaḥ jyāyasī buddhiḥ sā api uktā eva iti, 'tat kim karmaṇi ghore mām niyojayasi keśava' iti upālambhaḥ praśnaḥ vā na kathañcana upapadyate| na ca, arjunasya eva jyāyasī buddhiḥ na anuṣṭheyā iti bhagavatā uktam pūrvam iti, kalpayitum yuktam, yena 'jyāyasī cet' iti vivekataḥ praśnaḥ syāt||
yadi punaḥ ekasya puruṣasya <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di virodhāt yugapat anuṣṭhānam na saṃbhavati iti, <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheyatvam>T3 bhagavatā pūrvam uktam syāt, tataḥ ayam praśnaḥ upapannaḥ 'jyāyasī cet' ityādiḥ| <na-vivekataḥ>Tn <praśna-kalpanāyām>T6 api, <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheyatvena>T3 <<jñāna-karma>Di-niṣṭhayoḥ>T7 bhagavataḥ <prati-vacanam>Tp na upapadyate| na ca <ajñāna-nimittam>K1 <bhagavat-<prati-vacanam>Tp>T6 kalpanīyam| asmāt ca <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheyatvena>T3 <<jñāna-karma>Di-niṣṭhayoḥ>T7 bhagavataḥ <<prati-vacana>Tp-darśanāt>T6 <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di <samuccaya-<na-upapattiḥ>Tn>T6| tasmāt, kevalāt eva jñānāt mokṣaḥ ityeṣaḥ arthaḥ niścitaḥ gītāsu, <sarva-upaniṣatsu>K1 ca||
<jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di 'ekam vada niścitya' iti ca, <eka-viṣayā>Bs6 eva prārthanā <na-upapannā>Tn, ubhayoḥ <samuccaya-saṃbhave>T6| 'kuru karma eva tasmāt tvam' iti ca, <<jñāna-niṣṭhā>T7-saṃbhavam>T6 arjunasya avadhāraṇena darśayiṣyati||
arjunaḥ uvāca
jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te matā buddhiḥ janārdana|
tat kim karmaṇi ghore mām niyojayasi keśava||3.1||
||3.1|| - jyāyasī śreyasī cet yadi karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt te tava matā abhipretā buddhiḥ jñānam he janārdana| yadi <buddhi-karmaṇī>Di samuccite iṣṭe tadā ekam <śreyas-sādhanam>T6 iti karmaṇaḥ jyāyasī buddhiḥ iti karmaṇaḥ <atirikta-karaṇam>T6 buddheḥ <na-upapannam>Tn arjunena kṛtam syāt; na hi tadeva tasmāt phalataḥ atiriktam syāt| tathā ca, karmaṇaḥ śreyaskarī bhagavatā uktā buddhiḥ, <na-śreyaskaram>Tn ca karma kuru iti mām pratipādayati, tat kim nu kāraṇam iti bhagavataḥ upālambham iva kurvan tat kim kasmāt karmaṇi ghore krūre <hiṃsā-lakṣaṇe>Bs6 mām niyojayasi keśava iti ca yat āha, tat ca na upapadyate| atha smārtena eva karmaṇā samuccayaḥ sarveṣām bhagavatā uktaḥ arjunena ca avadhāritaḥ cet, 'tat kim karmaṇi ghore mām niyojayasi' (gītā 3.1) ityādi katham yuktam vacanam||
kiñca ?
vyāmiśreṇa iva vākyena buddhim mohayasi iva me|
tat ekam vada niścitya yena śreyaḥ aham āpnuyām||3.2||
||3.2|| - vyāmiśreṇa iva, yadyapi <vivikta-abhidhāyī>T6 bhagavān, tathāpi mama <manda-buddheḥ>Bs6 vyāmiśram iva <bhagavat-vākyam>T6 pratibhāti| tena mama buddhim mohayasi iva, mama <<buddhi-vyāmoha>T6-apanayāya>T6 hi pravṛttaḥ tvam tu katham mohayasi? ataḥ bravīmi buddhim mohayasi iva me mama iti| tvam tu <bhinna-kartṛkayoḥ>K1 <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di <<<eka-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭhāna>T6-<na-saṃbhavam>Tn>T6 yadi manyase, tatra evam sati tat tayoḥ ekam buddhim karma vā idam eva arjunasya yogyam <<buddhi-śakti-avasthā>Di-<anu-rūpam>A1>T6 iti niścitya vada brūhi, yena jñānena karmaṇā vā anyatareṇa śreyaḥ aham āpnuyām prāpnuyām; iti yat uktam tat api na upapadyate|| 
yadi hi <karman-niṣṭhāyām>T7 <guṇa-bhūtam>T2 api jñānam bhagavatā uktam syāt, tat katham tayoḥ 'ekam vada' iti <eka-viṣayā>Bs6 eva arjunasya śuśrūṣā syāt| na hi bhagavatā pūrvam uktam 'anyatarat eva <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di vakṣyāmi, na eva dvayam' iti, yena <<ubhaya-prāpti>T6-<na-saṃbhavam>Tn>T6 ātmanaḥ manyamānaḥ ekam eva prārthayet|| 
<praśna-<anu-rūpam>A1>T6 eva <prati-vacanam>Tp śrībhagavān uvāca -

||3.3|| - loke asmin <<śāstra-artha>T6-anuṣṭhāna>T6-adhikṛtānām>T7 traivarṇikānām dvividhā <dvi-prakārā>Bs6 niṣṭhā sthitiḥ <anuṣṭheya-tātparyam>T6 purā pūrvam <sarga-ādau>T6 prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā tāsām <<<abhyudaya-niḥśreyasa>Di-prāpti>T7-sādhanam>T6 <<veda-artha>T6-saṃpradāyam>T6 āviṣkurvatā proktā mayā <sarva-jñena>U īśvareṇa he <na-agha>Bs6 <na-pāpa>Bs6| tatra kā sā dvividhā niṣṭhā iti āha - tatra <jñāna-yogena>K6 jñānam eva yogaḥ tena sāṃkhyānām <<<<ātman-<na-ātma>Tn>Di-viṣaya>T6-viveka>T6-vijñāna^vatām>T6 <brahmacarya-āśramāt>T6 eva <kṛta-saṃnyāsānām>Bs3 <<vedānta-vijñāna>T6-suniścita-arthānām>Bb <paramahaṃsa-parivrājakānām>K1 brahmaṇi eva avasthitānām niṣṭhā proktā| <karman-yogena>K6 karma eva yogaḥ <karman-yogaḥ>K6 tena <karman-yogena>K6 yoginām karmiṇām niṣṭhā proktā ityarthaḥ| yadi ca ekena puruṣeṇa ekasmai puruṣārthāya jñānam karma ca samuccitya anuṣṭheyam bhagavatā iṣṭam uktam vakṣyamāṇam vā gītāsu vedeṣu ca uktam, katham iha arjunāya upasannāya priyāya <<<viśiṣṭa-bhinna>T5-puruṣa>K1-kartṛke>T6 eva <<jñāna-karma>Di-niṣṭhe>T7 brūyāt? yadi punaḥ 'arjunaḥ jñānam karma ca dvayam śrutvā svayam eva anuṣṭhāsyati anyeṣām tu <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheyatām>T6 vakṣyāmi iti' matam bhagavataḥ kalpyeta, tadā <rāga-dveṣa>Di^vān <na-<pramāṇa-bhūtaḥ>T2>Tn bhagavān kalpitaḥ syāt| tat ca <na-yuktam>Tn| tasmāt kayā api yuktyā na samuccayaḥ <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di||
yat arjunena uktam karmaṇaḥ jyāyastvam buddheḥ tat ca sthitam, <na-nirākaraṇāt>Tn| tasyāḥ ca <jñāna-niṣṭhāyāḥ>T7 saṃnyāsinām eva anuṣṭheyatvam , <<<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheya^tva>T3-vacanāt>T6| bhagavataḥ evam eva anumatam iti gamyate||
'mām ca <bandha-kāraṇe>T6 karmaṇi eva niyojayasi' iti <viṣaṇṇa-manasam>Bs6 arjunam 'karma na ārabhe' ityevam manvānam ālakṣya āha bhagavān - na karmaṇām <na-ārambhāt>Tn iti| athavā - <<jñāna-karma>Di-niṣṭhayoḥ>T7 <paraspara-virodhāt>T6 ekena puruṣeṇa yugapat anuṣṭhātum aśakyatve sati <<itara-itara>Di-<na-apekṣayoḥ>Tn>T6 eva <puruṣārtha-hetu^tve>T6 prāpte <karman-niṣṭhāyāḥ>T7 <<<jñāna-niṣṭhā>T7-prāpti>T6-hetu^tvena>T6 <puruṣārtha-hetu^tvam>T6, na svātantryeṇa; <jñāna-niṣṭhā>T7 tu <<<<karman-niṣṭhā>T7-upāya>T6-labdha>T3-ātmi^kā>Bs6 satī svātantryeṇa <puruṣārtha-hetuḥ>T6 <anya-<na-apekṣā>Tn>Bs6, ityetam artham pradarśayiṣyan āha bhagavān -
na karmaṇām <na-ārambhāt>Tn naiṣkarmyam puruṣaḥ aśnute|

||3.4|| - na karmaṇām kriyāṇām <yajña-ādīnām>Bs6 iha janmani <janman-antare>Tm vā anuṣṭhitānām <<<upātta-durita>K1-kṣaya>T6-hetu^tvena>T6 <<sattva-śuddhi>T6-kāraṇānām>T6 <tat-kāraṇa^tvena>T6 ca <<jñāna-utpatti>T6-dvāreṇa>T6 <<jñāna-niṣṭhā>T7-hetūnām>T6, 'jñānam utpadyate puṃsām kṣayāt pāpasya karmaṇaḥ| yathā <<<ādarśa-tala>T6-prakhye>T7 paśyati ātmānam ātmani' (mahā0 śānti0 204|8) <ityādi-smaraṇāt>T6, <na-ārambhāt>Tn <na-anuṣṭhānāt>Tn naiṣkarmyam <niṣkarman-bhāvam>T6 <karman-śūnyatām>T6 <jñāna-yogena>K6 niṣṭhām <niṣkriya-<ātman-svarūpeṇa>T6>K1 eva avasthānam iti yāvat| puruṣaḥ na aśnute na prāpnoti ityarthaḥ||

nanu ca '<na-bhayam>Tn <sarva-bhūtebhyaḥ>K1 dattvā naiṣkarmyam ācaret' ityādau <<kartavya-karma>K1-saṃnyāsāt>T6 api <naiṣkarmya-prāptim>T6 darśayati| loke ca karmaṇām <na-ārambhāt>Tn naiṣkarmyam iti prasiddhataram| ataḥ ca <naiṣkarmya-arthinaḥ>U kim <karman-ārambheṇa>T6? iti prāptam| ataḥ āha - na ca saṃnyasanāt eva iti| na api saṃnyasanāt eva kevalāt <<karman-parityāga>T6-mātrāt>S eva <jñāna-rahitāt>T3 siddhim <naiṣkarmya-lakṣaṇām>Bs6 <jñāna-yogena>K6 niṣṭhām samadhigacchati na prāpnoti||

||3.5|| - na hi yasmāt kṣaṇam api kālam jātu kadācit kaścit tiṣṭhati <na-<karman-kṛt>U>Tn san| kasmāt? kāryate pravartyate hi yasmāt <na-vaśaḥ>Tn eva <na-svatantraḥ>Tn eva karma sarvaḥ prāṇī <prakṛti-jaiḥ>U prakṛtitaḥ jātaiḥ <sattva-rajas-tamobhiḥ>Di guṇaiḥ| <na-jñaḥ>U iti <vākya-śeṣaḥ>T6, yataḥ vakṣyati 'guṇaiḥ yaḥ na vicālyate' iti| sāṃkhyānām pṛthak karaṇāt <na-jñānām>Tn eva hi <karman-yogaḥ>K6, na jñāninām| jñāninām tu guṇaiḥ <na-cālyamānānām>Tn svataḥ <calana-abhāvāt>T6 <karman-yogaḥ>K6 na upapadyate| tathā ca vyākhyātam 'veda <na-vināśinam>Tn' ityatra||

||4.3|| - saḥ eva ayam mayā te tubhyam adya idānīm yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ bhaktaḥ asi me sakhā ca asi iti| rahasyam hi yasmāt tat uttamam yogaḥ jñānam ityarthaḥ||

||4.4|| - aparam arvāk <vasudeva-gṛhe>T6 bhavataḥ janma| param pūrvam <sarga-ādau>T6 janma utpattiḥ vivasvataḥ ādityasya| tat katham etat vijānīyām <na-<viruddha-artha^tayā>K1>Tn, yaḥ tvam eva ādau proktavān imam yogam saḥ eva idānīm mahyam proktavān asi iti||

||4.5|| - bahūni me mama vyatītāni atikrāntāni janmāni tava ca he arjuna| tāni aham veda jāne sarvāṇi na tvam vettha na jānīṣe,       <<<<<dharma-adharme>Di-ādi>Bs6-pratibaddha>T3-jñāna>K1-śakti^tvāt>T6| aham punaḥ <<nitya-śuddha-buddha-mukta>Di-svabhāva^tvāt>Bs6 <<<na-āvaraṇa>Tn-jñāna>Tn-śaktiḥ>Bs6 iti veda aham he <param-tapa>U||

||4.7|| - yadā yadā hi dharmasya glāniḥ hāniḥ <<<varṇa-āśrama>Di-ādi>Bs6-lakṣaṇasya>Bs6 prāṇinām <<abhyudaya-niḥśreyasa>Di-sādhanasya>T6 bhavati bhārata, abhyutthānam udbhavaḥ adharmasya, tadā tadā ātmānam sṛjāmi aham māyayā||

||4.10|| - <vīta-<rāga-bhaya-krodhāḥ>Di>Bs5 rāgaḥ ca bhayam ca krodhaḥ ca vītāḥ vigatāḥ yebhyaḥ te <vīta-<rāga-bhaya-krodhāḥ>Di>Bs5 manmayāḥ <brahma-vidaḥ>U <īśvara-<abheda-darśinaḥ>U>T7 mām eva ca <parama-īśvaram>K! upāśritāḥ <kevala-<jñāna-niṣṭhāḥ>Bv>S ityarthaḥ| bahavaḥ aneke <jñāna-tapasā>K6 jñānam eva ca <<parama-ātma>K1-viṣayam>T6 tapaḥ tena <jñāna-tapasā>K6 pūtāḥ parām śuddhim gatāḥ santaḥ <asmad-bhāvam>T6 <īśvara-bhāvam>T6 mokṣam āgatāḥ samanuprāptāḥ| <<<<itara-tapo>K1-nirapekṣa>T6-jñāna>K1-niṣṭhāḥ>Bv ityasya liṅgam '<jñāna-tapasā>K6' iti viśeṣaṇam||

yadi tava īśvarasya <<<rāga-ādi>Bs6-doṣa>K1-abhāvāt>T6 <sarva{3}-prāṇiṣu>K1 anujighṛkṣāyām tulyāyām <<<sarva{3}-phala>K1-pradāna>T6-samarthe>T7 ca tvayi sati 'vāsudevaḥ sarvam' iti jñānena eva mumukṣavaḥ santaḥ kasmāt tvām eva sarve na pratipadyante iti? śṛṇu tatra kāraṇam -

||4.12|| - kāṅkṣantaḥ abhīpsantaḥ karmaṇām siddhim <phala-niṣpattim>T6 prārthayantaḥ yajante iha asmin loke devatāḥ <<indra-agni>Di-ādyāḥ>Bs6;    'atha yaḥ anyām devatām upāste anyaḥ asau anyaḥ aham asmi iti na saḥ vedaḥ yathā paśurevam saḥ devānām (bṛ0 u0 1.4.10)' iti śruteḥ| teṣām hi <<bhinna-devatā>K1-yājinām>U <phala-ākāṅkṣiṇām>T6 kṣipram śīghram hi yasmāt mānuṣe loke, <manuṣya{3}-loke>T6 hi <śāstra-adhikāraḥ>T6| 'kṣipram hi mānuṣe loke' iti viśeṣaṇāt anyeṣu api <<karman-phala>T6-siddhim>T6 darśayati bhagavān| mānuṣe loke <<<varṇa-āśrama>Di-ādi>BS6-karmāṇi>K1 iti viśeṣaḥ, teṣām ca <<varṇa-āśrama>Di-ādi>BS6 <adhikārin-karmaṇām>T6 <phala-siddhiḥ>T6 kṣipram bhavati| <karman-jā>U karmaṇaḥ jātā||

||4.13|| - catvāraḥ eva varṇāḥ <cātur-varṇyam>TDs mayā īśvareṇa sṛṣṭam utpāditam, 'brāhmaṇaḥ asya mukham āsīt' <<iti-ādi>Bs6-śruteḥ>K1| <<guṇa-karma>Di-vibhāgaśaḥ>T6 <guṇa-vibhāgaśaḥ>T6 <karman-vibhāgaśaḥ>T6 ca| guṇāḥ <sattva-rajas-tamāṃsi>Di| tatra sāttvikasya <sattva-pradhānasya>T6 brāhmaṇasya 'śamaḥ damaḥ tapaḥ' <iti-ādīni>Bs6 karmāṇi, <<sattva-upasarjana>S-<rajas-pradhānasya>S>Bs6 kṣatriyasya <<śaurya-tejaḥ>Di-prabhṛtīni>Bs6 karmāṇi, <<tamas-upasarjana>S-<rajas-pradhānasya>S>Bs6 vaiśyasya <kṛṣi-ādīni>Bs6 karmāṇi, <<rajas-upasarjana>S-<tamas-pradhānasya>S>Bs6 śūdrasya śuśrūṣā eva karma ityevam <<guṇa-karma>Di-vibhāgaśaḥ>T6 <cātur-varṇyam>TDs mayā sṛṣṭam ityarthaḥ| tat ca idam <cātur-varṇyam>TDs na anyeṣu lokeṣu, ataḥ mānuṣe loke iti viśeṣaṇam| hanta tarhi <cātur-varṇyasya>TDs <sarga-ādeḥ>Bs6 karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvāt tat phalena yujyase, ataḥ na tvam <nitya-muktaḥ>S <nitya-īśvaraḥ>S ca iti? ucyate - yadyapi <māyā-saṃvyavahāreṇa>T6 tasya karmaṇaḥ kartāram api santam mām <parama-arthataḥ>K1 viddhi <na-kartāram>Tn| ataḥ eva avyayam <na-saṃsāriṇam>Tn ca mām viddhi||

||4.14|| - na mām tāni karmāṇi limpanti <deha-ādi>Bs6 ārambhakatvena, <ahaṃkāra-abhāvāt>T6| na ca teṣām karmaṇām phaleṣu me mama spṛhā tṛṣṇā| yeṣām tu saṃsāriṇām' aham kartā' iti abhimānaḥ karmasu, spṛhā tat phaleṣu ca, tān karmāṇi limpanti iti yuktam, <tad-abhāvāt>T6 na mām karmāṇi limpanti| iti evam yaḥ anyaḥ api mām ātmatvena abhijānāti' na aham kartā na me <karman-phale>T6 spṛhā' iti saḥ karmabhiḥ na badhyate, tasya api na <deha-ādi>Bs6 ārambhakāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti ityarthaḥ||

||4.15|| - evam jñātvā kṛtam karma pūrvaiḥ api atikrāntaiḥ mumukṣubhiḥ| kuru tena karma eva tvam, na tūṣṇīm āsanam na api saṃnyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ, tasmāt tvam pūrvaiḥ api anuṣṭhitatvāt, yadi <na-<ātman-jñaḥ>U>Tn tvam tadā <<ātman-śuddhi>T6-artham>T4, <tattva-vit>U cet <<loka-saṃgraha>T6-artham>T4 pūrvaiḥ <janaka-ādibhiḥ>Bs6 pūrvataram kṛtam na adhunātanam kṛtam nirvartitam||

||4.16|| - kim karma kim ca akarma iti kavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ api atra asmin <<karman-ādi>Bs6-viṣaye>Bs6 mohitāḥ moham gatāḥ| tat ataḥ te tubhyam aham karma akarma ca pravakṣyāmi, yat jñātvā viditvā <karman-ādi>Bs6 mokṣyase <na-śubhāt>Tn saṃsārāt||

||4.17|| - karmaṇaḥ <śāstra-vihitasya>T3 hi yasmāt api asti boddhavyam, boddhavyam ca asti eva vikarmaṇaḥ pratiṣiddhasya, tathā akarmaṇaḥ ca tūṣṇīṃbhāvasya boddhavyam asti iti triṣu api adhyāhāraḥ kartavyaḥ| yasmāt gahanā viṣamā durjñeyā - karmaṇaḥ iti <upalakṣaṇa-artham>T4 <karman-ādīnām>Bs6 ? <karman-akarman-vikarmaṇām>Di gatiḥ yāthātmyam tattvam ityarthaḥ||

nanu kim idam viruddham ucyate 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet ' iti 'akarmaṇi ca karma' iti; na hi karma akarma syāt, akarma vā karma| tatra viruddham katham paśyet draṣṭā? - na, akarma eva <parama-arthataḥ>K1 sat karmavat avabhāsate <mūḍha-dṛṣṭeḥ>Bs6 lokasya, tathā karma eva akarmavat| tatra <<<yathā-bhūta>T2-darśana>K1-artham>T4 āha bhagavān - karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet (gītā 4.18) ityādi| ataḥ na viruddham| buddhimattvādi upapatteḥ ca| 'boddhavyam' iti ca <<yathā-bhūta>T2-darśanam>K1 ucyate| na ca <viparīta-jñānāt>K1 <na-śubhāt>Tn mokṣaṇam syāt; 'yat jñātvā mokṣyase <na-śubhāt>Tn' (gītā 4.16) iti ca uktam| tasmāt <karman-akarmaṇī>Di viparyayeṇa gṛhīte prāṇibhiḥ <<<<tad-viparyaya>T6-grahaṇa>T6-nivṛtti>T6-artham>T4 bhagavataḥ vacanam 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ' ityādi| na ca atra <karman-adhikaraṇam>T6 akarma asti, kuṇḍe badarāṇi iva| na api <akarman-adhikaraṇam>T6 karma asti, <karman-abhāva^tvāt>T6 akarmaṇaḥ| ataḥ <viparīta-gṛhīte>T3 eva <karman-akarmaṇī>Di laukikaiḥ, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikāyām udakam śuktikāyām vā rajatam| nanu karma karma eva sarveṣām na kvacit vyabhicarati - tat na, nausthasya nāvi gacchantyām <taṭa-stheṣu>U <na-gatiṣu>Bsmn nageṣu <<pratikūla-gati>K1-darśanāt>T6, dūreṣu cakṣuṣā <na-saṃnikṛṣṭeṣu>Tn gacchatsu <<gati-abhāva>T6-darśanāt>T6 , evam iha api akarmaṇi <karman-darśanam>T6 karmaṇi ca <akarman-darśanam>T6 <viparīta-darśanam>T6 yena <<tad-nirākaraṇa>T6-artham>T6 ucyate 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet' ityādi||
tadetat <ukta-<prati-vacanam>Tp>T6 api <na-sakṛt>Tn <<<atyanta-viparīta>K1-darśana>K1-bhāvita^tayā>T3 momuhyamānaḥ lokaḥ śrutam api <na-sakṛt>Tn tattvam vismṛtya vismṛtya <mithyā-prasaṅgam>T6 avatārya avatārya codayati iti punaḥ punaḥ uttaram āha bhagavān, durvijñeyatvam ca ālakṣya vastunaḥ| '<na-vyaktaḥ>Tn ayam <na-cintyaḥ>Tn ayam' 'na jāyate mriyate' ityādinā ātmani <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6 <<śruti-smṛti-nyāya>Di-prasiddhaḥ>T3 uktaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ ca| tasmin ātmani <karman-abhāve>T6 akarmaṇi <karman-viparīta>T3-darśanam>K1 <atyanta-nirūḍham>K1; yataḥ, 'kim karma kim akarma iti kavayaḥ api atra mohitāḥ' (gītā 4.16)| <deha-ādi>Bs6 āśrayam karma ātmani adhyāropya 'aham kartā, mama etat karma, mayā asya karmaṇaḥ phalam bhoktavyam' iti ca, tathā 'aham tūṣṇīm bhavāmi, yena aham <nir-āyāsaḥ>Bvp <na-karmā>Bsmn sukhī syām' iti <<kārya-karaṇa>T6-āśrayam>T6 <vyāpāra-uparamam>T6 <tat-kṛtam>T3 ca sukhitvam ātmani adhyāropya 'na karomi kiṃcit, tūṣṇīm sukhamāse' iti abhimanyate lokaḥ| tatra idam lokasya <<viparīta-darśana>K1-apanayāya>T6 āha bhagavān - 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet ' ityādi|| 
atra ca karma karma eva sat <<kārya-karaṇa>T6-āśrayam>T6 <karman-rahite>T6 avikriye ātmani sarvaiḥ adhyastam, yataḥ paṇḍitaḥ api 'aham karomi' iti manyate| ataḥ <ātman-samaveta^tayā>T3 <<sarva{3}-loka>K1-prasiddhe>T7 karmaṇi <<nadī-kūla>T6-stheṣu>U iva vṛkṣeṣu <gati-prātilomyena>T6 akarma <karman-abhāvam>T6 <yathā-bhūtam>T2 <gati-abhāvam>T6 iva vṛkṣeṣu yaḥ paśyet, akarmaṇi ca <<<kārya-karaṇa>T6-vyāpāra>T6-uparame>T6 karmavat ātmani adhyāropite, 'tūṣṇīm <na-kurvan>Tn sukham āse' iti <<<ahaṃkāra-abhisaṃdhi>T6-hetu^tvāt>T6, tasmin akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ paśyet, yaḥ evam <<<karman-akarma>Di-vibhāga>T6-jñaḥ>U saḥ buddhimān paṇḍitaḥ manuṣyeṣu, saḥ yuktaḥ yogī <<kṛtsna-karma>K1-kṛt>U ca saḥ <na-śubhāt>Tn mokṣitaḥ <kṛta-kṛtyaḥ>Bs3 bhavati ityarthaḥ||
ayam ślokaḥ anyathā vyākhyātaḥ kaiścit| katham? nityānām kila karmaṇām <īśvara-arthe>T4 anuṣṭhīyamānānām <<tat-phala>T6-abhāvāt>T6 akarmāṇi tāni ucyante gauṇyā vṛttyā| teṣām ca akaraṇam akarma; tat ca <pratyavāya-phala^tvāt>K6 karma ucyate gauṇyā eva vṛttyā| tatra nitye karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet <phala-abhāvāt>T6; yathā dhenuḥ api gauḥ agauḥ iti ucyate <kṣīra-ākhyam>Bs6 phalam na prayacchati iti, tadvat| tathā <nitya-akaraṇe>S tu akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ paśyet <<<naraka-ādi>Bs6-pratyavāya>K1-phalam>K6 prayacchati iti||
na etat yuktam vyākhyānam| evam jñānāt <na-śubhāt>Tn <mokṣa-anupapatteḥ>T6 'yat jñātvā mokṣyase <na-śubhāt>Tn' iti bhagavatā uktam vacanam bādhyeta| katham? nityānām anuṣṭhānāt <na-śubhāt>Tn syāt nāma mokṣaṇam, na tu teṣām <<phala-abhāva>T6-jñānāt>T6| na hi nityānām <<phala-abhāva>T6-jñānam>T6 <<<na-śubha>Tn-mukti>T5-phala^tvena>K6 coditam, <<nitya-karma>S-jñānam>T6 vā| na ca bhagavatā eva iha uktam| etena <na-karmaṇi>Tn <karman-darśanam>T6 prati uktam| na hi <na-karmaṇi>Tn 'karma' iti darśanam kartavyatayā iha codyate, nityasya tu <kartavya^tā-mātram>S| na ca '<na-karaṇāt>Tn nityasya pratyavāyaḥ bhavati' iti vijñānāt kiñcit phalam syāt| na api <nitya-<na-karaṇam>Tn>T6 jñeyatvena coditam| na api 'karma akarma' iti <mithyā-darśanātT6 <na-śubhāt>Tn mokṣaṇam buddhimattvam yuktatā <<<kṛtsna-karma>K1-kṛttva>T6-ādi>Bs6 ca phalam upapadyate, stutiḥ vā| <mithyā-jñānam>K1 eva hi sākṣāt <<na-śubha>Tn-rūpam>Bs6| kutaḥ anyasmāt <na-śubhāt>Tn mokṣaṇam? na hi tamaḥ tamasaḥ nivartakam bhavati||
nanu karmaṇi yat <akarman-darśanam>T6 akarmaṇi vā <karman-darśanam>T6 na tat <mithyā-jñānam>K1; kim tarhi? gauṇam <<phala-<bhāva-abhāva>Di>T6-nimittam>T6 - na, <<karman-akarma>Di-vijñānāt>T6 api gauṇāt phalasya <na-śravaṇāt>Tn| na api <<śruta-hāni>T6-<<na-śruta>Tn-parikalpanāyām>T6>Di kaścit viśeṣaḥ upalabhyate| <sva-śabdena>T6 api śakyam vaktum '<nitya-karmaṇām>S phalam na asti, akaraṇāt ca teṣām <naraka-pātaḥ>T7 syāt' iti; tatra vyājena <<para{3}-vyāmoha>T6-rūpeṇa>Bs6 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet' ityādinā kim? tatra evam vyācakṣāṇena bhagavatā uktam vākyam <<loka-vyāmoha>T6-artham>T4 iti vyaktam kalpitam syāt| na ca etat <chadman-rūpeṇa>T6 vākyena rakṣaṇīyam vastu; na api <śabda-antareṇa>Tm punaḥ punaḥ ucyamānam <su-bodham>Tp syāt ityevam vaktum yuktam| 'karmaṇi eva ādhikāraḥ te' ityatra hi sphuṭataraḥ uktaḥ arthaḥ, na punaḥ vaktavyaḥ bhavati| sarvatra ca praśastam boddhavyam ca kartavyam eva| na niṣprayojanam boddhavyam iti ucyate||
na ca <mithyā-jñānam>K1 boddhavyam bhavati, tat pratyupasthāpitam vā <vastu-ābhāsam>T6| na api nityānām akaraṇāt abhāvāt <<pratyavāya-bhāva>T6-utpattiḥ>T6, 'na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ' (gītā 2.16) iti vacanāt 'katham asataḥ sat jāyeta' (bṛ0 u0 6.2.2) iti ca darśitam asataḥ sat <janman-pratiṣedhāt>T6| asataḥ sat utpattim bruvatā asat eva sat bhavet, sat ca api asat bhavet iti uktam syāt| tat ca <na-yuktam>Tn, <<sarva{3}-pramāṇa>K1-virodhāt>T6| na ca niṣphalam vidadhyāt karma śāstram, <duḥkha-svarūpa^tvāt>T6, duḥkhasya ca <buddhi-pūrvakatayā>S <kārya^tva-<na-upapatteḥ>Tn>T6| <tad-<na-karaṇe>Tn>T6 ca <<naraka-pāta>T7-abhyupagamāt>T6 <na-arthāya>Bsmn eva ubhayathā api karaṇe ca akaraṇe ca śāstram niṣphalam kalpitam syāt| <<sva-abhyupagama>T6-virodhaḥ>T6 ca 'nityam niṣphalam karma' iti abhyupagamya '<mokṣa-phalāya>K6' iti bruvataḥ| tasmāt <yathā-śrutaḥ>A1 eva arthaḥ 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ' ityādeḥ| tathā ca vyākhyātaḥ asmābhiḥ ślokaḥ||
tadetat karmaṇi <akarman-darśanam>T6 stūyate -
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ <<kāma-saṅkalpa>Di-varjitāḥ>T3|
<<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-karmāṇam>Bs6 tam āhuḥ paṇḍitam budhāḥ||4.19||
||4.19|| - yasya yathā <ukta-darśinaḥ>U sarve yāvantaḥ samārambhāḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi, samārabhyante iti samārambhāḥ, <<kāma-saṅkalpa>Di-varjitāḥ>T3 kāmaiḥ <tat-kāraṇaiḥ>K1 ca saṃkalpaiḥ varjitāḥ mudhā eva <ceṣṭā-mātrāḥ>S anuṣṭhīyante; pravṛttena cet <<loka-saṃgraha>T6-artham>T4, nivṛttena cet <<jīvana-mātra>S-artham>T4| tam <<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-karmāṇam>Bs6 <karman-ādau>Bs6 <<akarman-ādi>Bs6-darśanam>T6 jñānam tat eva agniḥ tena <jñāna-agninā>K6 dagdhāni <<śubha-aśubha>Di-lakṣaṇāni>Bs6 karmāṇi yasya tam āhuḥ <parama-arthataḥ>K1 paṇḍitam budhāḥ <brahma-vidaḥ>U|| 
yaḥ tu <<akarma-ādi>Bs6-darśī>U, saḥ <<akarman-ādi>Bs6-darśanāt>T6 eva niṣkarmā saṃnyāsī <<<jīvana-mātra>S-artha>T4-ceṣṭaḥ>T6 san karmaṇi na pravartate, yadyapi prāk vivekataḥ pravṛttaḥ| yaḥ tu <prārabdha-karmā>Bs3 san <uttara-kālam>K1 <utpanna-<ātman-<samyak-darśanaḥ>K1>T6>Bs6 syāt, saḥ <sarva-karmaṇi>K1 prayojanam apaśyan <sa-sādhanam>BvS karma parityajati eva| saḥ kutaścit nimittāt <<karman-parityāga>T6-<na-saṃbhave>Tn>T6 sati karmaṇi <tat-phale>T6 ca <saṅga-rahita^tayā>T3 <<sva-prayojana>T6-abhāvāt>T6 <<loka-saṃgraha>T6-artham>T4 pūrvavat karmaṇi pravṛttaḥ api na eva kiñcit karoti, <<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-karman^tvāt>K1 tadīyam karma akarma eva saṃpadyate iti etam artham darśayiṣyan āha -
tyaktvā <<karman-phala>T6-āsaṅgam>T7 <nitya-tṛptaḥ>S <nir-āśrayaḥ>Bvp|
karmaṇi abhipravṛttaḥ api na eva kiñcit karoti saḥ||4.20|| 	
||4.20|| - tyaktvā karmasu abhimānam <phala-āsaṅgam>T7 ca yathā uktena jñānena <nitya-tṛptaḥ>S <nir-ākāṅkṣaḥ>Bvp viṣayeṣu ityarthaḥ|  <nir-āśrayaḥ>Bvp <āśraya-rahitaḥ>T3, āśrayaḥ nāma yat āśritya puruṣārtham sisādhayiṣati, <<<<<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa-iṣṭa>Di-phala>K1sādhana>T6āśraya>T6-rahitaḥ>T3 ityarthaḥ| viduṣā kriyamāṇam karma <parama-arthataḥ>K1 akarma eva, tasya <<niṣkriya-<ātman-darśana>T6>K1-saṃpanna^tvāt>T3| tena evam bhūtena <<sva-prayojana>T6-abhāvāt>T6 <sa-sādhanam>Bvs karma parityaktavyam eva iti prāpte, tataḥ <nirgama-<na-saṃbhavāt>Tn>T6 <<loka-saṃgraha>T6-cikīrṣayā>T6  <<śiṣṭa-vigarhaṇa>T6-<na-parijihīrṣayā>Tn>T6 vā pūrvavat karmaṇi abhipravṛttaḥ api <<niṣkriya-<ātman-darśana>T6>K1-saṃpanna^tvāt>T3 na eva kiñcit karoti saḥ||
yaḥ punaḥ <<pūrva-ukta>S-viparītaḥ>T6 prāk eva <karman-ārambhāt>T6 brahmaṇi <sarva{3}-antare>T6 <pratyak-ātmani>T6 niṣkriye <saṃjāta-<ātman-darśanaḥ>T6>Bs6 saḥ <<<<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa-iṣṭa>Di-viṣaya>K1-āśīḥ>T7-vivarjita^tayā>T3 <<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa>Di-arthe>T6 karmaṇi prayojanam apaśyan <sa-sādhanam>Bvs karma saṃnyasya <<<śarīra-yātrā>T6-mātra>S-ceṣṭaḥ>Bs6 yatiḥ <jñāna-niṣṭhaḥ>Bv mucyate iti etam artham darśayitum āha -
<nir-āśīḥ>Bs5 <yata-<citta-ātmā>Di>Bs3 <tyakta-<sarva{3}-parigrahaḥ>T6>Bs3|
śārīram kevalam karma kurvan āpnoti kilbiṣam||4.21|
||4.21|| - <nir-āśīḥ>Bs5 nirgatāḥ āśiṣaḥ yasmāt saḥ <nir-āśīḥ>Bs5, <yata-<citta-ātmā>Di>Bs3 cittam antaḥkaraṇam ātmā bāhyaḥ <<kārya-karaṇa>-saṃghātaḥ>T6 tau ubhau api yatau saṃyatau yena saḥ <yata-<citta-ātmā>Di>Bs3, <tyakta-<sarva{3}-parigrahaḥ>T6>Bs3 tyaktaḥ sarvaḥ parigrahaḥ yena saḥ <tyakta-<sarva{3}-parigrahaḥ>T6>Bs3, śārīram <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>K6, kevalam tatra api <abhimāna-varjitam>T3, karma kurvan na āpnoti na prāpnoti kilbiṣam <aniṣṭa-rūpam>Bs6 pāpam dharmam ca| dharmaḥ api mumukṣoḥ kilbiṣam eva <bandha-āpādaka^tvāt>T6| tasmāt tābhyām muktaḥ bhavati, saṃsārāt muktaḥ bhavati ityarthaḥ|| 
	'śārīram kevalam karma' ityatra kim <śarīra-nirvartyam>T3 śārīram karma abhipretam, āhosvit <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>K6 śārīram karma iti? kim ca ataḥ yadi <śarīra-nirvartyam>T3 śārīram karma yadi vā <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>K6 śārīram iti? ucyate - yadā <śarīra-nirvartyam>T3 karma śārīram abhipretam syāt, tadā <<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa>Di-prayojanam>Bs6 karma pratiṣiddham api śarīreṇa kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam ityapi bruvataḥ <viruddha-abhidhānam>T6 prasajyeta| śāstrīyam ca karma <<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa>Di-prayojanam>Bs6 śarīreṇa kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam ityapi bruvataḥ <<<na-prāpta>Tn-pratiṣedha>T6prasaṅgaḥ>T6| 'śārīram karma kurvan' iti viśeṣaṇāt <<kevala-śabda>K7-prayogāt>T6 ca <<vāṅ-manasa>Di-nirvartyam>T3 karma <<vidhi-pratiṣedha>Di-viṣayam>T6 <<dharma-adharma>Di-śabda>K7-vācyam kurvan prāpnoti kilbiṣam iti uktam syāt| tatrāpi <vāṅ-manasābhyām>Di <<vihita-anuṣṭhāna>T6-pakṣe>T6 <<kilbiṣa-prāpti>T6-vacanam>T6 viruddham āpadyeta| <<pratiṣiddha-sevā>T6-pakṣe>T6 api <<<bhūta-artha>K1-anuvāda>T6-mātram>S <na-artha^kam>Bsmn syāt| yadā tu <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>K6 śārīram karma abhipretam bhavet, tadā <<dṛṣṭa-adṛṣṭa>Di-prayojanam>Bs6 karma <<vidhi-pratiṣedha>Di-gamyam>T3 <<śarīra-vāṅ-manasa>Di-nirvartyam>T3 anyat akurvan taiḥ eva <śarīra-ādibhiḥ>Bs6 <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>K6 <<kevala-śabda>K7-prayogāt>T6 'aham karomi' iti <abhimāna-varjitaḥ>T3 <<śarīra-ādi>Bs6-ceṣṭā>T6-mātram>S <loka-dṛṣṭyā>T6 kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam| evam bhūtasya <<<<<pāpa-śabda>K7-vācya>T3-kilbiṣa>K1-prāpti>T6-<na-saṃbhavāt>Tn>T6 kilbiṣam saṃsāram na āpnoti; <<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-<sarva{3}-karma^tvāt>K1>K1 <na-pratibandhena>Tn mucyata eva iti <<<<pūrva-ukta>S-<samyak-darśana>K1>K1-phala>T6-anuvādaḥ>T6 eva eṣaḥ| evam 'śārīram kevalam karma' ityasya arthasya parigrahe niravadyam bhavati|| 
<tyakta-<sarva{3}-parigrahasya>T6>Bs3 yateḥ <anna-ādeḥ>Bs6 <<śarīra-sthiti>T6-hetoḥ>T6 parigrahasya abhāvāt <yācanā-ādinā>Bs6 <śarīra-sthitau>T6 kartavyatāyām prāptāyām 'ayācitamasaṃklṛptamupapannam yadṛcchayā' (bodhā0 smṛ0 21.8.12) ityādinā vacanena anujñātam yateḥ <<śarīra-sthiti>T6-hetoḥ>T6 <anna-ādeḥ>Bs6 <prāpti-dvāram>T6 āviṣkurvan āha -
<<yadṛcchā-lābha>T3-santuṣṭaḥ>T3 <dvandva-atītaḥ>T3 <vi-matsaraḥ>Bs5|
samaḥ siddhau asiddhau ca kṛtvā api na nibadhyate||4.22||
||4.22|| - <<yadṛcchā-lābha>T3-santuṣṭaḥ>T3 <<na-prārthita>Tn-upanataḥ>T3 lābhaḥ <yadṛcchā-lābhaḥ>T3 tena saṃtuṣṭaḥ <saṃjāta-<alam-pratyayaḥ>K7>Bs6| <dvandva{3}-atītaḥ>T3 dvandvaiḥ <<śīta-uṣṇa>Di-ādibhiḥ>Bs6 hanyamānaḥ api <<na-viṣaṇṇa>Tn-cittaḥ>Bs6 <dvandva-atītaḥ>T3 ucyate| <vi-matsaraḥ>Bs5 <vigata-matsaraḥ>Bs5 <nirvaira-buddhiḥ>Bs6 samaḥ tulyaḥ <yadṛcchā-lābhasya>T3 siddhau asiddhau ca| yaḥ evam bhūtaḥ yatiḥ <anna-ādeḥ>Bs6 <<śarīra-sthiti>T6-hetoḥ>T6 <lābha-alābhayoḥ>Di samaḥ <<harṣa-viṣāda>Di-varjitaḥ>T3 <karman-ādau>Bs6 <<akarman-ādi>Bs6-darśī>U <<<yathā-bhūta>T2-<ātman-darśana>T6>K1-niṣṭhaḥ>Bv san <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojane>T6 <<<bhikṣā-aṭana>T4-ādi>Bs6-karmaṇi>K1 <<śarīra-ādi>Bs6-nirvartye>T6 'na eva kiñcit karomi aham, guṇāḥ guṇeṣu vartante' (gītā 3.28) ityevam sadā saṃparicakṣāṇaḥ ātmanaḥ <kartṛ^tva-abhāvam>Tn paśyan eva kiñcit <<bhikṣā-aṭana>T4-ādikam>Bs6 karma karoti, <<loka-vyavahāra>T6-<sāmānya-darśanena>K1>T6 tu laukikaiḥ <āropita-kartṛtve>K1 <<bhikṣā-aṭana>T4-ādau>Bs6 karmaṇi kartā bhavati| <sva-anubhavena>T6 tu <<<śāstra-pramāṇa>K6-ādi>Bs6-janitena>T3 <na-kartā>Tn eva| saḥ evam <<para-adhyāropita>T3-kartṛtvaḥ>Bs6 <<<śarīra-sthiti>T6-mātra>S-prayojanam>T6 <<bhikṣā-aṭana>T4-ādikam>Bs6 karma kṛtvā api na nibadhyate <bandha-hetoḥ>T6 karmaṇaḥ <sa-hetu^kasya>BvS <jñāna-agninā>K6 dagdhatvāt iti <ukta-anuvādaḥ>T6 eva eṣaḥ||
'tyaktvā <<karman-phala>T6-asaṅgam>T7' (gītā 4.20) ityanena ślokena yaḥ <prārabdha-karmā>Bs6 san yadā <<<niṣkriya-<brahma-ātma>Di>K1-darśana>T6-saṃpannaḥ>Bs6 syāt tadā tasya ātmanaḥ <<<kartṛ-karma-prayojana>Di-abhāva>T6-darśinaḥ>U <karman-parityāge>T6 prāpte kutaścit nimittāt <tad-asaṃbhave>T6 sati pūrvavat tasmin karmaṇi abhipravṛttasya api 'na eva kiñcit karoti saḥ' iti <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6 pradarśitaḥ| yasya evam <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6 darśitaḥ tasya eva - 
<gata-saṅgasya>Bs5 muktasya <jñāna-avasthita-cetasaḥ>Bb|
yajñāya ācarataḥ karma samagram pravilīyate||4.23||
||4.23|| - <gata-saṅgasya>Bs5 sarvataḥ <nivṛttā-āsakteḥ>Bs5, muktasya <nivṛtta-<<<dharma-adharma>Di-ādi>Bs6-bandhanasya>K1>Bs5, <jñāna-avasthita-cetasaḥ>Bb jñāne eva avasthitam cetaḥ yasya saḥ     ayam <jñāna-avasthita-cetāḥ>Bs6 tasya, yajñāya <<yajña-nirvṛtti>T6-artham>T4 ācarataḥ nirvartayataḥ karma samagram saha agreṇa phalena vartate iti samagram karma tat samagram pravilīyate vinaśyati ityarthaḥ|| 
kasmāt punaḥ kāraṇāt kriyamāṇam karma <<sva-kārya>T6-ārambham>T6 akurvat samagram pravilīyate iti ucyate yataḥ -
brahma arpaṇam brahma haviḥ <brahma-agnau>K6 brahmaṇā hutam|
brahma eva tena gantavyam <<brahma-karma>K6-samādhinā>Bs7||4.24||
||4.24|| - brahma arpaṇam yena karaṇena <brahma-vit>U haviḥ agnau arpayati tat brahma eva iti paśyati, tasya <ātman-vyatirekeṇa>T6 abhāvam paśyati, yathā śuktikāyām <rajata-abhāvam>T6 paśyati; tat ucyate brahma eva arpaṇam iti, yathā yat rajatam tat śuktikā eva iti| 'brahma arpaṇam' iti <na-samaste>Tn pade| yat <arpaṇa-buddhyā>T6 gṛhyate loke tat asya <brahma-vidaḥ>U brahma eva ityarthaḥ| brahma haviḥ tathā yat haviḥ buddhyā gṛhyamāṇam tat brahma eva asya| tathā <brahma-agnau>K6 iti samastam padam| agniḥ api brahma eva yatra hūyate brahmaṇā kartrā, brahma eva kartā ityarthaḥ| yat tena hutam <havana-kriyā>Km tat brahma eva| yat tena gantavyam phalam tat api brahma eva <<brahma-karma>K6-samādhinā>Bs7 brahma eva karma <brahma-karma>K6 tasmin samādhiḥ yasya saḥ <<brahma-karma>K6-samādhiḥ>Bs7 tena <<brahma-karma>K6-samādhinā>Bs7 brahma eva gantavyam|| 
evam <loka-saṃgraham>T6 cikīrṣuṇā api kriyamāṇam karma <parama-arthataḥ>K1 akarma, <<brahma-buddhi>T6-upamṛdita^tvāt>T3| evam sati <nivṛtta-karmaṇaḥ>Bs3 api <<sarva{3}-karma>K1-saṃnyāsinaḥ>T6 samyak <<darśana-stuti>T6-artham>T4 <yajñatva-saṃpādanam>T6 jñānasya sutarām upapadyate; yat <arpaṇa-ādi>Bs6 <adhi-yajñe>A1 prasiddham tat asya adhyātmam brahma eva <<parama-artha>K1-darśinaḥ>U iti| anyathā sarvasya brahmatve <arpaṇa-ādīnām>Bs6 eva viśeṣataḥ <brahma^tva-abhidhānam>T6 <na-artha^kam>Bsmn syāt| tasmāt brahma eva idam sarvam iti abhijānataḥ viduṣaḥ <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6| <<kāraka-buddhi>T6-abhāvāt>T6 ca| na hi <<kāraka-buddhi>T6-rahitam>T3 <yajña-ākhyam>Bs6 karma dṛṣṭam| sarvam eva <agnihotra-ādi^kam>Bs6 karma <<<<<śabda-samarpita>T3-<devatā-viśeṣa>Km-saṃpradāna>T6-ādi>Bs6-kāraka>K1-buddhi^mat>T6 <<<kartṛ-abhimāna>T6-phala>T6-abhisaṃdhi^mat>T6 ca dṛṣṭam; na <<<<upamṛdita-<kriyā-kāraka>Di>K1-phala>T6-bheda>T6-buddhi^mat>T6 <<<<kartṛ^tva-abhimāna>T6-phala>T6-abhisaṃdhi>T7-rahitam>T3 vā| idam tu <<<<<<<<<brahma-buddhi>T6-upamṛdita>T3-arpaṇa>T6-ādi>Bs6-kāraka>K1-kriyā>T6-phala>T6-bheda>T7-buddhi>Bs7 karma| ataḥ akarma eva tat| tathā ca darśitam 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet' 'karmaṇi abhipravṛttaḥ api na eva kiṃcit karoti saḥ' 'guṇāḥ guṇeṣu vartante' 'na eva kiṃcit karomi iti yuktaḥ manyeta <tattva-vit>U' ityādibhiḥ| tathā ca darśayan tatra tatra <<<<<kriyā-kāraka>Di-phala>T6-bheda>T7-buddhi>T6-upamardam>T3 karoti| dṛṣṭā ca <<kāmya-agnihotra>K1-ādau>Bs6 <kāma-upamardena>T6 <<<kāmya-agnihotra>K1-ādi>Bs6-hāniḥ>T6| tathā <<<mati-pūrvaka>S-<na-<mati-pūrvaka>S>Tn>Diādīnām>Bs6 karmaṇām <kārya-viśeṣasya>Km ārambhakatvam dṛṣṭam| tathā iha api <<<<<<<<<brahma-buddhi>T6-upamṛdita>T3-arpaṇa>T6-ādi>Bs6-kāraka>K1-kriyā>T6-phala>T6-bheda>T7-buddheḥ>Bs6 <<bāhya-ceṣṭā>S-mātreṇa>S karma api viduṣaḥ akarma saṃpadyate| ataḥ uktam 'samagram pravilīyate' iti|| 
atra kecit āhuḥ - yat brahma tat <arpaṇa-ādīni>Bs6; brahma eva kila <arpaṇa-ādinā>Bs6 <pañcan-vidhena>Km <kāraka-ātmanā>Bs6 vyavasthitam sat tat eva karma karoti| tatra na <<arpaṇa-ādi>Bs6-buddhiḥ>K1 nivartyate, kintu <arpaṇa-ādiṣu>Bs6 <brahma-buddhiḥ>T6 ādhīyate; yathā <pratima-ādau>Bs6 <<viṣṇu-ādi>Bs6-buddhiḥ>T6 yathā vā <nāman-ādau>Bs6 <brahma-buddhiḥ>T6 iti|| 
satyam, evam api syāt yadi <<<jñāna-yajña>K6-stuti>T6-artham>T4 prakaraṇam na syāt| atra tu samyak darśanam <<jñāna-yajña>K6-śabditam>T3 anekān <yajña-śabditān>T3 <kriyā-viśeṣān>Km upanyasya 'śreyān dravyamayāt yajñāt <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6' (gītā 4.33) iti jñānam stauti| atra ca samartham idam vacanam 'brahma arpaṇam' ityādi jñānasya <yajñatva-saṃpādane>T6; anyathā sarvasya brahmatve <arpaṇa-ādīnām>Bs6 eva viśeṣataḥ <brahma^tva-abhidhānam>T6 <na-artha^kam>Bsmn syāt| ye tu <arpaṇa-ādiṣu>Bs6 pratimāyām <viṣṇu-dṛṣṭi^vat>T6 <brahma-dṛṣṭiḥ>T6 kṣipyate <nāman-ādiṣu>Bs6 iva ca iti bruvate na teṣām <brahma-vidyā>T6 uktā iha vivakṣitā syāt, <<arpaṇa-ādi>Bs6-viṣaya^tvāt>T6 jñānasya| na ca <<dṛṣṭi-saṃpādana>T6-jñānena>T6 <mokṣa-phalam>T6 prāpyate| 'brahma eva tena gantavyam' iti ca ucyate| viruddham ca samyak darśanam antareṇa <mokṣa-phalam>T6 prāpyate iti| <prakṛta-virodhaḥ>T6 ca; samyak darśanam ca prakṛtam 'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet' ityatra, ante ca samyak darśanam, tasya eva upasaṃhārāt| 'śreyān dravyamayāt yajñāt <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6', 'jñānam labdhvā parām śāntim' ityādinā samyak <darśana-stutim>T6 eva kurvan upakṣīṇaḥ adhyāyaḥ| tatra akasmāt <arpaṇa-ādau>Bs6 <brahma-dṛṣṭiḥ>T6 <na-prakaraṇe>Tn pratimāyām iva <viṣṇu-dṛṣṭiḥ>T6 ucyate iti <na-upapannam>Tn| tasmāt <<yathā-vyākhyāta>A1-arthaḥ>K1 eva ayam ślokaḥ||
tatra adhunā samyak darśanasya yajñatvam saṃpādya tat <stuti-artham>T4 anye api yajñāḥ upakṣipyante -

||4.25|| - daivam eva devāḥ ijyante yena yajñena asau daivaḥ yajñaḥ tam eva apare yajñam yoginaḥ karmiṇaḥ paryupāsate kurvanti ityarthaḥ| <brahma-agnau>K6 'satyam jñānamanantam brahma' (taitti0 u0 2.1) 'vijñānam ānandam brahma' (bṛha0 u0 3.9.22) 'yat sākṣāt aparokṣāt brahma yaḥ ātmā sarvāntaraḥ' (bṛha0 u0 3.4.1) <<ityādi-vacana>K1-uktam>T3 <<<<aśana-āya>Di-ādi>Bs6-<sarva-<saṃsāra-dharma>T6>K1>K1-varjitam>T3 'na iti na iti' iti <nirasta-<na-śeṣa>Bsmn-viśeṣam>Bb <brahma-śabdena>K7 ucyate| brahma ca tat agniḥ ca saḥ <<homa-adhikaraṇa^tva>T6-vivakṣayā>T6 <brahma-agniḥ>K6| tasmin <brahma-agnau>K6 apare anye <brahma-vidaḥ>U yajñam - <<yajña-śabda>K7-vācyaḥ>T3 ātmā, <ātman-nāmasu>T6 <yajña-śabdasya>T6 pāṭhāt - tam ātmānam yajñam <parama-arthataḥ>K1 param eva brahma santam <<<buddhi-ādi>Bs6-upādhi>K1-saṃyuktam>T3 <adhyasta-<<sarva{3}-upādhi>K1-dharma^kam>T6>Bs6 <āhuti-rūpam>Bs6 yajñena eva ātmanā eva uktalakṣaṇena upajuhvati prakṣipanti, <sa-upādhikasya>BvS ātmanaḥ <nir-upādhikena>Bvp <<para-brahma>K1-svarūpeṇa>T6 eva <yad-darśanam>K1 saḥ tasmin homaḥ tam kurvanti <<<<brahma-ātma>Di-ekatva>T6-darśana>T6-niṣṭhāḥ>Bs6 saṃnyāsinaḥ ityarthaḥ||
saḥ ayam <<samyak-darśana>K1-lakṣaṇaḥ>Bs6 yajñaḥ <<daiva-yajña>T6-ādiṣu>Bs6 yajñeṣu upakṣipyate 'brahma arpaṇam' <ityādi-ślokaiḥ>K1 prastutaḥ 'śreyān dravyamayāt yajñāt <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6 <param-tapa>U' (gītā 4.33) ityādinā <stuti-artham>T4 -

||4.26|| - <śrotṛ-ādīni>Bs6 indriyāṇi anye yoginaḥ <saṃyama-agniṣu>K6| <prati-indriyam> saṃyamaḥ bhidyate iti <bahu-vacanam>K1| saṃyamāḥ eva agnayaḥ teṣu juhvati <indriya-saṃyamam>T6 eva kurvanti ityarthaḥ| <śabda-ādīn>Bs6 viṣayān anye <indriya-agniṣu>K6 indriyāṇi eva agnayaḥ teṣu <indriya-agniṣu>K6 juhvati <śrotṛ-ādibhiḥ>Bs6 <<<na-viruddha>Tn-viṣaya>K1-grahaṇam>T6 homam manyante||

||4.27|| - sarvāṇi <indriya-karmāṇi>T6 indriyāṇām karmāṇi <indriya-karmāṇi>T6, tathā <prāṇa-karmāṇi>T6 prāṇaḥ vāyuḥ ādhyātmikaḥ <tad-karmāṇi>T6 <<ākuñcana-prasāraṇa>Di-ādīni>Bs6 tāni ca apare <<ātman-saṃyama>T7-<yoga-agnau>K6>K6 ātmani saṃyamaḥ <ātman-saṃyamaḥ>T7 saḥ eva <yoga-agniḥ>K6 tasmin <<ātman-saṃyama>T7-<yoga-agnau>K6>K6 juhvati prakṣipanti <jñāna-dīpite>T3 snehena iva pradīpe <viveka-vijñānena>K6 <ujjvala-bhāvam>T6 āpādite juhvati pravilāpayanti ityarthaḥ||

||4.31|| - <<<yajña-śiṣṭa>T6-amṛta>K1-bhujaḥ>U yajñānām śiṣṭam <yajña-śiṣṭam>T6 <yajña-śiṣṭam>T6 ca tat amṛtam ca <<yajña-śiṣṭa>T6-amṛtam>K1 tat bhuñjate iti <<<yajña-śiṣṭa>T6-amṛta>K1-bhujaḥ>U| yathā uktān yajñān kṛtvā <tad-śiṣṭena>T6 kālena <<yathā-vidhi>A1-coditam>T3 annam <amṛta-ākhyam>Bs6 bhuñjate iti <<<yajña-śiṣṭa>T6-amṛta>K1-bhujaḥ>U yānti gacchanti brahma sanātanam cirantanam mumukṣavaḥ cet; <<kāla-atikrama>T6-apekṣayā>T6 iti sāmarthyāt gamyate| na ayam lokaḥ <<sarva{3}-prāṇi>K1-sādhāraṇaḥ>Bs7 api asti yathā uktānām yajñānām ekaḥ api yajñaḥ yasya na asti saḥ <na-yajñasya>Bsmn tasya| kutaḥ anyaḥ <<viśiṣṭa-sādhana>K1-sādhyaḥ>T3 <kuru-sattama>T7||

||4.32|| - evam yathā uktāḥ <bahu-vidhāḥ>Bs7 <bahu-prakārāḥ>Bs7 yajñāḥ vitatāḥ vistīrṇāḥ brahmaṇaḥ vedasya mukhe dvāre <veda-dvāreṇa>T6 avagamyamānāḥ brahmaṇaḥ mukhe vitatāḥ ucyante; tadyathā 'vāci hi prāṇam juhumaḥ' ityādayaḥ| <karman-jān>U <<<kāyika-vācika-mānasa>Dikarma>K1-udbhavān>Bs6 viddhi tān sarvān <na-<ātman-jān>U>Tn, <nir-vyāpāraḥ>Bvp hi ātmā| ataḥ evam jñātvā vimokṣyase <na-śubhāt>Tn| na <asmad-vyāpārāḥ>T6 ime, <nir-vyāpāraḥ>Bvp aham udāsīnaḥ ityevam jñātvā asmāt <samyak-darśanāt>K1 mokṣyase <saṃsāra-bandhanāt>T6 ityarthaḥ||
'brahma arpaṇam' <ityādi-ślokena>K1 <samyak-darśanasya>K1 yajñatvam saṃpāditam| yajñāḥ ca aneke upadiṣṭāḥ|
taiḥ <<siddha-puruṣārtha>K1-prayojanaiḥ>T6 jñānam stūyate| katham? -
śreyān dravyamayāt yajñāt <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6 <param-tapa>U|

||4.33|| - śreyān dravyamayāt <<dravya-sādhana>K6-sādhyāt>T3 yajñāt <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6 he <param-tapa>U| dravyamayaḥ hi yajñaḥ phalasya ārambhakaḥ, <jñāna-yajñaḥ>K6 na <phala-ārambhakaḥ>T6, ataḥ śreyān praśasyataraḥ| katham? yataḥ sarvam karma samastam akhilam <na-pratibaddham>Tn pārtha jñāne <mokṣa-sādhane>T6 <<sarvatas-saṃpluta-udaka>Bb-sthānīye>T6 parisamāpyate antaḥ bhavati ityarthaḥ 'yathā kṛtāya vijitāyādhareyāḥ saṃyanti evam enam sarvam tadabhisameti yat kiñcit prajāḥ sādhu kurvanti yaḥ tadveda yat saḥ vedaḥ ' (chā0 u0 4.1.4) iti śruteḥ||
tadetat viśiṣṭam jñānam tarhi kena prāpyate iti ucyate -
tat viddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā|

||4.34|| - tat viddhi vijānīhi yena vidhinā prāpyate iti| ācāryān abhigamya, praṇipātena prakarṣeṇa nīcaiḥ patanam praṇipātaḥ <dīrgha-namaskāraḥ>K1 tena, 'katham bandhaḥ? katham mokṣaḥ? kā vidyā? kā ca avidyā? iti paripraśnena, sevayā <guru-śuśrūṣayā>T6 evam ādinā| praśrayeṇa āvarjitā ācāryāḥ upadekṣyanti kathayiṣyanti te jñānam yathā <ukta-viśeṣaṇam>K1 jñāninaḥ| jñānavantaḥ api kecit yathāvat <<tattva-darśana>T6-śīlāḥ>Bs6, apare na; ataḥ viśinaṣṭi <tattva-darśinaḥ>U iti| ye <samyak-darśinaḥ>U taiḥ upadiṣṭam jñānam <kārya-kṣamam>T6 bhavati na itarat iti bhagavataḥ matam||
tathā ca sati idam api samartham vacanam -

||4.35|| - yat jñātvā yat jñānam taiḥ upadiṣṭam adhigamya prāpya punaḥ bhūyaḥ moham evam yathā idānīm moham gataḥ asi punaḥ evam na yāsyasi he pāṇḍava| kim ca - yena jñānena bhūtāni <na-śeṣeṇa>Tn <brahma-ādīni>Bs6 <stamba-paryantāni>Bs6 drakṣyasi sākṣāt ātmani <pratyak-ātmani>T6 '<asmad-saṃsthāni>T6 imāni bhūtāni' iti athaḥ api mayi vāsudeve '<parama-īśvare>K1 ca imāni' iti; <<kṣetrajña-īśvara>Di-ekatvam>T6 <<sarva{3}-upaniṣat>K1-prasiddham>T7 drakṣyasi ityarthaḥ||

||4.36|| - api cet asi pāpebhyaḥ <pāpa-kṛdbhyaḥ>U sarvebhyaḥ atiśayena <pāpa-kṛt>U <pāpa-kṛt^tamaḥ>U sarvam <jñāna-plavena>K6 eva jñānam eva plavam kṛtvā vṛjinam <vṛjina-arṇavam>K6 <pāpa-samudram>K6 saṃtariṣyasi| dharmaḥ api iha mumukṣoḥ pāpam ucyate||

||4.37|| - yathā edhāṃsi kāṣṭhāni samiddhaḥ samyak iddhaḥ dīptaḥ agniḥ bhasmasāt bhasmībhāvam kurute he arjuna, jñānam eva agniḥ <jñāna-agniḥ>K6 <sarva{3}-karmāṇi>K1 bhasmasāt kurute tathā nirbījīkaroti ityarthaḥ| na hi sākṣāt eva <jñāna-agniḥ>K6 karmāṇi indhanavat bhasmīkartum śaknoti| tasmāt samyak darśanam <sarva{3}-karmaṇām>K1 nirbījatve kāraṇam iti abhiprāyaḥ| sāmarthyāt yena karmaṇā śarīram ārabdham tat <pravṛtta-phala^tvāt>K1 upabhogena eva kṣīyate| ataḥ yāni <<na-pravṛtta>Tn-phalāni>K1 <jñāna-utpatteḥ>T6 prāk kṛtāni <jñāna-sahabhāvīni>T6 ca <<atīta-<aneka-janma>K1>K1-kṛtāni>T7 ca tāni eva sarvāṇi bhasmasāt kurute||
yataḥ evam ataḥ -

||4.38|| - na hi jñānena sadṛśam tulyam pavitram pāvanam <śuddhi-karam>U iha vidyate| tat jñānam svayam eva <yoga-saṃsiddhaḥ>T3 yogena <karman-yogena>K7 <samādhi-yogena>K7 ca saṃsiddhaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ yogyatām āpannaḥ san mumukṣuḥ kālena mahatā ātmani vindati labhate ityarthaḥ||
yena ekāntena <jñāna-prāptiḥ>T6 bhavati saḥ upāyaḥ upadiśyate -

||4.39|| - śraddhāvān śraddhāluḥ labhate jñānam| śraddhālutve api bhavati kaścit <manda-prasthānaḥ>Bs6, ataḥ āha - <tad-paraḥ>Bs6, <<guru-upāsadana>T6-ādau>Bs6 abhiyuktaḥ <<jñāna-labdhi>T6-upāye>T6 śraddhāvān| <tad-paraḥ>Bs6 api <na-<jita-indriyaḥ>Bs3>Tn syāt ityataḥ āha - <saṃyata-indriyaḥ>Bs6, saṃyatāni viṣayebhyo nivartitāni yasya indriyāṇi saḥ <saṃyata-indriyaḥ>Bs6| yaḥ <evam-bhūtaḥ>S śraddhāvān <tad-paraḥ>Bs6 <saṃyata-indriyaḥ>Bs6 ca saḥ avaśyam jñānam labhate| <praṇipāta-ādiḥ>Bs6 tu bāhyaḥ anaikāntikaḥ api bhavati, <<māyāvi^tva-ādi>Bs6-saṃbhavāt>T6; na tu tat <śraddhāvat^tva-ādau>Bs6 iti ekāntataḥ <<jñāna-labdhi>T6-upāyaḥ>T6| kim punaḥ <jñāna-lābhāt>T6 syāt iti ucyate - jñānam labdhvā param <mokṣa-ākhyām>Bs6 śāntim uparatim <na-cireṇa>Tn kṣipram eva adhigacchati| <samyak-darśanāt>K1 kṣipram eva mokṣaḥ bhavati iti <<<sarva{3}-śāstra>K1-nyāya>T6-prasiddhaḥ>T7 suniścitaḥ arthaḥ||
atra saṃśayaḥ na kartavyaḥ, pāpiṣṭhaḥ hi saṃśayaḥ; katham iti ucyate -

||4.40|| - ajñaḥ ca <na-<ātman-jñaḥ>U>Tn ca <na-śraddadhānaḥ>Tn ca <<guru-vākya>T6-śāstreṣu>Di <na-viśvāsa^vān>Tn ca <saṃśaya-ātmā>Bv ca <saṃśaya-cittaḥ>Bv ca vinaśyati| <ajña-<na-śraddadhānau>Tn>Di yadyapi vinaśyataḥ, na tathā yathā <saṃśaya-ātmā>Bv| <saṃśaya-ātmā>Bv tu pāpiṣṭhaḥ sarveṣām| katham? na ayam sādhāraṇaḥ api lokaḥ asti| tathā na paraḥ lokaḥ| na sukham, tatrāpi <saṃśaya-utpatteḥ>T6 <saṃśaya-ātmanaḥ>Bv <saṃśaya-cittasya>Bv| tasmāt saṃśayaḥ na kartavyaḥ||
kasmāt? -
<yoga-saṃnyasta-karmāṇam>Bb <jñāna-saṃchinna-saṃśayam>Bb|

||4.41|| - <yoga-saṃnyasta-karmāṇam>Bb <<<parama-artha>K1-darśana>T6-lakṣaṇena>Bs6 yogena saṃnyastāni karmāṇi yena <<parama-artha>K1-darśinā>U <<dharma-adharma>Di-ākhyāni>Bs6 tam <yoga-saṃnyasta-karmāṇam>Bb| katham <yoga-saṃnyasta-karma>Bb iti āha - <jñāna-saṃchinna-saṃśayam>Bb jñānena <<<<ātman-īśvara>Di-ekatva>T6darśana>T6-lakṣaṇena>Bs6 saṃchinnaḥ saṃśayaḥ yasya saḥ <jñāna-saṃchinna-saṃśayaḥ>Bb| yaḥ evam <yoga-saṃnyasta-karmā>Bb tam ātmavantam <na-pramattam>Tn <<guṇa-ceṣṭā>Di-rūpeṇa>Bs6 dṛṣṭāni karmāṇi na nibadhnanti <aniṣṭa-ādi>Bs6-rūpam>Bs6 phalam na ārabhante he dhanañjaya||
yasmāt <<karman-yoga>K6-anuṣṭhānāt>T6 <<<<<aśuddhi-kṣaya>T6-hetu^ka>T6-jñāna>K1-saṃchinna>T3-saṃśayaḥ>Bs6 na nibadhyate karmabhiḥ <<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-karmatvāt>K1 eva, yasmāt ca <<<jñāna-karma>Di-anuṣṭhāna>T6-viṣaye>T6 saṃśayavān vinaśyati -

iti <śrīmad-bhagavadgītāsu>K1 upaniṣatsu <brahma-vidyāyām>T6 <yoga-śāstre>K7 <<śrīkṛṣṇa-arjuna>Di-saṃvāde>T6 <karman-yogaḥ>K6 nāma caturthaḥ adhyāyaḥ||
||4.42 - tasmāt pāpiṣṭham <ajñāna-saṃbhūtam>T5 ajñānāt avivekāt jātam <hṛdaya-stham>U hṛdi buddhau sthitam <jñāna-asinā>K6 <<<<śoka-moha>Di-ādi>Bs6doṣa>K1-haram>U <samyak-darśanam>K1 jñānam tat eva asiḥ khaṅgaḥ tena <jñāna-asinā>K6 ātmanaḥ svasya, <ātman-viṣaya^tvāt>T6 saṃśayasya| na hi parasya saṃśayaḥ pareṇa cchettavyatām prāptaḥ, yena svasya iti viśiṣyate| ataḥ <ātman-viṣayaḥ>T6 api svasya eva bhavati| chittvā enam saṃśayam <<<sva-vināśa>T6-hetu>T6-bhūtam>T2, yogam <<samyak-darśana>K1-upāyam>T6 <karman-anuṣṭhānam>T6 ātiṣṭha kuru iti arthaḥ| uttiṣṭha ca idānīm yuddhāya bhārata iti||
iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrogovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmat śaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau śrīmat bhagavadgītābhāṣye caturthaḥ adhyāyaḥ||

'karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet' iti ārabhya, 'sayuktaḥ <<kṛtsna-karma>K1-kṛt>U', '<<<jñāna-agni>K6-dagdha>T3-karmāṇam>Bs6', 'śārīram kevalam karma kurvan', '<<yadṛcchā-lābha>T3-saṃtuṣṭaḥ>T3', 'brahma arpaṇam brahma haviḥ', '<karman-jān>U viddhi tān sarvān' 'sarva <karman-akhilam>K2 pārtha', '<jñāna-agniḥ>K6 <sarva{3}-karmāṇi>K1', '<yoga-saṃnyasta-karmāṇam>Bb' iti etaiḥ vacanaiḥ, <<sarva{3}-karma>K1-saṃnyāsam>T6 avocat bhagavān| 'chittvā enam saṃśayam yogam ātiṣṭha' ityanena vacanena, yogam ca <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6-lakṣaṇam>Bs6 anutiṣṭha iti uktavān| tayoḥ ubhayoḥ ca <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6-<karman-saṃnyāsayoḥ>T6>Di <sthiti-gati^vat>T6 <paraspara-virodhāt>T6, ekena saha kartum <na-śakyatvāt>Tn, <kāla-bhedena>T6 ca <<anuṣṭhāna-vidhāna>T6-abhāvāt>T6, arthāt etayoḥ <<anya^tara-kartavya^tā>T6-prāptau>T6 satyāṃ, yat praśasyataram etayoḥ <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6-<karman-saṃnyāsayoḥ>T6>Di tat kartavyam , na itarat, ityevam manyamānaḥ, praśasyataraḥ bubhutsayā arjunaḥ uvāca - 'saṃnyāsam karmaṇām kṛṣṇaḥ ' ityādinā||
nanu ca <ātman-vidaḥ>U <jñāna-yogena>K6 niṣṭhām pratipipādayiṣan, <pūrva-udāhṛtaiḥ>S vacanaiḥ bhagavān <<sarva{3}-karma>K1-saṃnyāsam>T6 avocat, na tu <na-<ātman-jñasya>U>Tn| <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6-<karman-saṃnyāsayoḥ>T6>Di <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-viṣayatvāt>T6, anyatarasya <praśasya^tara^tva-bubhutsayā>T6 ayam praśnaḥ anupapannaḥ| satyam eva, <yuṣmad-abhiprāyeṇa>T6 praśnaḥ na upapadyate; praṣṭuḥ <sva-abhiprāyeṇa>T6 punaḥ praśnaḥ yujyate eva iti vadāmaḥ| katham? <pūrva-udāhṛtaiḥ>S vacanaiḥ, bhagavatā <karman-saṃnyāsasya>T6 kartavyatayā vivakṣitatvāt, prādhānyam antareṇa ca kartāram tasya <kartavya^tva-asaṃbhavāt>T6, <na-<ātman-vit>U>Tn api kartā pakṣe prāptaḥ anūdyate eva; na punaḥ <ātman-vit>U kartṛkatvam eva saṃnyāsasya vivakṣitam, iti evam manvānasya arjunasya <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6-<karman-saṃnyāsayoḥ>T6>Di  <<<na-vidvat>Tn-puruṣa>K1-kartṛka^tvam>T6 api asti iti, <pūrva-uktena>S prakāreṇa tayoḥ <paraspara-virodhāt>T6 anyatarasya kartavyatve prāpte, praśasyataram ca kartavyam, na itarat, iti <praśasya^tara-vividiṣayā>T6 praśnaḥ na <na-upapannaḥ>Tn|| 
<<<prati-vacana>Tp-<vākya-artha>T6>T6-nirūpaṇena>T6 api, praṣṭuḥ abhiprāyaḥ evam eva iti gamyate| katham? '<saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogau>K6>Di niḥśreyasakarau, tayoḥ tu <karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate' iti <prati-vacanam>Tp| etat nirūpyam - kim anena <<ātman-vit>U-kartṛkayoḥ>Di <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di niḥśreyasakaratvam prayojanam uktvā, tayoḥ eva kutaścit viśeṣāt <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <karman-yogasya>K6 viśiṣṭatvam ucyate? āhosvit, <<<na-<ātman-vit>U>Tn-kartṛkayoḥ>Di <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di tat ubhayam ucyate? iti| kim ca ataḥ yadi <<ātman-vit>U-kartṛkayoḥ>Di <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di niḥśreyasakaratvam, tayoḥ tu <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <karman-yogasya>K6 viśiṣṭatvam ucyate; yadi vā <<<na-<ātman-vit>U>Tn-kartṛkayoḥ>Di <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di tat ubhayam ucyate iti| atra ucyate - <<ātman-vit>U-kartṛkayoḥ>Di <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di <na-saṃbhavāt>Tn, tayoḥ <<niḥśreyasa-kara^tva>U-vacanam>T6 tadīyāt ca <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <karman-yogasya>K6 <viśiṣṭa^tva-abhidhānam>T6, iti etat ubhayam <na-upapannam>Tn| yadi <na-<ātman-vidaḥ>U>Tn, <karman-saṃnyāsaḥ>T6 <tad-pratikūlaḥ>T6 ca <<karman-anuṣṭhāna>T6>Bs6lakṣaṇaḥ <karman-yogaḥ>K6 saṃbhavetām, tadā tayoḥ <<niḥśreyasa-kara^tva>U-uktiḥ>T6, <karman-yogasya>K6 ca <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <viśiṣṭa^tva-abhidhānam>T6, iti etat ubhayam upapadyeta| <ātman-vidaḥ>U tu <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di <na-saṃbhavāt>Tn, tayoḥ <<niḥśreyasa-kara^tva>U-abhidhānam>T6 <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 ca <karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate iti ca <na-upapannam>Tn||
atra āha - kim <ātman-vidaḥ>U <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di ubhayoḥ api <na-saṃbhavaḥ>Tn? āhosvit, anyatarasya <na-saṃbhavaḥ>Tn? yadā ca anyatarasya <na-saṃbhavaḥ>Tn, tadā kim <karman-saṃnyāsasya>T6, uta <karman-yogasya>K6? iti; <na-saṃbhave>Tn kāraṇam ca vaktavyam iti| atra ucyate - <ātman-vidaḥ>U <nivṛtta-<mithyā-jñāna>K1>Bs6^tvāt, <<viparyaya-jñāna>K1-mūlasya>Bs6 <karman-yogasya>K6 <na-saṃbhavaḥ>Tn| <<<janman-ādi>Bs6-<sarva{3}-vikriyā>K1>K1-rahitatvena>T3 niṣkriyam ātmānam ātmatvena yaḥ vetti tasya <ātman-vidaḥ>U, <samyak‌-darśanena>K1 <apāsta-<mithyā-jñānasya>K1>Bs3 <<<niṣkriya-<ātman-svarūpa>T6>K1-avasthāna>T6-lakṣaṇam>Bs6 <sarva{3}-<karman-saṃnyāsam>T6>K1 uktvā, <tad-viparītasya>T6 <<<<mithyā-jñāna>K1-mūla>T6-kartṛ^tva>T6-<abhimāna-puraḥsarasya>T6>T6 <<<sakriya-<ātman-svarūpa>T6>K1-avasthāna>T6-rūpasya>Bs6 karman-yogasya, iha <gītā-śāstre>K7 tatra tatra <<<ātman-svarūpa>T6-nirūpaṇa>T6-pradeśeṣu>T6, <<<<samyak-jñāna>K1-<mithyā-jñāna>K1-tat>K2-kārya>T6-virodhāt>T6, abhāvaḥ pratipādyate yasmāt, tasmāt <ātman-vidaḥ>U <nivṛtta-<mithyā-jñānasya>K1>Bs6 <<viparyaya-jñāna>K1-mūlaḥ>Bs6 <karman-yogaḥ>K6 na saṃbhavati iti yuktam uktam syāt|| 
keṣu keṣu punaḥ <<<ātman-svarūpa>T6-nirūpaṇa>T6-pradeśeṣu>T6, <ātman-vidaḥ>U <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6 pratipādyate, iti atra ucyate - 'avināśi tu tat' iti prakṛtya, 'yaḥ enam vetti hantāram', 'veda avināśinam nityam' ityādau, tatra tatra <ātman-vidaḥ>U <karman-abhāvaḥ>T6 ucyate||

'jyāyasī cet karmaṇaḥ te' ityatra <jñāna-karmaṇoḥ>Di saha <na-saṃbhave>Tn, 'yat śreyaḥ etayoḥ tat- brūhi' ityevam pṛṣṭaḥ arjunena, bhagavān sāṅkhyānām saṃnyāsinām <jñāna-yogena>K6 niṣṭhā, punaḥ <karman-yogena>K6 yoginām niṣṭhā proktā iti nirṇayam cakāra| 'na ca saṃnyasanāt eva kevalāt siddhim samadhigacchati' iti vacanāt <jñāna-sahitasya>T3 <siddhi-sādhana^tvam>T6 iṣṭam; <karman-yogasya>T6 ca, vidhānāt| <jñāna-rahitasya>T6 saṃnyāsaḥ śreyān, kim vā <karman-yogaḥ>K6 śreyān? iti etayoḥ <viśeṣa-bubhutsayā>T6 -
arjunaḥ uvāca 
saṃnyāsam karmaṇām kṛṣṇa punaḥ yogam ca śaṃsasi|

||5.1|| - saṃnyāsam parityāgam karmaṇām śāstrīyāṇām <anuṣṭheya-viśeṣāṇām>K1 śaṃsasi praśaṃsasi kathayasi iti etat| punaḥ yogam ca teṣām eva anuṣṭhānam <avaśya-kartavya^tvam>S śaṃsasi| ataḥ me katarat śreyaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ - kim <karman-anuṣṭhānam>T6 śreyaḥ, kim vā <tad-hānam>T6 iti| praśasyataram ca anuṣṭheyam| ataḥ ca yat śreyaḥ praśasyataram etayoḥ <<karman-saṃnyāsa>T6-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di <yad-anuṣṭhānāt>T6 śreyaḥ avāptiḥ mama syāt iti manyase, tat ekam anyatarat saha <<<eka-puruṣa>Km-anuṣṭheya^tva>T3-<na-saṃbhavāt>Tn>T6 me brūhi <su-niścitam>Tp abhipretam tava iti||
<sva-abhiprāyam>T6 ācakṣāṇaḥ nirṇayāya śrībhagavān uvāca -
śrībhagavān uvāca

||5.2|| - saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇām parityāgaḥ <karman-yogaḥ>K6 ca teṣām anuṣṭhānam tau ubhau api <niḥśreyasa-karau>U mokṣam kurvāte <<jñāna-utpatti>T6-hetutvena>T6| ubhau yadyapi <niḥśreyasa-karau>U, tathāpi tayoḥ tu <niḥśreyasa-hetvoḥ>T6 <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 kevalāt <karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate iti <karman-yogam>K6 stauti||
kasmāt iti āha -

||5.3|| - jñeyaḥ jñātavyaḥ saḥ <karman-yoga^in>K6 <nitya-saṃnyāsī>S iti yaḥ na dveṣṭi kiñcit na kāṅkṣati <duḥkha-sukhe>Di <tad-sādhane>T6 ca| <evam-vidhaḥ>S yaḥ, karmaṇi vartamānaḥ api saḥ <nitya-saṃnyāsī>S iti jñātavyaḥ ityarthaḥ| <nir-dvandvaḥ>Bvp <dvandva-varjitaḥ>T3 hi yasmāt <mahat-bāho>Bs6 sukham bandhāt <na-āyāsena>Tn pramucyate||
<saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogayoḥ>K6>Di <<bhinna-puruṣa>K1-anuṣṭheyayoḥ>T3 viruddhayoḥ phale api virodhaḥ yuktaḥ, na tu ubhayoḥ <niḥśreyasa-kara^tvam>U eva iti prāpteḥ idam ucyate -

||5.4|| - <sāṃkhya-yogau>Di pṛthak <viruddha-<bhinna-phalau>K1>Bs6 bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ| paṇḍitāḥ tu jñāninaḥ ekam phalam <na-viruddham>Tn icchanti| katham? kam api <sāṃkhya-yogayoḥ>Di samyak āsthitaḥ samyak anuṣṭhitavān ityarthaḥ, ubhayoḥ vindate phalam| ubhayoḥ tat eva hi niḥśreyasam phalam; ataḥ na phale virodhaḥ asti||
nanu <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yoga>K6>Di-śabdena>K7 prastutya <sāṃkhya-yogayoḥ>Di <phala-ekatvam>T7 katham iha <na-prakṛtam>Tn bravīti? na eṣaḥ doṣaḥ - yadyapi arjunena saṃnyāsam <karman-yogam>K6 ca kevalam abhipretya praśnaḥ kṛtaḥ, bhagavān tu tat <na-parityāgena>Tn eva <sva-abhipretam>T3 ca viśeṣam saṃyojya <<śabda-antara>Tm-vācyatayā>T3 <prati-vacanam>Tp dadau '<sāṃkhya-yogau>Di' iti| tau eva <saṃnyāsa-<karman-yogau>K6>Di <<<<jñāna-<tad-upāya>T6>K1-<sama-buddhi^tva>K1>T6-ādi>Bs6-saṃyuktau>T3 <<<sāṃkhya-yoga>Di-śabda>K7-vācyau>T3 iti bhagavataḥ matam| ataḥ na <<na-prakṛta>Tn-prakriyā>K1 iti||
ekasya api samyak anuṣṭhānāt katham ubhayoḥ phalam vindate iti ucyate -
yat sāṃkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānam tat yogaiḥ api gamyate| 
ekam sāṃkhyam ca yogam ca yaḥ paśyati saḥ paśyati||5.5||
||5.5|| - yat sāṃkhyaiḥ <jñāna-niṣṭhaiḥ>Bv saṃnyāsibhiḥ prāpyate sthānam <mokṣa-ākhyam>Bs6, tat yogaiḥ api <<jñāna-prāpti>T6-upāya^tvena>T6 īśvare samarpya karmāṇi ātmanaḥ phalam <na-abhisaṃdhāya>Tn anutiṣṭhanti ye te yogāḥ yoginaḥ taiḥ api <<<<parama-artha>K1-jñāna>T6-<saṃnyāsa-prāpti>T6>T4-dvāreṇa>T6 gamyate iti abhiprāyaḥ| ataḥ ekam sākhyam ca yogam ca yaḥ paśyati <phala-ekatvāt>T6 saḥ samyak paśyati ityarthaḥ||
evam tarhi yogāt saṃnyāsaḥ eva viśiṣyate; katham tarhi idam uktam 'tayoḥ tu <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate (gītā 5.2)' iti? śṛṇu tatra kāraṇam - tvayā pṛṣṭam kevalam <karman-saṃnyāsam>T6 <karman-yogam>K6 ca abhipretya tayoḥ anyataraḥ kaḥ śreyān iti| <tad-anurūpam>T6 <prati-vacanam>Tp mayā uktam <karman-saṃnyāsāt>T6 <karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate iti jñānam <na-apekṣya>Tn| <jñāna-apekṣaḥ>Bv tu saṃnyāsaḥ sāṃkhyam iti mayā abhipretaḥ| <<parama-artha>K1-yogaḥ>K6 ca saḥ eva| yaḥ tu <karman-yogaḥ>K6 vaidikaḥ saḥ ca tādarthyāt yogaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ iti ca upacaryate| katham tādarthyam iti ucyate -
saṃnyāsaḥ tu <mahat-bāho>Bs6 duḥkham āptum <na-yogataḥ>Tn| 
<yoga-yuktaḥ>T3 muniḥ brahma na cireṇa ādhigacchati||5.6||
||5.6|| - saṃnyāsaḥ tu <pārama-arthikaḥ>Bs6 he <mahat-bāho>Bs6 duḥkham āptum prāptum <na-yogataḥ>Tn yogena vinā| <yoga-yuktaḥ>T3 vaidikena <karman-yogena>K6 <<īśvara-samarpita>T3-rūpeṇa>Bs6 <phala-nirapekṣeṇa>Bs6 yuktaḥ, muniḥ mananāt <īśvara-svarūpasya>T6 muniḥ, brahma - <<<<parama-ātma>K1-jñāna>T6-niṣṭhā>T7-lakṣaṇa^tvāt>Bs6 prakṛtaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ brahma ucyate, 'nyāsaḥ iti brahmā brahmā hi paraḥ (nā0 u0 2.78)' iti śruteḥ - brahma <<parama-artha>K6-saṃnyāsam>T6 <<<<parama-artha>K1-jñāna>T6-niṣṭhā>T7-lakṣaṇam>Bs6 na cireṇa kṣipram eva adhigacchati prāpnoti| ataḥ mayā uktam '<karman-yogaḥ>K6 viśiṣyate' iti||
yadā punaḥ ayam <<<samyak-jñāna>K1-prāpti>T6-upāya^tvena>T6 -
<yoga-yuktaḥ>T3 <viśuddha-ātmā>Bs6 <vijita-ātmā>Bs3 <jita-indriyaḥ>Bs3|
<<sarva-bhūta>K1-<ātman-bhūta>T2-ātmā>Bb kurvan api na lipyate||5.7||
||5.7|| - yogena yuktaḥ <yoga-yuktaḥ>T3, <viśuddha-ātmā>Bs6 <viśuddha-sattvaḥ>Bs6, <vijita-ātmā>Bs3 <vijita-dehaḥ>Bs6, <jita-indriyaḥ>Bs3 ca, <<sarva-bhūta>K1-<ātman-bhūta>T2-ātmā>Bb sarveṣām <brahma-ādīnām>Bs6 <stamba-paryantānām>T6 bhūtānām <ātman-bhūtaḥ>T2 ātmā <pratyak-cetanaḥ>Bs6 yasya saḥ <<sarva-bhūta>K1-<ātman-bhūta>T2-ātmā>Bb <samyak-darśi>U ityarthaḥ, saḥ tatra evam vartamānaḥ <loka{3}-saṃgrahāya>T6 karma kurvan api na lipyate na karmabhiḥ badhyate ityarthaḥ||
na ca asau <parama-arthataḥ>K1 karoti ityataḥ -

||5.8-5.9|| -
na eva kiñcit karomi iti yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ san manyeta cintayet, <tattva-vit>U ātmanaḥ yāthātmyam tattvam vetti iti <tattva-vit>U <<parama-artha>K1-darśi>U ityarthaḥ||
kadā katham vā tattvam avadhārayan manyeta iti, ucyate - paśyan iti| manyeta iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ| yasya evam <tattva-vidaḥ>U <<<sarva{3}-kārya>K1-karaṇa>T6-ceṣṭāsu>T6 karmasu akarma eva, paśyataḥ <samyak-darśinaḥ>U tasya <<sarva{3}-karma>K1-saṃnyāse>T6 eva adhikāraḥ, karmaṇaḥ <abhāva-darśanāt>T6| na hi mṛgatṛṣṇikāyām <udaka-buddhyā>T6 pānāya pravṛttaḥ <<udaka-abhāva>T6-jñāne>T6 api tatra eva <pāna-prayojanāya>T6 pravartate||
yaḥ tu punaḥ <na-<tattva-vit>U>Tn pravṛttaḥ ca <karman-yoge>K6 -

||5.10|| - brahmaṇi īśvare ādhāya nikṣipya' tadartham karma karomi' iti bhṛtyaḥ iva <svāmin-artham>T4 sarvāṇi karmāṇi mokṣe api phale saṅgam tyaktvā karoti yaḥ <sarva{3}-karmāṇi>K1, lipyate na saḥ pāpena na saṃbadhyate <padma-patram>T6 iva ambhasā udakena| kevalam <<sattva-śuddhi>T6-mātram>S eva phalam tasya karmaṇaḥ syāt||
